Staff were responsive and pleasant; cheerful and helpful.In the center of the resort was a clubhouse with a lounge area, another common area with tables and chairs, and a business center with four computers and a printer.  The pool area was open from 9 AM to midnight.  A nearby fitness center had a weight set, two treadmills, two elliptical machines, and two stationary bikes.  There were also four outdoor grills.  The resort provided shuttle service to the strip, another casino, a grocery store, and Walmart.Some additional perks that were available included electric vehicle charging stations, covered areas for parking to shade cars from the sun, room-darkening draperies, sharp knives in the kitchen, and honest-to-goodness blankets for the beds.  (So many resorts have gone to comforters only, which always seem too hot.)  We cook in our unit a lot, and appreciated having good cutlery and a decent-sized cutting board, a good set of cookware, and ample, clean dishes. In addition to visiting Red Rock Canyon, the Valley of Fire is a little over an hour away, and Death Valley National Park is 2.5 to 3 hours away.

reviews.title: A perfect Property
reviews.text: The pool and spa area are larger and more inviting than the pictures show.  The property is immaculate and the room was perfectly cleaned.  The checking process was seamless and quick.  The spa is huge and can easily hold 12 people without people being packed in.

reviews.title: cliffs at peace canyon
reviews.text: decent resort, needs some updating (especially kitchen area, countertops, cabinets) no activities running or offered (stopped with covid and never started back up)  easy to get to, and quiet.  they offer shuttle to grocery store, and 2 casinos, but if you want to enjoy area a car is needed.

reviews.title: Weather and shuttle were great
reviews.text: Large two bedroom condo, lots of room for two couples .  Shuttle was very convenient to go to the strip.  We saw more of Vegas and surrounding sites, Red Rock Canyon and Hoover Dam in a rental car.   Units are older and in need of a very through deep clean.  Brought this to the attention of front desk but not much reaction to acknowledge short coming in cleaning during a pandemicThere was pigeon poos and cigarette buts on the balcony when we arrived.  Pleasant cleaner came right away but you wonder what else was missed.  I cleaned the kitchen counters myself after finding hardened ice cream on them.

reviews.title: A Peaceful Getaway!
reviews.text: The Cliffs is a perfect distance from the Strip.  We usually catch the shuttle once or twice a week (be sure to tip since this is a free trip) to the Mirage but otherwise, we stay at the resort.  Sitting by the pool, taking in the sun, barbecuing supper and going for walks equals JOY!  The rooms are a great size and the beds are comfortable.  What more could you want?

reviews.title: Great location and experience
reviews.text: We had great time in the resort. It is clean, quite and convenient. My daughter would go to swim everyday before and after our activities. The location is close to Red Rock Canyon which we went to trail, and it is also not so far from downtown LV. There are groceries nearby for anything we need.

reviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon was a good facility.
reviews.text: The facillities and amenities were good.  Good peaceful location. The only complaint was that Internet service was very weak and intermittent.   The Wifi signal kept dropping out and returning multiple times everyday of my stay.

reviews.title: Nice place but WiFi was terrible which made vacation planning difficult
reviews.text: The property is nice and we took advantage of the shuttle but the WIFI was terrible and made planning very difficult. The fact that I see other reviewers commenting on this makes me think that it was going on for awhile. I believe that the resort fee included WIFI do that should have been refunded. The shuttle is great.

reviews.title: Huge one-bedroom condo!
reviews.text: Wow, what a wonderful and expansive one bedroom apartment.  We are so pleased with our place - quiet, close to restaurants, grocery stores, and of course the Strip. So much more calmer and relaxing than one of the big high rises.  Everything you need was in place when we arrived, even laundry detergent to use in the full size washer and dryer. The kitchen is well equipped and big. Overall, it's a great place to chill and feel at home.

reviews.title: Stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Nice resort mixed in a residential area. Nice pool and hot tub.  Barbecue grills to cook.  Restaurants and shopping nearby , not in walking distance but a few minute drive. Close enough to the strip but away from the noise.

reviews.title: Truly peaceful at Peace Canyon!
reviews.text: We enjoyed a very peaceful stay at The Cliffs. Our unit was toward the back, quiet with a lovely view of the mountains. We actually stayed for two separate weeks, and the second week we asked to change our unit, and the desk clerk was immensely helpful. We are not "The Strip" kind of people, so this was very restful. But when we did want to go downtown, the shuttle bus was really helpful, and both drivers were very sweet. There was a supermarket (Smith's), Walgreen's, and a couple restaurants very handy (with a car, but the shuttle will take you to the grocery store as well as The Strip). My only suggestion would be to provide pool noodles; there were many senior vacationers, and we all said we'd benefit from them. We definitely hope to go back.

reviews.title: Wonderful, attentive staff!
reviews.text: I have stayed at The Cliffs many times!  I love the location, the shuttle service and the friendliness of all the staff (including security and shuttle drivers).  Our 2 bedroom unit was great along with the pool area.  I can't wait to go back!

reviews.title: Great location and nice units off the strip
reviews.text: Nice place to stay if not wanting to be on the strip.  Conveniently located to shopping, Red Rock Canyon, lots of trails.  The resort has a nice pool and hot tub and the units are a large size, allowing two couples to spread out.

reviews.title: Convenient wast Las Vegas Resort
reviews.text: Nice quiet location awzy from the strip.  We seldom go to the strip, this is a great spot to access Red Rock Canyon, golf courses, biking, and disc golf courses.  The pool area and bbq areas are nice quiet spots.Very comfortable location.

reviews.title: Dated property located in residential neighborhood
reviews.text: 1980's styling.  Looks and feels more like an apartment complex instead of a resort. Small pool.  Staff was very helpful when asked, but overall property needed more amenities.  Location biggest detriment.

reviews.title: A great choice for anyone that does not want to stay right on the strip
reviews.text: We stayed for two weeks and loved it. The location is great. Driving to the strip is very easy.  The location is close to everything you might need, and it is also right near the 215 which makes it is very convenient for quickly going anywhere you want to go.  The pool and hot tub are great.  They have nice gas grills if you want to grill a few steaks.  We loved this place.

reviews.title: Good unit, sketchy cleaning and Wi-Fi
reviews.text: Booked this week via RCI as a bonus week. Got a 2 BR unit. Unit is laid out well, maintained ok, but poorly cleaned. Lots of accumulated dirt/dust away from primary surfaces. Unit did have a washer/dryer. Was charged a resort fee that included Wi-Fi.  Wi-Fi wouldn’t work consistently in the unit. This was a problem as I was working part of the week. Asked guest services for assistance. Was told that they new about Wi-Fi issue and they were trying to get fixed. Asked if I still wanted someone to come work on it. I said yes to reset the Connection, but no one ever came. Pool, hot tub and grills worked well. Overall, a good experience off the strip with restaurants and shoppers near by.

reviews.title: Feels like home
reviews.text: My husband and I return every year because the resort is clean and friendly. The pool is excellent, the grills are kept clean, and the shuttle to the strip is so convenient. The condo is well equipped and comfortable.

reviews.title: Location Location Location
reviews.text: Great restaurants and shopping within walking distance.  15 minute drive to Red Rock Conservation Area.  Great hiking.  Bring a nonstick frying pan and a cookie sheet, or pizza pan.  Check in and check out are easy.  if you get Roy at check in, he will go out of his way to make your experience wonderful.  The shuttle to The Strip is very nice.

reviews.title: Clean, quiet
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay here and the one-bedroom was perfect for a couple. Would have been tight with four people but that's probably true of most one-bedrooms. Actually had washer/dryer in the unit. LARGE walk-in closet plus a coat closet. Bathroom located outside the bedroom which was convenient when someone was still sleeping. 20 minute drive to the strip and the shuttle requires advanced 24 hour notice so I wouldn't stay here without a car. But it's away from the hustle and bustle which is a plus.

reviews.title: Less than expected
reviews.text: The location is a little out of the way when traveling to Las Vegas strip activity, a shuttle service is available but not easily used. Appearance of the facility is good but maintenance of individual units is sorely lacking.  The staff were friendly.

reviews.title: Nice unit - No WIFI, rude staff
reviews.text: We had booked the unit from Saturday Feb. 26, but arrived on Monday Feb. 28th. We reached the resort at 1:30pm. We approached the front desk and informed the staff that we are checking in. Her response was no you cant check in now. No greeting, no questions. My husband said we have the unit from Saturday and was trying to give her the name. She said, I don't need your name, give me your ID.We found this whole experience very unsettling. She proceeded to check us in, without any comments. I suppose she needs some training on customer service. Or perhaps she had a problem because we were of Indian origin. We have been RCI members for 13 years, this is the first time having such a unprofessional service.If you are planning to use WIFI to plan your stay, forget about it. The WIFI kicked us out every 30 seconds. We have to keep logging back in. We found it hard to plan the day, find restaurants, etc. The front desk informed us that they are aware of the problem and are trying to fix it. It did not get fixed the whole week we were there.

reviews.title: Peace at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Great place to stay. Private and quiet.  It could have close to the strip. Plenty of restaurants  in the area. I recommend  the EggWorks for breakfast. We will probably book the Cliffs at Peace Canyon again..

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Wonderful experience. Very clean and spacious. Pool was amazing and open until midnight! Shuttle is an awesome option to the strip. Resort is nicely located, not too far from strip but far enough from all the bustle to enjoy rest of Nevada.

reviews.title: Great place to vacation
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon are outstanding.  Clean and spacious.  If you are not into gambling,this is the place to stay. Area is quiet and facility is great.  Staff are very attentive and requests are taken care of asap.

reviews.title: Our go to  when in Vegas
reviews.text: Our go to when in Vegas.  It is consistently friendly clean  close to Rte 215 which makes it convenient to getting around to the strip, the airport, Red Rock Casino and Red Rock Federal Park.  Recommend to anyone who would like to be close to the downtown action without spending all of your town in the busiess of the strip.

reviews.title: Nice place off Strip
reviews.text: Our intent was to stay away from the Strip and this fit the bill. They offer shuttle service to a few locations and I thought we might take advantage of that but it never happened. It would have been nice if shuttle service had been offered to/from the airport. We WOULD have used that. As it was, we used Lyft quite a bit and also walked to nearby places since the temperatures were pleasant at this time of year.

reviews.title: White and peaceful
reviews.text: Not a lot of people at the location so it was quiet and relaxing.  Location is good for traveling to Red Rock Canyon, Fremont Street, Lake Mead and the Strip.  Lots of restaurants and shopping close too!

reviews.title: Wish I could have stayed longer
reviews.text: Great place to stay......nice staff, very helpful.  Clean pools and property. My overall experience was 29 out of 30.....only thing of any issue was the room wasn't clean enough for my wife....as it couldn't be....so she cleaned it again....herself.  The shuttle was a wonderful thing....we enjoyed Mr. Rocky, he is an excellent and HONEST driver....if he could he did...if he thought he would be late...he would tell you before he dropped you off.

reviews.title: Nice but needs some unit updating
reviews.text: The  property is nice, the individual units need updating. With the slow down due to Covid should be used to repair and update the aging aspects of the unit especially the Kitchen area (cupboards and finishing).

reviews.title: poor wifi
reviews.text: Very poor WiFi. Kept getting kicked off.  Not good enough to stream a movie.Hard sell to go to timeshare presentation where the unvaccinated salesman wanted to eat with us and talk unmasked, not to mention argue about vaccinations which was inappropriate.

reviews.title: Peace in the Canyon
reviews.text: This is my second or third time staying at this wonderful resort a short distance from the Las Vegas strip.  It has a shuttle bus to take you around town if you don’t feel like driving, even to the strip.  The condos are nice and spacious like an apartment.  Staff is friendly and helpful.  I highly recommend this property for long stays in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Location in residential area of Las Vegas
reviews.text: The first floor units are subjected to noise from second floor occupants. The Cliffs has very poor internet. We stayed for two consecutive weeks. On the second week, we called the reception to clean our unit, the replacement bedsheets and towels were outside our door but the room was not cleaned when we returned in the afternoon. We had to follow it up with the reception the following day.

reviews.title: Noisy Downstairs
reviews.text: Staying in a ground floor unit be prepared for a lot of foot traffic noise from upstairs. The people upstairs would arrive back around 11:00pm and walk around until about 1:00am. They would start all over again around 5:30am. It sounded like they were trying to get steps in for their Fitbit. They constantly stomped around, not walking lightly. Since there are no elevators we took a downstairs unit due to amount of luggage and groceries.

reviews.title: Great week long visit
reviews.text: We had a great trip not only visiting the Vegas Strip using the amazing Steve and Rocky who drove us there as well as to Fremont Street and local grocery via the shuttle, we also were close to the Grand Canyon West and Red Rock Canyon from this location.  Comfortable and easy to access.

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at this resort during Christmas Week to spend some alone time together.The resort is in a very good location if you want to go to Red Rock Canyon and the nearby area; including Downtown Summerlin.The property is well-maintained and everyone we spoke with were very helpful.

reviews.title: Great Facility
reviews.text: This well maintained facility is conveniently located to several attractions without the dealings of large crowds nearby.  Staff very friendly and helpful.  Each visit is a 10/10!  Look forward to many upcoming stays here with family and friends…

reviews.title: Work-cation
reviews.text: Great place and staff was very helpful. Would stay they again. Location was perfect close enough to the strip, but away from the crowds. Close to Red Rock Canyon and Valley of Fire State Park for great hiking.

reviews.title: Good option off the strip
reviews.text: Shuttle service to the strip is free but check the shuttle schedule before booking your tickets to shows, otherwise you will be paying $20-$40 to Uber each way.  Since Covid, their shuttle service is not what it was before when you could guarantee a ride late into the evening.

reviews.title: Maybe it was just my unit
reviews.text: In general it’s a nice timeshare.  HOWEVER, the t.v. In the second bedroom for some unknown reason went on at about 1:15 every night.  We would have had to move furniture in order to unplug it.  We called maintenance, but they could not solve it.  The heat would not go on if the fan was set at auto, only if the fan was set to always go on.  The shower in the second bedroom was dripping.  The furniture was outdated.  Otherwise it was great.

reviews.title: Location in Vegas
reviews.text: If you want a really quiet place, this place is great. Staff was friendly and property and rooms were clean. Nice place over all. The shuttle ran most days 11am-6pm. This is the only thing that I can really talk negatively about, and it probably has more to do with staff shortages. We were ready to get active well before 11 and past 6pm. And the shuttle only went certain places during the day so you need to plan how you want to do things. Such as go to the local grocery store, the Red Rock Casino or to the strip. It only went certain places certain times of the day. We ended up using Uber the entire stay which got pretty pricy from where the resort is located. We could have rented a vehicle, but after seeing the traffic in and around the Las Vegas strip we decided we didn't want to drive the area. Leave it to the locals. There are some good eats around the place. Rise and Shine and Einstein's Bagels were exceptional breakfast stops each day about 3/4 mile from the resort. Smith's Grocery store about the same distance in the opposite direction was clean and well stocked  also. Over all an excellent choice if you don't plan to spend every day on the strip or that part of town.

reviews.title: Fun Resort, warm swimming pool, hot-tub was large and worked well,
reviews.text: Very friendly staff, the room with two bedrooms was awesome, large screen in every room, full kitchen, washer and dryer! not too far from the strip! Well kept up by staff, had a game room with a pool table. and there was good workout room, they had 10 grills to cookout anytime great for grilling steaks!

reviews.title: Nice pool, terrible internet.
reviews.text: Really nice pool and hot tub area with outdoor barbeques.   Dated but clean units.  Nice location 7 miles west of the strip.  Fairly quiet.  Easy to get around west Las Vegas.  Close to downtown Summerlin for great shopping, restaurants and Red Rocks Casino.  Biggest problem is the very poor internet connection.  At times it’s unusable.  If you are looking for a place to relax and go lay by the pool this works great.  But if you are depending on the internet for work or school don’t count on it being available, as it’s often off-line.

reviews.title: Restful, Peaceful Resort
reviews.text: My daughter and I have stayed her numerous times and it is extremely clean, friendly and easy to get to. Love their shuttle that takes you to the strip, mall and Grocery store. We will come back again soon!!

reviews.title: Peace at the Cliffs
reviews.text: The Handicap Unit is in need of update/repair. We attached the towel racks in both bathrooms on the walls. Toilet is too low. I reported the lack of towel racks, they were sitting on top of the sinks counters upon our arrival, no maintenance responded.

reviews.title: Fire specific front deskperson .... horrible front desk experience !!!!
reviews.text: Far less than a RCI Gold Crown Resort !!! Lower your expectations if you choose to stay here. There were no canyons in the middle of this apartment complex on the west side of Las Vegas. No views except a parking lot or the other side of buildings. The inside of this apartment was old and very dated. The dishwasher did not sit properly in the cabinent frame. Very poor condidtion overall. The beds creaked badly. Overall, this is just an old, outdated apartment complex in a residential neighborhood. As for the first night arriving, the front desk "customer service" rep was HORRIBLE. She was in a foul mood, glared at us across the lobby, was rude from the first second of arrival. I asked her if she was having a bad day. She didn’t like that and her rudeness got worse. I then said "this is poor customer service", which was a statement of fact, so she said "If you disrespect me, I'll give it right back"... that should terminate this person immediately. I did not disrespect her !!!! She was rude, period. But when she refused to give me a second key to the room, even though I asked three times, she then called security to escort me out of "her" lobby. She said I wasn't welcome in her lobby, and not to return. That's when I said "This is bulls---". At that point I was upset as that was a very poor move on her part to escalate the situation !!!! Clearly, this was not her first time acting so rudely to a "guest". The photos are of the first room we were sent to... with trash in the kitchen and bathrooms, and the bedrooms, kitchen and bathrooms not attended to.  Poor excuse for a "peaceful resort"

reviews.title: Cliffs
reviews.text: The community appeared half full but they put a family above us that stomped around at all hours. The unit was not clean to expectations. The bed was hard and with the stomping upstairs, sleeping wasn’t what we wanted for a vacation.We’ve stayed at Cliffs several times since 2000, but this time left us disappointed.

reviews.title: The Cliffs is a very nice and comfortable resort.
reviews.text: The location was great and our unit was very nice.  We liked being on the ground floor with easy access to the pool and jacuzzi.  Although we didn't use the barbecue area it seemed very clean and had 5 grills.  They also have a wonderful outside fireplace with comfortable chairs.  The jacuzzi jets were strong and the temperatures of the jacuzzi and pool were great.  They have longer hours to enjoy both and it was nice to have that option for time.  The rooms were nice and spacious.

reviews.title: POOR TREATMENT OF THE OWNER BY STAFF MEMBER
reviews.text: Long story short, the staff member at the front desk didn't like my opinion, so she called security.  Personally, I don't appreciate being threatened by someone that is supposed to be working for me.  And if you know me, you would know that I don't start messing with someone else until they F>>K with me.

reviews.title: A Little Disappointed
reviews.text: We had several issues with housekeeping and ended up cleaning ourselves. The dishwasher was leaking and maintenance cleared that up. The television in the guest bedroom had not video, just audio and the front desk advised me that it needed to be replaced. The had no replacement. The staff was really friendly but seemed short staffed. Everything else was really good. Love the pool.

reviews.title: Cliff at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: The resort is away from the Las Vegas Strip, but we enjoy the peace and quiet of this resort.  The staff was very friendly and the check-in and check-out was very efficient.  The resort is very close to several major roads , with many shopping and restaurant options.  It is also easy access to 215 highway.  Overall a very nice resort for the Las Vegas area.

reviews.title: Large and comfortable
reviews.text: We rented a 2 bedroom unit; it was very large, comfortable with lots of space.  The unit was clean however it was dated with older furniture and features.  We enjoyed the heated pool and hot tub and the pleasant surroundings outdoors.

reviews.title: Good location
reviews.text: The location is great if you want to be off the strip.  Theunit itself was spacious although the utensils and other kitchen items need to be updated or replaced.  If you are in a unit on the 2nd floor it has a nice fireplace.  On the other hand, the front desk staff leaves a lot to be desired.  We reported a problem with the TVs in both bedrooms.  It was never fixed and there was no follow up from the desk staff.  Also, the “shuttle service” is a bit of a joke.  We recommend a rental car or some other transportation.

reviews.title: The Cliffs
reviews.text: Stayed at The Cliffs at the end of Sept 2021. The Cliffs is located on the far west side of Las Vegas. If you want to be close to the strip, this is not your place. If you like off the beaten path, the Cliffs is in a great spot, about a 20 minute drive from the strip. Found our unit to be roomy and comfortable. It was clean and well maintained though not very new. At the end of September, the place was dead. There were very few guests. The common area has gas grills and a nice pool and hot tub. We had little contact with the staff outside of check-in, which was easy. There was a power issue in the bathroom the first night that we were there. Called the front desk early in the morning and they dispatched maintenance first thing in the morning. All in all, The Cliffs was a good stay.

reviews.title: Front desk employee was rude and disrespectful to our guests.
reviews.text: Booked one week for a two bedroom through RCI for us and another couple (our family). Due to Southwest airlines cancelling our flight from Tucson AZ, we had to drive the approx 445 miles, thereby delaying our check-in by one day. Our guest couple had arrived at the appointed day. I had to jump through some hoops with RCI to provide a "Guest Certificate" that would allow them to check-in before we arrived the following day. I e-maild the RCI guest certificate to our guests, and RCI was to provide a copy to The Cliffs at Peace Canyon. After a few hours had lapsed our guests arrived at "Peace Canyon" and proceeded to attempt check-in. The front desk employee informed them they couldn't check-in until they received the RCI copy. I've come to expect this slow response from RCI, however what transpired from the front desk was unacceptable. Granted that this is hearsay from our guest: They asked the front desk employee what they should do, and was informed that they could sleep on the street for all she cared! HOW RUDE!

reviews.title: Outdated
reviews.text: The apartment appliances were so old it carried a stench.  AC motor ran the entire time.  Washer and dryer  is 25 years old. coffee pot was ancient.  the exercise equipment was so old.   The utensils were ok.  the only thing that was great was the shuttle service guys, night shift and the ice machine  T he pool area was never serviced the entire time we were there.  Being we are in a pandemic situation, I assumed the sanitation guidelines was safe.  I was sadly mistaken.  They should have never open due to lack of  sufficient staff and sanitation guidelines.

reviews.title: week stay
reviews.text: Had to be moved to 3 different units.  maintenance problems in all 3 units.  Outdated furniture and beds are old and uncomfortable.  the cost in points double from last time we stayed. Very disappointed with this.  Pool was really warm and made us wonder if it was being maintained.

reviews.title: Vegas Gathering
reviews.text: Other than the bed being uncomfortable and iron faulty it was a nice unit.  The associate were very nice cause I had to change my time of arrival a few time due to the airline.  Visited with both daughters and grandson was a nice gathering.

reviews.title: Great people, uncomfortable furniture
reviews.text: The resort was nice and the people working there were helpful. My only complaint is the furniture from the living room to the bed was uncomfortable. In addition, comforter was scratchy and old. The pool was nice with its spa and not crowded.

reviews.title: The Cliffs
reviews.text: Great area for some relaxation. Our room was comfortable, nicely clean, close to the pool area, and quiet.  Administration was professional and office was nicely staffed.  Would highly recommend staying here

reviews.title: Ok place
reviews.text: This resort is ok but nothing special.  It needs work on the sinks and toilets and a little updating would be nice.  Its very quiet so for the over 75 its perfect.  It does have food places close at hand which is good because there is nothing offered at the place.

reviews.title: Very nice rooms and grounds
reviews.text: Rooms were excellent!! Very nice, well maintained, and clean. Ground and pool area are very clean and well maintained. Very convenient location to stores and restaurants. Front desk team helpful, and check in/out was easy. Staying here again soon!20-30 min to the strip was the only bad thing

reviews.title: Enjoyed our stat at The Cliffs
reviews.text: We very much enjoyued our five-night stay at The Cliffs. We were in a 1 BR, second floor unit, at the rear of the property but still a close walk to the pool area. We used the pool, hot tub, and BBQ nearly every day and really enjoyed those amenities. They were clean and well maintained. Perhaps because it was mid-September and school had started, we didn't see many kids; instead we met many working or retired couples, many of whom were repeat visitors or time share owners. We purposely stayed in the Summerlin area because it is very convenient to parks (Mt. Charleston, Red Rock Canyon, Spring Reserves) as well as the strip. We would like to return.

reviews.title: Fantastic as long as you're not a gym rat.
reviews.text: Literally my only less than wonderful comment is regarding a very lackluster fitness center. Don't expect to get a weight workout there.  HOWEVER,  this resort was otherwise fantastic and we HIGHLY recommend.

reviews.title: My home away from home
reviews.text: I am a timeshare owner here at The Cliffs for the past 20 years.  This resort is an excellent place for couples and family to share time.  The Units and grounds are updated and clean.  The staff are always ready to assist you in any way from the front desk to the cleaners and maintenance.  They have a shuttle service to get you back and forth to the Strip and also for groceries.  It's my home away from home and I always look forward to going back.  You won't be disappointed.  Bonnie P

reviews.title: Great time at the Cliffs
reviews.text: Check Inn was easy. Unit was Clean and fresh.The resort was not busy ( I guess do to covid)Would recommend We like the Convenience of being close to the Highway (215) It makes Vegas very accessible.

reviews.title: Not clean and a little stinky
reviews.text: We stayed here for a trip off the strip with the kids. When we arrived after midnight, the room had not been air conditioned (85 degrees), there was a dirty toilet seat, and it had a funky smell. We cleaned the toilet because we didn’t want to wait any longer to go to bed. The AC worked and cooled it down fairly quickly. Beds were comfy, pool was refreshing, second floor was quiet. After awaking the last morning, we found two empty lubrication bottles and a white washcloth under the bed! At this point, I wonder if they had even washed the sheets?! I don’t want to know. Masks were being required but we were allowed to wear them incorrectly which makes no sense. If you are worried about their cleaning regimen because of Covid, it clearly is not up to par.

reviews.title: Nice, clean, and worth the stay!
reviews.text: The staff at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon was very supportive and helpful in any way I asked of them.  The room was very clean and neat.  I have no complaints about the staff,  the room maintenance or ground maintenance,

reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.text: The resort was clean, well laid out, convenient to Vegas as well as Hoover Dam and Red Rock Canyon.  The unit was clean.  The pool was refreshing.  Would like to come back again sometime in the future.  Recommend the resort.

reviews.title: Second visit at Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: We traded our condo for the Cliffs for our 4th anniversary. We stayed here after a whirlwind tour from Tucson, Sedona and Utah, ending in getting married in Las Vegas. We are seniors, widows, over 65. The first visit In August 2017 made us want to come back. After checking in today, we are not so happy. I wrote five emails to various addresses claiming to be affiliated with Peace Canyon. We wanted to stay in the same unit we had in 2017. I received an email from customer service at the Cliffs saying they would try their best to grant or wish, and said they sent the request to the timeshare. After a long trip from NJ to Las Vegas, we finally got to the resort. They stated they did not receive the request. Okay, we were given a two bedroom that we did request but not where we wanted it. We understood. We got to the unit and checked it out. It was disgusting!  Large globs of hair in the bathtub with remaining water. Dead large water bugs on the floors. Tub was dirty all over. We went to the front desk, showed the manager the pictures, and he was appalled!  He was very kind and gave us another unit with someone to help with the luggage. I appreciated that so much, since my husband is almost 70, and it’s been a long day. We were taken to the new unit. Before my husband came in, I checked quickly because he was getting upset with even staying here. The bathroom toilet had toilet tissue in it, and the bed has blood stains on the sheets. I didn’t want to upset my husband, since he has heart issues, but with seeing that and other stuff, I told him all was well and didn’t tell him. I’ll suck it up. We are stuck here for the week, since we exchanged our timeshare for this. I will never return. I can’t believe this is considered a high end timeshare.

reviews.title: A great place to escape/
reviews.text: Clean and well  kept grounds , wonderful pool and spa opened from 6AM-midnight, quiet and nicely furnished units. The staff was  Great  and a shuttle to the strip or grocery shopping is available if you want to go

reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Wonderful week at the resort.  Beautiful grounds, lovely pool, grill was nice, room is nicely appointed.  The bed and pillows were very comfortable. The resort spa onsite was top notch.  I highly recomment.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: They decided to close the pool all day without notice. We did not able to use the pool and we are very disappointed. We could change our schedule if we only knew. Their reason of closure is cutting trees.

reviews.title: A home away from home on par with Disney accommodations. Quiet room upon request. Clean and pleasant accommodations.
reviews.text: A home away from home on par with Disney accommodations. Quiet room upon request. Clean and pleasant accommodations.

reviews.title: Cliffs is a very nice play to stay.
reviews.text: The Cliffs is a very nice play to stay. Staff is friendly and quick to respond. Facilities are clean. We loved having a washer and dryer in our unit. Our only complaint was that the mattress in our two bedroom unit was very hard and the frame squeaky.

reviews.title: Nice location and Resort/Poor Info
reviews.text: We really liked this well maintained and conveniently located resort. It is modern and and spacious. Our view was nothing to speak of but we really liked the layout and small size of the resort. We had an issue w the DVD player and maintenance came and promptly replaced it. Pool is small but was not crowded and was nice.  Lots of seating. Nice mix of families who all seemed respectful. Our only constructive feedback is that the front desk told us nothing at check-in. They have movies and board games to check out for free. We saw on activity center sign on our last day but too late to check it out. Nice clubhouse with a pool table and TV as well as coupons. No information given about check out either or the ability to visit the Grandview sister resort.  These are basic communications that should be provided right away. Other than that, the location and resort were very nice and low key, which is what we like. Also, lots of conveniently located stores and restaurants nearby.

reviews.title: Great Spot!
reviews.text: Great location off the strip but quick to get where ever you want to go including the strip, there are still hotels on the strip that have free parking so commuting back and forth was not an issue - great place for families.  The units were modern and spacious, the entire area was very clean and we felt very safe comfortable there.

reviews.title: Really NOT a Resort
reviews.text: This is a converted condo complex. Has a small pool, small gym, and a billiards table. That's it. No food. No drinks. Apartments are spacious, but also laid out strangely. Why would you put a walk-in closet in the bathroom, so all your clothes can get funky from the shower steam? Wi-Fi is awful. I put in a help ticket with their provider on Day 1 and it never got solved. Washing machine and dryer in unit (which left a small river in the adjoining kitchen). Has covered, assigned parking spots which was good. Easy drive to Strip (which is currently $30/night during the week - maybe we'll stay there for a couple of nights so it feels more like a vacation and not an Air BnB). Heck, even the Hampton Inn in Barstow cools their pool so it's not a bathtub. It's fine. It's clean. It's quiet. But they're calling themselves a "luxurious resort" which is HI-LARIOUS.

reviews.title: Nice, clean resort away from the Law Vegas Strip
reviews.text: I like staying too close to the Las Vegas lights but still close enough to enjoy. There is a shuttle service available which we chose not to use. Everything in the unit worked well with plenty of towels in the bathrooms. The staff was friendly and efficient.

reviews.title: Watch out for RCI
reviews.text: Facility good. RCI bad. I am expecting RCI to make good on this second charging of a second room that was already paid for in advance. I don't seem to be able to submit this review because I'm sure they don't want to hear about how they double charged me for a room I already paid for.

reviews.title: Quiet, Clean and Comfortable
reviews.text: Clean, spacious units. Had everything we needed to enjoy our Vegas trip. Comfortable for our party of 4. Large rooms. Sofa bed comfortable. Pool area was clean and quiet. Shuttle service is a great service offered and driver was very friendly.

reviews.title: Fantastic units; great location
reviews.text: Loved this resort, for being Vegas-adjacent. Definitely felt like we were away from The Strip, and closer to nature (Red Rock Canyon.) Peaceful, good light, covered parking. Covid protocols were in place when we were there. Unit was very well appointed, clean and up to date.

reviews.title: Great resort, NOT so great staff
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful. The staff is what I have a problem with, I am not a well person and have several serious health issues to deal with, One evening my wife was out at dinner and called me back at the condo and I was in the shower and did not hear the phone. She waited 5 min and called again and again I did not hear the phone. She called the office and asked them if they would have security check on me. I called her back and she informed me that security would be coming by and that she had JUST spoke to the office....No one ever came by or even called, it is a good thing that I did not have a serious issue. We have had a couple of problems with the staff before and maybe that is why I believe there may be a bit of an attitude with them.

reviews.title: Trip
reviews.text: Booked here thru RCI after it was listed as Gold Crown resort. This resort was big disappointment.  Unit was dated, with cracked tiles, old tired cabinets and appliances.  Resort is old condo complex dressed up as a resort.  Don't waste your time here.

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Very clean and inviting.  Great place for business or for family.  Excellent staff and grounds crew.  Amenities left some to be desired.  Very near to residential hot spots for recreation.  I expect to be back before the end of the year.

reviews.title: Quiet and relaxing
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the Cliffs of Peace Canyon and recommend it. Large, clean, well-maintained units. Friendly, accommodating staff. Close to Red Rock Canyon, where we enjoyed hiking several days. Easy drive to The Strip. Plenty of shops and restaurants in the area to enjoy.

reviews.title: Another nice visit at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: This is the second time we visited this resort.  The resort is in a quiet neighborhood, perfect for our family.  The resort is simple and clean.  Our children enjoyed the pool.  There are plenty of restaurants and shopping nearby.  Although we had our personal cars, there is a shuttle to the Las Vegas Strip and local grocery stores.   We will stay here again.

reviews.title: The Cliffs in May.
reviews.text: We very much enjoyed ourselves at the Cliffs. If there was anything we would have wanted extra it would be a fast food service on site. Other than that we were very satisfied with the staff and the grounds.

reviews.title: Best in Vegas for families
reviews.text: Lovely large apartments in a quieter part of the city which connects easily to main routes into city. Resort has excellent facilities for families and super friendly staff. Red Rock Canyon, Calico Basin, Spring Mountain Ranch Preserve are all nearby and all are excellent for hiking and wildlife. Vegas has so much to offer other than the Sin City ‘attractions’. We had a great two weeks and never set foot on the strip. Great accommodation is the perfect springboard for a family trip and the Cliffs is it!

reviews.title: Las Vegas area visit
reviews.text: Nice quiet resort yet close to Vegas and area attractions. From this resort we visited Hoover Dam, Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire State Park, The old railroad tunnel trail (that was used when building hoover dam), Death Valley CA (about a 2 hour drive) and yes Las Vegas (15 minute drive).Staff was very friendly and no pressure to attend an update (sales pitch).

reviews.title: Quiet stay at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Staying at Peace Canyon in the West Las Vegas area is truly peaceful.  It is located in a quiet residential area, but you can easily get onto the nearby freeway and easily visit the Red Rock Canyon area, as well. The Las Vegas airport is reached quickly via the freeway.  Local shopping is just a few minutes away. Several lovely restaurants abound near the resort.

reviews.title: May in Vegas
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a lovely resort.  we stayed to ourselves and did not venture to the pool which was opened.  We had a street facing unit but no noise from cars driving by.  the only time we needed anything it was delivered within 20 minutes.   This was a very relaxing vacation for us.

reviews.title: Las Vegas is much more than the trip
reviews.text: Excellent location, just off Hwy215, 10-15 mins from strip very quiet and easy to get to the “other” great things. Red Rock Valley, Hoover Dam, Boulder City, mountain trails, and so much more that people do not know about. 10-15 from the airport. Really large rooms and the service is great, no one bugs you, there are none of those annoying sales calls or other calls.

reviews.title: Vegas fun
reviews.text: We prefer the Cliffs at Peace Canyon over staying on the Strip whenever we visit Las Vegas. It is well laid out and appointed. It is near everything we need like grocery store, restaurants, salons and gas stations. Easy to get to and from the airport. The condos are spacious and  include washer and dryer as well as a full kitchen. The 2 bedroom units have 2 bathrooms, which is very nice.

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: I would say this place is average. Great location away from Las Vegas Strip and close to Red Rocks. Nothing special. It was clean, well equipped, and comfortable. It is obviously an old apartment complex they made into a resort. The outside grills were nice. Small (single) pool and hot tub. I would say this place is more for adult travelers. I'm not saying it is not kid friendly. Just not much there for them. Service a little suspect. Our AC was periodically making some excessive noise. They came and looked at it and said they would have to get contractor in to service it. They never did come and we just leaved with the noise. Probably would opt for another place if given the choice.

reviews.title: Cliffs
reviews.text: This is an intimate resort. It's peaceful and not far from the strip.  The staff was very pleasant. My unit was clean and the kitchen was well equip and the front desk had grilling utensils. There were only two things I would change. (1) On the first night I had to wash all of my linens because the detergent used made me itch and (2) I wish the shuttle ran 7 days instead of only 5 days (off Wednesday & Thursday).

reviews.title: Nice and Quiet Location
reviews.text: We were here to visit family and friends, so the location was perfect for us. It is far enough away from the hustle and bustle of the strip, yet close enough if you choose to make a trip to the strip.The unit was very clean, but could use some beefing up to make the decor a little more up to date.

reviews.title: Desert trip
reviews.text: Very nice stay on west side of Las Vegas.  Excellent facility off the strip and close to Red Rock area.  Close to shopping and multiple good restaurants and easy access to the strip for gambling and people watching.

reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.text: Ive stayed here a few times and we enjoy it every time! They allowed us to check in early which was great. We stayed for one week and reserved 2 units to which they accommodated us with units directly close to each other. Its abut 20 min away from the strip with beautiful mountain views near by. The resort is perfect for family vacations as my family and I enjoy every time we stay at this resort!

reviews.title: Clean and quiet
reviews.text: First time staying at The Cliffs. We really enjoyed our stay!  Mostly out hiking during the day or down on the Vegas Strip. Used pool once as it was just repaired and a little cold but pool area is really nice. Unit was clean. Only complaint is the bathtub creaks when standing in it to take shower.

reviews.title: Quiet, great location for hiking
reviews.text: We started with the expectation of not going to the strip every day, which worked out perfectly once we were introduced to Red Rock Canyon. We drove 15 minutes each day and hiked for 3-5 hours a day, after picking up some local coffee and breakfast right around the corner. We will be coming back, can’t wait!

reviews.title: The Cliffs
reviews.text: This is my 3rd time here and you can tell units are showing lots of wear and tear. The pool was going maintenance repair so we could not enjoy the pool. The resort offered the pool at the grand view which is a solution but drinking and driving could be an issue since the Grandview is like 20 min from the cliffs.

reviews.title: Apartment in the city
reviews.text: Not a 'resort' in Vegas terms but it has ample size and the grounds were well maintained.  It is a good location if you are going to do adventures around the city. Not your unit if you want to camp on Fremont Street or the Strip.

reviews.title: Las Vegas with Friends
reviews.text: Everything worked to perfection. Check-in was smooth and easy. Cliffs folks were able to house our group in side by side units making it easy to visit. Units were recently updated with new carpeting and interior paint. BBQ's were clean and all worked fine. Staff was courteous and friendly. Highly recommend the Cliffs at Peace Canyon

reviews.title: Excellent place
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon was a comfortable, beautiful, relaxing and inviting place near the strip in Vegas.  Very clean, staff was courteous and responsive, and it was so easy to access.  The management really went out of its way to make us feel at home.  Highly recommend and will soon be back.

reviews.title: Expected better than it was
reviews.text: Normally, I work to find positive stuff about locations we stay at. The Cliffs at Peace Canyon made that a bit more challenging. I will start with the few pros I could find.1. proximity to beautiful hiking in Red Rock Canyon was perfect.2. proximity to grocery stores was great.3. spacious4. Kitchen was nice and had most of the necessary utensils and dishes and the ice maker even worked. woohoo5. things were a little worn. The bathroom needed some caulking around the floor tiles.Cons1. the unit we were in smelled of past smokers staying in it.2. the front desk suggested we have a second floor unit, but, for whatever reason, gave us a bottom floor unit. 3. related to #2, noise from upstairs was not bad but definitely hearable.4. Windows were so dirty.5. There were no utensils available for grilling so had to use a regular fork.6. the hot tub was freezing cold.7. the out door gas fireplace did not work

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: No view of the Red Rock Canyons at all.  No view of anything just the parking lot and other buildings Unit needs a good “spring” cleaning furniture is placed in odd position in the living room hard for three people to sit on it and see the tv.  Disappointed because we are Vacation Village Owner elsewhere.

reviews.title: Staff rude and uncaring.
reviews.text: Staff was rude and uncaring at both check in and checkout . We were told that taking trash out of unit was our responsibility after paying extra cleaning fee. Trash dumpsters were not shown on the map and hard to locate.We left 3 days early out of boredom.

reviews.title: very quiet and relex
reviews.text: Very convenient location for us to get to Spring mountain road restaurant and shoppingOff from casino made us complete rest.  Swimming pool was under the construction.Designated parking lot was very clean and convenient for us and guest.

reviews.title: Good quiet  location if you want to stay off the Strip and see other places
reviews.text: We spent three days visiting the Las Vegas Strip or Fremont Street, and three days driving to Lake Mead/Hoover Dam, Red Rock Canyon, and Mt Charleston area. Saved a lot of money eating most meals at the Condo, including grilling steak and hamburgers outside.Unit had a washer/dryer. Did not use most of the resort amenities. The pool was closed for maintenance, so it lost a star.

reviews.title: Not on the strip!
reviews.text: Looking for a get away with a lot to offer? Hike at Red Rock, Many Golf coursed to choose from, Excellent shopping and restaurants' in the area. Even had one of the best facials at a local Spa. Hue Spa. And of course the Red Rock Casino is very close.  Our room was Great lots of room. The TV remote's were a bit hard to work, Beds a bit hard...but those are the only complaints!  The pool was closed, so could not enjoy that.

reviews.title: I Own Here - Still Wonder About the Value Proposition
reviews.text: The staff do (I think) care about your satisfaction with your unit and the property. I'm trying to temper my less-than-stellar feelings from this trip by blaming it on the COVID-related impacts. It's just hard to reconcile getting off a Southwest flight where there was not a single empty seat (March 6, 2021), then being told that the pool table is off limits (mind you, I brought my own cue sticks, and offered to sanitize the balls under their supervision) - but nothing doing.I thought the staff were responsive with the issue(s) I had with the washer in the unit - but I got the impression that they went out of their way to purchase the lowest quality laundry equipment there is.I love the location of the property and the fact that it's away from the Strip.

reviews.title: Not the same as they used to be
reviews.text: I have always loved the Cliffs before but the last few visits have been disappointing. There doesn’t seem to be the same respect for patrons with regards to maintenance because of the fact that you have to completely vacate the individual timeshare before maintenance will come in which means you can’t even point out what’s wrong. I believe it was just an excuse to get out of it. The other time don’t have the same policy.

reviews.title: Great Family size room
reviews.text: Had a great time using Vegas as a Centralized vacation spot for our hiking vacation. We first hiked Red Rock Canyon Nat Park for two days, then went Zion Nat Park & stayed for 3 days, two nights in Zion. While coming back to Vegas, we hike Pioneer Canyon in St George Utah. We walked the Vegas strip on the last day, which was the worst experience, since the strip has gone down to be a total Ghetto zone with plenty of Homeless & pot-smoking Thugs lined along the sidewalks. We only wanted to hit the M&M store, then leave. It's as bad as L.A. Aside from that, the trip was great!

reviews.title: Good price, subpar resort.
reviews.text: Currently staying at this establishment.  PROS:Very spaciousLocated in quite and clean communityCost Family friendlyKitchenSemi modern furnitureHigh ceilingsCONS:Broken dishwasherDirty pull out bedsDirty wallsDirty cabinetsDustyBroken pool chairs ( I almost fell through a broken pool chair)Not all the burners on the gas grills properly functioningOutdated TV (No modern HDMI/smart TV)Missing amenities (Check for pool before reserving) (pool down for maintenance**Lack of attention to detailConclusion:**Might** give this property another chance, but right now it's not looking like that.  The price was good, space was good, but overall care and condition of the room and property was not 4 star quality.  Has 4 star potential with the right management.

reviews.title: Outstanding Golf and Relaxing Experience
reviews.text: My party of eight golfers that utilized Units 1073,74, & 76 from February 20th -27th were extremely pleased with the accommodations and service provided by your resort.The pre arrival support and information provided by their Assistant Manager was extremely helpful and sincerely appreciated.  RCI (Vacation Village) should be very proud having this resort as one of your member resorts.

reviews.title: Quiet Place Away From The Strip
reviews.text: We had to use our RCI points or lose them. This was our first stay here. We loved how quiet it was and close to great restaurants and shopping. Our one bedroom was spacious, clean, and comfortable. Our only complaint is that the gentleman who checked us in wasn't particularly friendly or easy to understand.

reviews.title: Skip This One
reviews.text: Unless you desire the westside, out of the way location, skip this one. Much better choices in Vegas elsewhere. Positives -- nice pool and gym, clean rooms. Negatives -- poor front desk personnel, most rooms overlook parking areas. Appears to be a converted apartment complex.

reviews.title: SO SO
reviews.text: The unit we were in was very out dated and had no view at all, only the parking lot.  Did not use patio because it felt like we were sitting in the parking lot we had a wonderful view of the garbage bins and all the parked cars plus all the maintenance garages with workers coming and going.

reviews.title: Great week touring Vegas area
reviews.text: We spent the week touring outdoor areas near LasVegas and managed to not go in one casino we were so busy.  Red Rock Park was a lovely spot for hiking but really enjoyed the Valley of the Fire Park for red rock viewing.  The railroad tunnels gave a perfect view of Lake Mead and also opportunity for hike to the Hoover Dam.  The wildlife refuge nearby was also a surprise with many birds, ducks etc enjoying the streams.  The resort was in a great location for exploring as it was close to parks and freeway.

reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.text: We styled the first week of Feb.  the kids loved the heated pool.  A lot was closed because of COVID but we still had a great time.  The cliffs at peace canyon was clean with large rooms.  Shopping and restaurants were near by.  The strip is just a couple miles down flamingo. The beds were a little hard but I like mine soft.

reviews.title: average
reviews.text: everything was good. unit has no full length mirror, made it hard to dress and not know how you look like. and the bed wasn't comfortable. The full size bed should of been a queen bed. my friend fell off the bed bc it was too small.

reviews.title: Dental Vacation
reviews.text: The cliffs were very quite place away from the strip and traffic was not a issue at all being that it was around 7 miles from strip, pool was alittle small but very clean staff was friendly and the grounds were very clean

reviews.title: Quiet and not far from the action
reviews.text: The Cliffs was nice and clean. Very quiet. I'm sure Covid made it more quiet. The location wasn't bad. Red Rock Casino was 10 minutes away. The Strip is 20-30 min away depending on how you went and what time. Lots of restaurants and shopping near by. Good area of town. The pool and workout facitily looked nice alothough we did not use. Nice large unit. Overall happy with our stay.

reviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: We went on a Father & son golf outing for a week. The 2 bedroom/2 bath apartment was exactly what we needed. Golf courses were less than 15 minutes away and fantastic courses to play. Numerous restaurants within minutes of the apartment. Very nice area of Las Vegas probably 20 minutes from the Strip. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.title: Unpleasant experience while staying at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: have a list of "must haves" with you when you check into an RCI unit and you will have a much pleasant experience then we had.  In the RCI book it states the condo had WIFI, it did, just not the building they assigned us to. It took us 3 days of complaining to finally be told that our building did not have WIFI working and had to move to a second floor unit in another building to get WIFI.   We were not happy seniors.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Definitely will be back -great property for quiet stay.. Did day trips out to the natural scenery so with that and covid didn't use a lot of amenities. At the 14 day ahead of stay point very helpful in pre-selecting a unit.

reviews.title: Stay at the Cliffs at Peac Canyon
reviews.text: We stayed at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon in Las Vegas second time in a few years. We liked it the first time already and the second time was also as enjoyable and satisfying as the first one. They have taken good recautions to protect again Covid and are following all all protocols. The init was ckean and comfortable and staff was very helpful.

reviews.title: Lovely Condo and Quiet
reviews.text: We wanted a getaway but with limited exposure to people. This condo really worked out. The rooms are nice and it has a big walkin closet, bedroom, kitchen, dining room area, balcony and living room. It also has washer dryers and a dishwasher. The pool area was nice. We used the bbq area to cook one of our meals. It is very quiet and the front desk staff were very accomodating. We didn't go to the strip or downtown Vegas, but the freeways seemed very easy to get to and quick if you wanted to do that. It is close to Red Rock Canyon, which is gorgeous.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: The condo is excellently laid out great with guest rooms on either side of the living space. the shuttle bus drivers were always on time and very pleasant to talk to.  do note that there was not any amenities within walking distance

reviews.title: great place to stay
reviews.text: excellent accomodations; comfortable furniture; full kitchen and washer/dryer.  Huge walk in closet in master for storing luggage etc. Heated swimming pool great for chilly days. Missed using the activity center which was closed due to COVID.

reviews.title: great and quiet place
reviews.text: Nice place and if you want quietness, this is the place . it is close by to red rock canyon and flying club. Staff was great . the only thing due to the pandemic the jacuzzi was not open. but the pool was and that was a plus

reviews.title: Meets expectations
reviews.text: A very well maintained condo complex with the standard amenities. Location is convenient to shopping and freeways.Clean, quiet, nice sized apartments, comfortably furnished. Sometimes noisy neighbors above, (tile floors), so ask for second floor.

reviews.title: Lives up to it's name
reviews.text: This is a few miles away from the Las Vegas strip hubbub but shuttles are available.  This is the second time here.  Despite the COVID restrictions, we felt comfortable as the units are clean, comfortable, and easily accessible.  It was very quiet.  Stores and food places are within short driving distance.  Found Dim Sum Cafe with excellent dim sum.  The scenery is beautiful and overall relaxing.

reviews.title: Jewell of a Place to Stay in the South Summerlin Area
reviews.text: Great location in South Summerlin or South Las Vegas in Proximity to Summerlin, Red Rock Canyon National Forest, and even the Strip in a short 15 minute drive. Accommodating Staff, updated furniture and well maintained 'Gold Crown Resort". Have stayed at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon for Thanksgiving Week for the last 5 years.

reviews.title: Very Nice Staycation
reviews.text: The rooms were very nice, large and clean but in need of updating. Staff was very polite and helpful. The resort is located in a very nice area with lots of new homes, shopping, markets and a large casino nearby.

reviews.title: Poor customer service. Awesome site.
reviews.text: The location is near nature and the strip. Customer service needs improvement. the rooms don't have enough supplies like toilet paper and wash soap. Everyday you need to call for stuff. Not good. Sucks.

reviews.title: COIVD19 vacation to Vegas
reviews.text: During this unusual time, we were very pleased with the courtesy and professional staff at the Cliffs. Protocol was observed, and the units were in great shape with updated appliances and décor. We will definitely book this resort on a return trip to Vegas.

reviews.title: Awesome vacay
reviews.text: it was very nice resort very clean and inviting very quiet and the room was very cozy, the staff was very frindly definetly would stay again. I would recommend to friends and family. it doesnt even feel you are in the city. I loved it  thank you so much !!!!!!! I was there in June 7, 2019 thru the 10th

reviews.title: Hiking out west
reviews.text: We used this resort as our base to hike 9 parks in Nevada, Utah, and California. Location was good and we didn't have any issues. On our free time we went into Las Vegas to check it out. Not a lot of things open yet, but we still had a good time seeing the sights that were open.

reviews.title: Tranquil Retreat in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This was our 2nd week in Las Vegas- the first at our resort the Grandview. I always wanted to go to the Cliffs at Peace Canyon and we are so glad we did. It is not near the Strip but there was easy access to Red Rocks Canyon and Lake Mead for us. We had a few minor issues but they were taken care of promptly. I liked the warm swimming pool. The room was spacious, a lounging couch, large tv, great kitchen and the bed was comfy. Overall we enjoyed our stay there and would go again!

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Went to Nevada to visit the Parks there , not the Strip. The resort was in an excellent location to getting out into the environs, yet within the city for access to food stores, gas stations, etc. The unit was spacious  and the facilities were good although many were shut because of the virus.

reviews.title: Nice Place to Stay but away from the action
reviews.text: Nice quiet surroundings. But you will have to travel a bit to get to the Vegas action. Units are nice size. Covered parking is a nice extra.Property is in a neighborhood setting. Units don't a view. You will need a car to get around.

reviews.title: Great resort and very comfortable
reviews.text: Great place to have a great and quiet vacation and space great pool warm yacuzzi. At great place to visit even doh its a little far from the strip but very worthy. Will keep coming back to this place to enjoy

reviews.title: Poorly maintained and dirty unit
reviews.text: The unit was not maintained to our standards.  The unit was not clean.  The bathroom was dirty, shower curtain broken, the window screen broken, cob webs and dust everywhere, floor was flithy (went bare foot after showing and my feet were black after 1 hour walking around on the floors), the dishwasher was rusty and missing the prongs to hold up the dishes.  The units do not have elevators and we were given a 2nd floor unit which made it difficult to navigate as seniors with physical limitations.

reviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: This place was fantastic!  We had a two bedroom, two bath unit that was extremely clean when we got there and had all the amenities that we had asked for.  What a pleasant surprise to find a washer/dryer within the unit.  The area was very nice without too much traffic on the street.  The pool and the BBQ near the pool were also a plus.  Definitely a place that we will go back to!!!

reviews.title: Peaceful, clean & quiet.
reviews.text: Nice place, clean, quiet, close to everything. Nice grilling area, lots of people were enjoying it in the evenings. Did not use the gym but it looked nice.  Loved the pool area and the waterfalls into the pool.

reviews.title: 1st time visit- not last
reviews.text: CURRENTLY STILL CHECKED IN- We had a 3night stay at another resort on check out day we got a little crazy and decided to stay another night at least. (at the original resort, but was booked solid) We called RCI and they recommended this place since we do have kids this time around. Only way to stay here is on a 3 nt minimum so we booked. looked through reviews and got worried. Realizing the reviews were old we gave it a try. Gotta say our room is clean well stocked. Not outdated. Washer and dryer in every room is a plus. And since our original plan was for 3 nts and not 6 I did 2 loads of laundry :) to cover us. pool area is nice. Not the biggest pool but it’s very quiet and not many people at all. BBQ area is clean and again lonely we had hamburgers and hotdogs last night. overall grounds are quiet. I didn’t see anything dirty or rundown. I did see remodeling of another villa- probably those outdated ones on other reviews. fitness room is clean and there is an ice machine and vending machine inside. 20 min from strip and there is plenty of stores and places to eat nearby but not within walking distance. Bottom line we were happy with our stay and will be booking here from now on when we travel to LV with our kids. We like to keep them away from the hustle and bustle of the strip.

reviews.title: Relaxing  Getaway
reviews.text: I love this spot. I have booked it several times and will continue to book it whenever we go to Vegas. It is away from the strip chaos and commotion, and just peaceful. The hot tub was not opened due to COVID restrictions, but the pool was. The grills made cooking easy, and staff are always friendly. The WI-FI is much improved over my last stay in 2018. There are not a bunch of kids running around. This is not the family resort, this is the older adults want to chill resort; which is why I go there. Rent a car and go hiking or site seeing. There is so much more to Vegas the gambling and strip activities. They make it affordable by being able to cook your meals and save money, or you have restaurant after restaurant options too. We will be back soon. Get a 2nd floor room for the quiet, the floors are thin, and when you are on the 1st floor, you can hear the folks upstairs walking, and such.

reviews.title: Great little spot away from the Strip
reviews.text: After being surprised for my 30th with two weeks in Vegas, I was a little gutted to learn we wasn't staying on the strip. However, this place was really good. There was a shuttle bus to and from the strip hourly, also if you wanted to do shopping at the local supermarket they would pick you up on the way back. The room was nice and clean, the pool area and jacuzzi was spot on and also a basic gym to use. The staff were friendly, especially Rocky and Steve the shuttle bus drivers. Wouldn't hesitate to go back and stay again

reviews.title: Beautiful location
reviews.text: This location was about 20 min away from the strip. However it was very worth it. There scenery was beautiful being so close to the mountains. The 2 bedroom we had was very spacious and nice! I'd definitely recommend this resort for families!

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: This is a nice place to stay, much more room than a hotel.  The "family room" area is large and enough space to spread out and relax.  Our room was very clean. The furnishings are modern.  The beds were comfortable and the air conditioner rocked!  The bathroom was large.  Parking was easy. It is in a upscale neighborhood,  Lots of stores and restaurants very close by (i.e. 1/2 mile).  Traffic is light in the area. Wifi worked well.  We will be back next time we are in Vegas.

reviews.title: Except For
reviews.text: My Unit, 1031, had hot water problems, which was fixed, but this unit had Internet problems that were never really resolved even though the router was reset. Informing Management was a waste of time. One lady, Nathalia, blamed my laptop even after being serviced by the Internet Service people who concluded that my unit reception was the problem. If you are given unit 1031 request another unit.

reviews.title: Great Quiet Resort
reviews.text: Great resort, away from the glitz and noise of the strip.  We booked this trip to go bike riding in the mountains and canyons around Vegas.  We didn't want to carry our bikes up stairs so they gave us a ground floor unit as we requested.  We plan to go back again.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Love the place and would say to take BBQ  food because they have grills by the pools. Excellent spot.  The stores are not far and the strip is not also far from this location. Convenient and well kept up. Thank you

reviews.title: Cirque
reviews.text: Stayed for the week so we could see a new Cirque du Soliel.  We traveled around to places like Oatman AZ.  The unit was great but too cold to use the pool.  Was a good location off the strip but close enough

reviews.title: Nice Stay Away from the Strip
reviews.text: Good location away from the Strip with many good restaurant options and stores within a mile radius. The resort itself has a nice pool and jacuzzi, other than that, however, there isn't much to do on the premises. It's a residential area so not much to walk around; not a problem though if you have a car.

reviews.title: It's an Apartment complex
reviews.text: The pictures of this "resort" are misleading. The game room was closed so we have no idea what was in there. We shldve been able to sched a time for the kids to play. The pool is very small. It wasn't a resort, it was an apt complex, literally. The unit seemed small. The carpet was so dirty it made the bottom of our feet dirty. We had to wear shoes inside. The beds hurt our backs. The lamps, kitchen counters and cabinets were old and outdated. There were dust bunnies on the walls. My home shouldn't be nicer than my vacation spot.

reviews.title: Peace Canyon - Las Vegas
reviews.text: Site met expectations.  Nicely located with many restaurants and activities. Pleased with the staff and functionality of the unit.  The unit was large and had a TV in each room.  The showers and closets were large.

reviews.title: If it seems nice, do it twice.
reviews.text: This is the second time we've stayed at this resort.  It's a great location. It's clean and quiet.  It's not fancy, but it suits our needs.  The staff are very friendly and welcoming.Hmm.  I can't complete this review until I get to 200 words, but I've already said everything I wanted to say.  What else?  Well, it's near lots of stuff, but off the strip.  You'll want to have a car, but you don't 100% need one, because there's a shuttle to & from the Strip.If you're going to Vegas to be ON the strip, this is not the right place for you.  If you're going to have a fun, relaxing experience, in a place that's about 10 minutes from Red Rock Casino (also pretty laid back and fun) and 15 from The Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area, this more your groove.

reviews.title: Great place off the strip
reviews.text: For travellers that enjoy the Las Vegas excitement but want to get away from the strip at night this is a great place to stay. The units are very clean and roomy. They offer a convenient shuttle service to nearby casino, shopping and the strip or Fremont St.

reviews.title: not restful if you want peace, quiet and heat in the unit.
reviews.text: helicopter sounding furnace that needed to be turned off  in February if you want peace and quiet to sleep.   Nice shower in the morning if you like only tepid water in the master bath.  Our unit could hear all late night traffic for the late check in guest.

reviews.title: Great place to land after hiking Red Rocks Canyon
reviews.text: We didn't go to Vegas to gamble. We went to hike. This resort was comfortable and not far from the canyon (15 minute drive). There wasn't much to do at the resort itself; they don't have a restaurant, the fitness room was very small with no weights, and the activity room was a joke. However, there were a lot of options for healthy eating close by. So other than hiking and eating, there wasn't much to do. You can shop and gamble but we didn't go for that.

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: Perfect location, 20 minutes from the strip and 20 minutes from Red Rock Canyon. They have a shuttle available to take you to the strip and even to the grocery store. We had a very spacious two bedroom unit with a full kitchen and it was perfect for two adults and two kids. They have a Rec room with movie nights, air hockey, table tennis etc. The pool was heated which was nice in February the kids didn't mind it was only 60* outside. I was very happy with our stay.

reviews.title: Location was good
reviews.text: Location was away from the strip.  I think it was 25 minutes.  Not bad. Just a little closer would have been great.  Otherwise, the resort was what we were looking for.....spacious units, quiet, away from the crowd.  Near Red Rock Casino (I think 8 minutes).  We did not use the facilities much, since this was a business trip and we were out of the unit most of the time.  I would come back.

reviews.title: great place to stay
reviews.text: We have stayed at this resort several times.It is a good resort in a great location. Very easy access to 215 freeway with easy access to I15 and The Strip, Red Rock resort and casino, golf courses and restaurants.

reviews.title: Far from most things.
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort. Our unit was very nice, updated and had all the amenities.  We asked for a ground floor and they were very receptive to our wishes.  It is a very tranquil and quiet resort.  If this is what you are looking for this resort is for you.  However, it is not close to anything.  It is quite a jaunt to the nearest market or restaurant. If you have a vehicle it is no problem.  They do have a shuttle to the strip and downtown.  I would recommend it if  you are traveling in a vehicle.

reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: One of the best resorts I've been to. Unit was so comfortable I could actually live there permanently. Spacious, private. Everything was there for what we needed. Located centrally around everywhere, but far enough away from the strip. Wonderful place.

reviews.title: Great place to relax
reviews.text: This is a great resort off the strip, but with a good transportation to and from the strip.  Very clean and well maintained.  Nice staff friendly and helpful.  All equipment, like the pool, work out room, out door grills,  etc were very well maintained.

reviews.title: Okay, but not great
reviews.text: Lobby, pool, public areas were very nice.  Unit was clean and beds were comfortable, but living room furniture was hard and uncomfortable and decor outdated.  Most of the staff was very courteous and accommodating, but we also interacted quite a bit with a gal at the front desk who seemed like we were an inconvenience to her when we called.  Even got our shuttle reservation wrong so we ended up having to get an Uber back from the Strip.  Over all, the place was fine. It was nice to be off the Strip and not in a high rise.  They have free parking and the amenities fee isn't high. The mid-week towel exchange was nice, and housekeeping was generous with supplies.

reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: Daniel, CJ, Ken S., Ken, Richard, Tatiana, Alicia and every staff member I experienced was absolutely wonderful!  The resort was clean and secure.  The staff was incredibly gracious in every way!  I can't image staying anywhere else when I am in town!  I felt very welcome and taken care of!

reviews.title: cliffs at peace canyon
reviews.text: Very clean, shuttle was easy and convient, did not need to rent a car if you are going to the strip. If you want to do other locations you would need a car. Staff was friendly and helpful. Shuttle will take you to the strip, walmart, and the grocery store. Not many places to eat withing walking distance, so you have to eat on the strip or buy groceries to eat in your unit. About a 30 min. ride from the strip.

reviews.title: Spacious comfortable rooms
reviews.text: We stayed for four nights.  Had a one bedroom suite that was dated but very comfortable.  Room was very clean and very quiet.  We didn't use the pool or any of the other amenities but did enjoy the wifi and the morning coffee.  Since there is no service for short stays, another towel rack or two would have been nice.

reviews.title: Quiet and Spacious
reviews.text: We wanted a quiet place away from the Las Vegas strip and this place met our requirements very well.  The location provided easy access to a lot of places.  The unit was spacious and clean. There was free shuttles for going to the strip.  It worked out well for us.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: This is a awesome vacation place for the whole family. Everything was very clean. Staff very helpful. There is a lot of room.  We would love to stay there again. The Cliff s At Peace Canyon is worth every penny.

reviews.title: Great Location and View
reviews.text: Easy check in and great facility.  Quick access to freeway.  Units have gas fireplace in the living room and great view of the pool.  Will stay at this facility again when I am back for the next trade show.

reviews.title: Quiet and clean apartments
reviews.text: We stayed two nights during the middle of the week, and we had a lovely stay. Everyone I spoke to at the front desk was very helpful, though to be honest we barely spoke to anybody the whole stay. We stayed in two apartments, one above the other. Ground floor was a 2 br, 2 bath apt and the upper floor was 1 br, 1 bath. Both had almost identical kitchens/dining rooms/living rooms and were very spacious. King size beds were comfortable.We used the gym, pool and hot tub which were all small but very nice. We also rented two DVDs (complimentary) from the front desk, which was very nice.
