We had a rental car, which allowed us to easily drive to plenty of shops and restaurants (basically everything you could need is within 2 blocks). We paid slightly less here than we would have paid at a hotel nearby, and we had way more space. I'd definitely consider staying here again if I return to Vegas, and I'd recommend this place for families looking to stay on the westside.

reviews.title: Great getaway
reviews.text: Super fantastic experience from check in to check out and everything in between. Staff was friendly, courteous and helpful. They were able to accommodate my request on room location. Shuttle service was a good plus. Pool/Jacuzzi was clean and uncrowded.

reviews.title: Definately not gold star
reviews.text: Outdated, not particularly clean, and a bit stinky.  Much better timeshares to stay at in Vegas.  We have stayed at 4 or 5 other resorts,  The Cliffs was the worst.  Nice folks, not a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Apartment Living
reviews.text: No view and small toilets. It's more of an apartment style living.  Although the back of the property was very nice.  Addditionally, their business center only allowed you use of their computers for approximately fifteen minutes when they would then shut off; not good.

reviews.title: Great location off the strip!
reviews.text: Dated but nice place, short drive to all the action, but out of the way in a quiet neighborhood.  I would definitely recommend this place for the large units, friendly staff, and location if you don’t want to be right on the strip.  Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Scammy establishment
reviews.text: Stay away from this one if you put your deposit on a debit card they know you can’t dispute it so they charge you $150 and tell you it was “your responsibility to clean the room”. Unbelievable. I stayed 9 nights the room itself was descent except for the traffic noise keeps you up late and gets you up early. Also they hang a flyer on your door every couple days to tell you you’ve won something and if you go to collect from the main desk they try to sell you something. Don’t stay here.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: We were 100 percent pleased with this resort.  We had an assigned parking space and carport.  The unit was large, comfortable, well-equipped, and had everything we needed.  It was quiet and off the strip but easily accessible to the strip and downtown.

reviews.title: GREAT POOL, HOT TUB,  SHUTTLE AND LOCATION.
reviews.text: Would definitely recommend this place.  Pool and hot tub were within walking distance of every unit, pool was warm enough and hot tub perfect.   HOWEVER Don't go to timeshare spiel... it took a LOT of our time.    Flaming Fajitas Restaurant was excellent  and is right down the street.    Shuttle great convenience

reviews.title: Nice Property away from The Strip
reviews.text: The resort was clean, quiet and the staff were friendly and helpful. It is conveniently located near many shops and restaurants. I recommend having a vehicle to get around  although they do offer a free shuttle to and from the strip. The 2 bedroom condo unit we had was spacious and equipped with anything  you need for a week or more. The grounds were well maintained, including the saltwater pool and hot tub. I would not hesitate to stay there again.

reviews.title: Disappointed Vacation
reviews.text: Arrived approx 10pm at resort, 2 Associates at work, one with existing customer, the other not. Neither acknowledge my presence. I stood there 15 minutes or more as one with furniture while there was conversation with 4 other people while I waited. Once I was engaged, there was no personalization, no thank you for waiting, but a very impersonal clinical brush over and a breakfast sales job before hardening me the keys to the living area.

reviews.title: JD Review Cliffs at Peace Canyon resort
reviews.text: Very convenient location where the resort offers back and forth shuttle service to the Vegas Strip all day long. The location is also close to shopping mall areas. Would highly recommend resort to stay for families the resort is very clean with heated pool and hot tub.

reviews.title: Very Comfortable
reviews.text: Great location near freeway entrance. Pool area well maintained and inviting. Game building a good option for the families with kids. Nice sized two bedroom condo. Decent living/dining room. Washer/Dryer came in handy.

reviews.title: Just average
reviews.text: The 2 bedroom unit that we had is poorly designed. The hating/AC unit is at one end of a long unit, so that the bedroom nearest it gets the cooling or heating (along with all of the noise) while the unit at the other end does not. The appliances, TV's and everything else was okay, but people in lower units have to put up with noise from the unit upstairs (sometimes well past 11pm). The steps in the pool felt slimy and were definitely very slippery, which could result in a serious fall.

reviews.title: Convenient and peaceful place
reviews.text: Very well maintained property located in the quieter section of the city. Shuttle service to the Strip. Staff is friendly and very helpful. Pool is beautiful and clean. Gym is also available and clean. My family and I enjoyed our stay and will go back.

reviews.title: Beautiful reort
reviews.text: Rooms were very spacious and clean.  Amenities at resort are great.  Immediate resolution of issue we had.  (The toaster was broke)  The staff was pleasant and friendly.  The only problem we had was they didn't tell us we needed to schedule a return trip on shuttle to Las Vegas Strip. (They should have disclosed this to us when making reservation for shuttle.)

reviews.title: Quite and Peaceful
reviews.text: Service, from check in to check out was excellent.  Every staff member of The Cliffs acknowledged you whenever you came anywhere near them.  Our unit was a one bedroom which was large and more than expected.  Kitchen could easily accommodate two, the walk in closet was huge and the living/dining area spacious.  Everything was very clean including the pool and BBQ area was awesome.  Outdoor fireplace provided a great place to sit, relax and read.  We did experience problems with hot water in our unit but it was promptly addressed and repaired.  Shuttle service into the strip was always on time.  Well stocked with paper towels etc.  Full size washer and dryer available which was great as our next week was Orlando and we were able to arrive there with clean clothes. Would definitely return on next trip to Vegas as it is a nice quiet getaway from the strip.  Thanks to all the staff of The Cliffs.  They personify customer service.

reviews.title: Watch out for the sales pitch.
reviews.text: My partner did not attend the breakfast "update" (sales pitch) so the breakfast was cancelled and the refundable fee was not returned, This nickel and dimeing was uncharacteristically cheap and underhanded considering that evrything else about the resort was excellent.

reviews.title: Great place to relax
reviews.text: A great place to relax.  Out of the hustle and bussel of downtown, but close to shopping and restaurants.  Also close to Red Rock Canyon.  We also used this a a base to visit local ghost towns and other scenic places.

reviews.title: Las Vegas getaway.
reviews.text: A rental car was a good decision on this trip. Although the other guest who was up all night partying an playing loud music wasn't addressed by Resort staff until I called was the turning point for a poor trip due to not able to sleep.  Although it was addressed the tenants started up the loud music at 8am.  Glad this was the later part of our stay.

reviews.title: Cozy & Clean
reviews.text: I was very pleased with this location, although it was a distance from the strip, but the shuttle was accessible, & I wanted to see other attractions. The parking was convenient to the entrance of the unit. An outside porch to enjoy a cup of coffee in the morning, with the view of the parking spaces.  The pool was attractive & at night there was an outdoor fireplace nearby. A trip to Valley of Fire State Park was amazing. Highly recommend this scenic drive.

reviews.title: Did not meet my expectations
reviews.text: Checked in a Non-smoking rooms smelled like cigarette stench when you walked in. Chip paint throughout the room.Furniture was dated. Need to upgrade the rooms. Did not meet my expectations as a gold crown resort.

reviews.title: A Week at The Cliffs
reviews.text: The resort staff was very friendly and accommodating from the moment we arrived.  They were able to meet our specific needs while making us feel as though we had returned home for a weekend visit with old friends.

reviews.title: Great vacation!
reviews.text: The Cliffs Resort is well located and up to date. Our condo was clean and spacious!The amenities were also very nice. A shuttle to the strip, grocery stores, Walmart and other locations was always on time and safely operated. We were checked in by the Resort Manager, Daniel, he was very friendly and obviously took pride in his property. We will be back when we return to Los Vegas.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Everything was first class! Would recommended The Cliffs at Peace Canyon for a stay in Las vegas area! Unit was large and everyone was very helpful. The pool, exercise room and grounds were perfect. Loved the free coffee from 5-11 pm.

reviews.title: Las Veges low key
reviews.text: Great location outside of the city away from the made house but only 20 min away if you want it the resort offers a shuttle to the city so we never had to drive in and park parking is expensive and vary from where you park to valet service.

reviews.title: Vegas Vacation/ USTA Tournament
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon was in the perfect location for us.  Easy access to the Darling Tennis Center and has a 15 minute entertaining shuttle service to the strip.The Cliffs are also located in walking distance to stores and restaurants.  This resort is well maintained by a friendly and helpful staff.

reviews.title: Off the busy strip
reviews.text: Lovely, clean resort 20 minutes off the strip.  Great shuttles every hour were more than an efficient way to get to the busy strip.  We rented a car and enjoyed having it to see the Valley of Fire and Red Rock canyon.

reviews.title: Nice condo and resort.
reviews.text: I used points with RCI to book this 2-bedroom unit.  It's very roomy and comfortable.  The pool area looks very nice, but I haven't used these amenities yet.  It's a little breezy and chilly in Vegas today.  I would stay here again, but I'm a litttle disappointed in the cleanliness of the condo.  There was something fuzzy in the master bathroom toilet, everything is a little dusty and there is something yucky under the shower faucet.  The parking is weird.  The location of the assigned parking spaces just doesn't make any sense.

reviews.title: Not Gold Crown status but very nice
reviews.text: If you don't want to stay on the strip and hassle with the traffic and people, this is an excellent choice. If you have a car, it is only 20 minutes away from the strip or Fremont St. The resort does provide a shuttle which is convenient otherwise. The pool area is very nice. The rooms are clean and more than adequate. Would stay there again. I would not say that the rooms are exceptional, so not sure what is used to qualify a resort as Gold Crown. Was expecting more.

reviews.title: Nice resort away from the noise of the entertainment Las Vagas Strip
reviews.text: The Cliffs was well Maintained. Jet noise from the nearby airport was the only minor issue at night and n the early Morning. Driving out of the resort Grand Canyon was dangerious due to the Brush on the left lookin South. Perhaps you can cut back the plant for better vision to avoid potentual car or truck collision.

reviews.title: Peaceful Resoty
reviews.text: This resort is just so welcoming from the time you arrive till you leave.  Staff are so helpful and rooms are comfortable and spacious.  Easy access with parking at the unit and balcony for lovely fresh air.  Pool is clean and in comfortable surrounds.  It is peaceful but still so close to stores and the strip.

reviews.title: Beautiful Resore
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort.  For the most part, very well maintained and appointed.  The only negative would be badly scratched kitchen cabinets.  Otherwise, any small issues were immediately taken care of, the shuttle to the Strip was great, the staff was friendly and helpful.  The linens were good quality (something I value in resorts where we stay.)  Our first floor unit was somewhat noisy when people moved in above us, not voices or TV, just walking back and forth.  The pool looked beautiful, unfortunately we were too busy to enjoy it.

reviews.title: Peace in the City
reviews.text: Very nice resort located 15 minutes from the Strip.  Very quiet neighborhood.  Close to all types of retail and service stores.  Good access to the freeway system.  Has covered reserved parking places for each condo.   Staff is very friendly and professional.  Well kept grounds and buildings.

reviews.title: Our stay at Cliffs In October, 2019
reviews.text: This was one of the most enjoyable vacations we have experienced, both educational and entertaining.  The location to the Strip was perfect (several miles away); The location to restaurants were fairly close as well (Bone Fish and Carrabus were our favorites).  The heated pool was refreshing and the area was very clean as well as the entire resort..  Looking forward to October, 2020 for another visit.

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Quite location and excellent shuttle service to the strip. Great staff and very clean place to stay. Everything you would need is nearby and we would stay there again in the future. Thanks for the great stay.

reviews.title: Nice and quiet
reviews.text: The staff was super friendly and the place itself is pretty clean and calm.The room was very spacious and had all the necessary appliances.Swimming pool could be cleaned more often but otherwise it was fine.

reviews.title: LV Vacation
reviews.text: Check in staff, Richard and Manager, Daniel were excellent, extremely helpful and accommodating.Provided near by restaurant recommendations, which were very good and reasonably priced. We enjoyed the pool and comfortable two bedroom suite.It was a great getaway for us, our daughter, son in law and 3 year old grandson.

reviews.title: Beauty in the southwest
reviews.text: We traveled with two couples for a week. We had a two bedroom condo that worked out fantastic for us. We rented a car to venture on day trips: Grand Canyon, Red Rock, Mead Lake Cruise, Hoover Dam, old Railroad walk, Fremont Street, The Las Vegas strip, Lone mountain, Top golf, visited friends, and relaxed at the pool. This location is awesome! You don’t NEED a car if you are wanting to relax and go to the strip, Fremont Street, shopping etc as the resort has a shuttle and The Duece bus can get you where you want to go for $8.00 daily (hop on / hop off for 24 hours)... there is a stop around the corner. The cliffs at Peace Canyon is clean, staff very friendly, beds are comfortable, quiet location, easy access, close to many restaurants and shops... we WILL be back!

reviews.title: Peace and quiet
reviews.text: The Cliffs is situated far enough away from the hustle and bustle of the strip so that you can have a nice and quiet relaxing time, but close enough should you want a bit of excitement. However this only works if you have a rental vehicle. The resort has a shuttle service that is very good but then you are tied to a timetable. There are plenty of stores and restaurants around the resort to accommodate all your basic needs. This third time visiting the Cliffs, but not our last.

reviews.title: Annual Visit
reviews.text: Still one of my favorite places. Customer service was less than what was provided over the years though. Some seem to need a little hospitality training especially in this city. Coffee in the morning was always empty by the time we were at the main office for the morning stroll. Hope it gets better with reviews on customer service. Update the gym! It needs a makeover of cardio and strength training equipment!!

reviews.title: Love The Cliff's At Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Love our little getaway so much to do so many places to go ~ For a City that never sleeps this place takes you away from all the lights but not so far that you can't go play ~ The sky's the limit FUN!

reviews.title: Two Week Stay at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon.
reviews.text: This facility is close to a lot of good golf courses.  The Red rock Casino and several other casinos are within minutes of this facility.   I found that  The Cliffs was in a quiet neighborhood and it was very peaceful.   This is the third time that I have stayed here and I will do so again.   One id not bothered by all the noise and traffic that we see when one is close to The Strip.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: Had everything we needed! Comfortable stay. We had one maintenance issue and it was resolved very quickly perfectly. The room was very comfortable and had everything we needed. I would recommend this to my friends and family.

reviews.title: Great Spot Away from Strip
reviews.text: Excellent place to stay if you'd like to experience all that Vegas has to offer, and then retreat away from the chaos of the strip to a quiet area of the city.  We enjoyed the resort for that very reason...a clean and large 2 bedroom un it that was close enough to downtown, yet far enough away!

reviews.title: Quiet in Vegas?
reviews.text: Nice place to stay, away from the strip.  Unit was nice and reasonably well equipped.  Pool was very, very nice.  We spent a lot of time there.  You will enjoy your time there more if you have a vehicle.  The place was quiet and close to lots of grocery stores, restaurants, drug stores, etc.

reviews.title: Worth the trade
reviews.text: Could have done a better job keeping the pool and hot tub clean. They never vacuumed the pool or spa after the wind storm on the first day we got there. So there was sand, rocks and stuff on the bottom the whole week.

reviews.title: total relaxation
reviews.text: A very relaxing resort. Close to the mountains, a must see...they are absolutely beautiful... but a little far from the Strip. If you came to Las Vegas to relax...this is the place. The pool is great, the check in quick and easy. No real hassle to go to an owner's meeting. The shuttle driver is very friendly.

reviews.title: Away from the craziness of the Strip
reviews.text: We were very happy with our stay. Lived up to all our expectations. Just far enough from the craziness of the Strip. Shuttle device was great. Went to 9:30 show on the Strip and had plenty of time to return on last shuttle. Close to lots of shopping and restaurants. Also close to Red Rock Casino. Would highly recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: My quiet place.
reviews.text: Every time We come to This resort, it’s  always very relaxing. Away from the all the traffic and noise. Clean, relaxing and close to all amenities. This place comes with everything and if you’re missing anything , they will gladly accommodate you with everything you need. Building operator is quick to fix any problem that may arise.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We had a great vacation at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon.Very quiet ,relaxing.Our condo was beautiful and clean.Pool area ,hot tub  area was clean.Staff was friendly and very helpful.Shuttle bus service to the stip was very convient.

reviews.title: Peaceful and Clean
reviews.text: Love the location of this resort, easy access to the strip or on and off the freeway for adventures.  Awesome shopping and places to eat nearby.  Highly recommend a car to gain the full benefits of the location of this resort.

reviews.title: The Cliffs
reviews.text: Nice place off of the strip (almost too far from the strip), rooms are spacious but the bathroom only has one sink and it's not centered under the mirror. Luxurious atmosphere although the pool closes too early and children are allowed in the hot tub.

reviews.title: Las Vegas,
reviews.text: The Cliffs was perfect for our vacation. We didn’t want to be on the strip. It was Very close to Red Rock. Immaculate and lovely accommodations. Pool was clean, grounds were well kept and very safe. Shuttle service is available to the strip.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: I love it there. I have been there 4 or 5 times. I used the shuttle this time a lot to go the strip. A 20 minute bus ride.  Must have a car and like to drive.  I drove to Death Valley.  Red Rock. I parked my rental car ( assigned covered parking place) only a few steps from room. Not many people there.  I cooked chicken on the grill. Pool to yourself.  Plenty of places to eat in the area. Check in is very easy.  25 minutes or less to airport.

reviews.title: Spacious and in a great location
reviews.text: These former apartments are spacious with large full kitchens, and washers and dryers in the unit.  A large dining room table allowed space to play games or do puzzles at one end.  The box spring of the king bed, was annoyingly creaky, always threatening to disturb your bed partner if you had to get up in the night.  There was assigned COVERED parking, which was really appreciated in the blazing sun of Vegas.  The Cliffs are on a fairly quiet street, between Flamingo and Tropicana, two of the main streets heading west of the Strip, which was about 8 miles east of us.  It's also close to the 215, making travel all around the area pretty easy.  The pool and hot tub are open until midnight and were very close to most every unit, so no getting in the car to go to the pool!  We were on the first floor in order to avoid hauling luggage upstairs; however, the second floor would have been quieter.  I think we had a herd of elephants residing above us.  There is not much in the way of "activities" at the Cliffs, but there is so much to do in the area (besides the Strip and gambling).  Red Rock Canyon is beautiful and fun to hike.  Hoover Dam is a great tour and about 1 hour away.  Valley of Fire State Park is also gorgeous and just over an hour away, but make sure to keep your tank full of gas; once you leave the highway, gas stations are few and far between, especially if you try to return via the slightly more interesting route that runs through Lake Meade Recreation Area.  The resort does run shuttles to two locations on the Strip if you don't want to have to drive and park there.  Parking along the Strip is pricey.  The Cliffs is in a very nice spot, away from the hubbub, but not too far either.  If we go back to the Vegas area, we wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. Staff was very helpful and there was no major pressure to do any timeshare sales stuff.

reviews.title: Excellent choice on our part!
reviews.text: The staff is extremely personable, pleasant and helpful.  They were attentive to our needs and always polite.  Richard is the best! :-)  Fantastic location with shuttle available to the strip.  Easy access to the airport. Close to Red Rock Canyon, a jewel of creation. Easy to access routes to Hoover Dam and Lake Mead and Valley of Fire.  Groceries are nearby. Restaurants are many and close by.  Only dislike was the man at the pool who insisted we all listen to his annoying music.

reviews.title: Vegas in Summer
reviews.text: Our second stay at The Cliffs was wonderful (so was the first, which is why we returned a year later!).  We arrived very late but staff were awake, alert and very happy to see us! Very friendly, they made us feel extremely welcome.  The pool area is inviting and relaxing and the resort is roughly a 20 minute drive west of the strip which meant we weren't bothered by the hustle and bustle of Vegas.  A wonderful, relaxing place to stay!

reviews.title: Not my favorite
reviews.text: Furniture is dated.  Beds and bedding fair.  Super low toilets.  Uncomfortable furniture. Units above are noisy.  You can hear furniture scrape on floor. Hear people walking above you.  Deadbolt did not work for door to deck.  Carpet fresh to hide smoke was very strong.

reviews.title: Not a gold star
reviews.text: The only positive on this resort was the small salt water pool, else thumbs down, the mattress had to be 20 years old and creaked with every move.  The place was in the middle of no where, the dirt from the patio was swept into the storage area.  Had newer counters, that is it.  You had to pay for shuttle service whether you had a car or not.

reviews.title: Excellent location; great place to stay
reviews.text: We loved our stay here.  Staff were very accommodating and prompt.  The condo was roomy and comfortable.  We were in a great location- quiet and close to everything we wanted to do.  Our unit was close to the pool and grills.  We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: The Cliffs vacation Village
reviews.text: Great place to stay in but definitely not on the strip.  It has a few amenities but no restaurants on the grounds.  Shopping and restaurants are about a mile away and they do have a bus if you don't have a car to get you to each location including taking you to the strip to gamble and party.

reviews.title: Loved the location and amenities
reviews.text: We chose this place for its location AWAY from all the bustle. We had a nice, one bedroom unit that was very clean and relaxing. The bed was super comfy! We loved the pool and hot tub, too. We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Very quiet
reviews.text: Very nice place. Room was big and clean nice pool. Close to all restaurant . Would suggest a car or going downtown Vegas.Hotel does have transportation to strip and to local food markets. Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Fabulous location, comfortable stay
reviews.text: Chose this place because it was close to family. We couldn't have been more delighted. Our unit was large, the bed was comfortable, the place was super clean. There were a few cosmetic issues with floor tiles and the shower rod, but nothing that impacted our stay. The staff was super helpful. Pool and hot tub were beautiful and the shuttle was a nice touch. We would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.title: Peace @ Peace Canyon
reviews.text: The West side of Las Vegas has its own charm and Peace Canyon puts you in the mix.  The location is quiet, well kept and  commerce is readily available as well as the Freeway.  Much of the attractiveness of Las Vegas surrounds the resort, i.e., Red Rock Canyon and the mountains near by.  A few of the best casinos are close by if you care; generally a well balanced area with your own transportation.

reviews.title: Cliffs at peace canyon
reviews.text: This is one of the best RCI timeshare experiences we have had. This resort is well kept and clean. Pool and hot tub are amazing with lots of chairs available anytime. The condo was a 2 bedroom and very clean and well kept. The service was fantastic and anything we needed the front desk responded right away no waiting time . Great customer service and nice people. We will definitely be coming back . 5 stars from us . Thanks for a great holiday experience.

reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: The Staff at The Cliffs made the difference between a Good vacation and a Great Vacation they were Professional Friendly and Helpful we would recommend the Cliffs at Peace Canyon to the very pickiestof People.

reviews.title: Fabulous Place to Share While in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Away from the Strip, clean & quiet offering fitness area, pool & indoor game area.  The location is close to shops, restaurants & grocery stores as well as a new casino, but if you want to go to the Strip, they offer a shuttle that goes on the hour to different locations and picks up on the half hour up until 11:30 - perfect so you don't have to drive in the traffic & park (as well as the fact that if you don't know your way around, it's very confusing).

reviews.title: September 7,2019
reviews.text: I would recommend this resort to everybody.Resort is  in a quiet area.Units are very clean and beds are very comfortable.Staff is so nice ,ready to help you right away.Shuttles will take you to Las Vegas strip every day.Will come back next time.

reviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: The resort was chosen for its location away from the strip as it is close enough to get there very quickly, but not get all the traffic and noise.  There are many stores/eating places conveniently located close by.  The Outlet shopping mall is great, something to do if you are not a hardcore gambler!

reviews.title: My Vacation at The Cliffs Peace Canyon
reviews.text: It was my first time in Vegas the rooms was very clean the staff was outstanding and it was nice and secluded area... I loved it and will return. The view was beautiful and it was close to a lot of stores... very convenient

reviews.title: OLD AND BUGGY
reviews.text: Stayed in June 2019.  I don't know why my prior review was not posted.  A Roach spotted within 5 minuets in unit.  We complained and they moved us to a 2nd floor unit in the same Bldg.  Unit was old needed updating and saw bugs again.  Too far from the strip 30 minuet drive.  Pool is small.  We have traveled through RCI form many years and this resort is not Gold Crown by far!!!!!

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: I truly enjoyed my stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon. I highly recommend this resort. The accommodations were first-rate. The staff was friendly and professional. The room was beautiful, and the bed luxurious.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: I would highly recommend the Cliffs to all. I would recommend that management look in to upgrading the mattress'.The grounds and facility are very well maintained and accessible. The shuttle service is also very convenient.

reviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: My daughter, her friend (both 13) and I stayed here Aug. 10-15, 2019. It was a pleasant stay! We stayed in a two bedroom-two bathroom unit. The bedrooms are separated by the rest of the unit. It has all the necessities you would want in the kitchen and bathrooms, only could have used a baking pan. The unit had plenty of room for the three of us. The master has a king bed and the other bedroom has a queen. The living room has a sectional with a sleeper sofa. Both the bedrooms and the living room have tv’s. Our unit was on a corner of the property so I could hear cars and trucks going by a good part of the night. You may get used to it, but I used earplugs. The only thing about the unit that needs to be replaced is the carpet. The beds seem a little old, but mine was comfortable. The pool is nice as is the hot tub. They also have a fitness room. We did not take advantage of any resort activities, but they do have DVD’s, board games, a pool table, a movie night, facials, and a shuttle that goes to the strip, a grocery store and an outlet center. We liked the resort for what we needed it for. We left during the day. If you have younger kids there’s not much to do except swim.

reviews.title: Good for a couple
reviews.text: Was a great resort to spend the week with my wife off the strip and still within close proximity to the Vegas attractions. The shuttle to the strip was as entertaining as many of the activities on the strip itself.

reviews.title: Vegas vacation
reviews.text: Very nice accommodations, clean,transportation to casinos, nice pool and facilities, close to shopping and restaurants. Quiet and relaxing away from downtown. If we return to Vegas in the future we will try to book at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: Love the size of property. Even though units are getting outdated and shown wear this property is a hidden area in Vegas. Much nicer for older vacationers than the mega size resorts.it is worth the 10 minute ride to the strip.

reviews.title: Family getaway
reviews.text: Our group of four adult siblings and in-laws chose Las Vegas area for its proximity to Grand Canyon and other outdoor activities rather than gambling access. August might seem odd to visit the desert and it was hot as expected, but the resort had a large, clean pool and deck area with plenty of reclining and upright chairs with sun and shade areas to accommodate everyone. Multiple gas grilles were located adjacent to the pool area to extend the outdoor opportunities and provide cooking options for those that wanted to dine in. Grilles were cleaned daily and cooking utensils were available at the front desk. Covered parking was provided near each unit for convenience. We had a leaking shower faucet that was fixed promptly around our schedule, so even maintenance staff was very helpful and courteous. Front desk staff was friendly and helpful on numerous occasions. Lots of shopping and grocery options very nearby, but the resort itself was located in a residential area that was quieter than the main streets. Finally, an hourly shuttle but to the Strip was free and reliable, which made excursions to Las Vegas Blvd much easier and convenient. Very nice property overall, and we had a great experience at the resort and outside locations we visited.

reviews.title: vegas fun
reviews.text: everything about cliffs at peace canyon is wonderful. The people at the front desk are attentive and kind. the swimming pool area is clean. I have nothing negative to say about this place, i am staying here again sept.

reviews.title: Great resort good location
reviews.text: The resort has a lot of things for you to do at the resort. It is also located 2 blocks from a major highway that can take you anywhere in the Vegas area in minutes. The staff was very helpful with suggestions of things for us to do.

reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.text: We loved this resort. It was first time staying here but won't be the last. Beautiful rooms and units, pleasant staff.  It was a peaceful place to stay with children or with out. We didn't want to leave.

reviews.title: COuld have been moved ....
reviews.text: Room smelled of smoke.   After going into room I immediately went back to registration.  Told them of odor in room and also asked for room nearer the pool area.  Reminded them I called them directly after booking with RCI and asked for 2nd level pool area.  I was in the back-back corner.  With smoke smell and corner area, I asked to please be moved.  Was told that was not possible.  During the week I could see their bookings were down - even around the pool area.  Many units not in use. They could have moved me but refused to.    Did bring machine to clear air in room but t then left it on the bar/kitchen area for the entire week.

reviews.title: Excellent Quieter Option to the busy Las Vegas Blvd Strip locations
reviews.text: Excellent for families and anyone not wanting to be in the middle of the busy, crowded Strip area all the time.  They provide free shuttle service to and from the Strip so you do not have to drive you own car in the congested, crowded areas or pay the high "parking fees" charges by the large hotels.   .  You can return after your "fun" to a quieter home base for resting, sleeping and enjoy the lovely pool area and amenities.

reviews.title: 11th Anniversary Yrip
reviews.text: The location is awesome.  We stayed in 2060 the rooms were nice and have everything you need.  The balcony was very nice with a view of the pool.  Our ONLY negative comment is the beds were horrible.  The master king was so flat it obviously has NEVER been replaced and the guest bed was not any better.  Ask for a room with a newer mattress or you will end up at the chiropractor like us.  Everything else is very nice.

reviews.title: The kitchen
reviews.text: In past stays the cookwares were more complete. There was a pot without a lid and a pot with a lid that is too big. Some cooking utensils are missing and the knives are very dull. The only cooking utensil we had was a metal spatula and a plastic draining spoon which is not very good for using with stainless steel. This made it frustrating and difficult for us when cooking. But our overall our stay was very good and the staff very friendly.

reviews.title: Lovely experience
reviews.text: A sweet respite from Las Vegas, but close enough to enjoy the city at any time.  The shuttle service was excellent traveling to and from Vegas on the hour every hour.  The drivers were prompt and delightful.  The unit and the entire property is clean, comfortable, and delightful.

reviews.title: An old apartment complex: not a resort
reviews.text: Located in a residential area, this is an old apartment complex with dated kitchen and crumbling floor tiles, surrounded by other (newer and better looking) apartment complexes. Far from the Las Vegas strip. Room smelled of cigarette smoke. "Activity center" is a trailer in the parking lot.

reviews.title: Perfect Family Stay.
reviews.text: The condo was clean and efficient.  The kitchen was perfect for preparing meals for the week without having to spend a fortune eating out.  It is only about 20 minutes from the strip.  We did lots of hiking and it was perfectly placed for that also.  It is about a 4 hour drive to the Grand Canyon.

reviews.title: good
reviews.text: the room is very clean and my family enjoy the stay on the resort. closer to the market, down town Vegas is very close and the transportation from the resort is very nice and clean.gym is very small but everything is on it. nice

reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text: I traded into RCI in order to stay in a two bedroom. We were able to purchase Guest Certificates through RCI so my daughter's dance team families could stay there too. There were 15 families all together. Best thing we ever did. Dance Nationals was held at a larger Casino Resort, but The Cliffs was absolutely perfect for all of us. The pool was never busy. We rented a car and everything was very easy to drive to. It's off the strip, but they have a shuttle that you can use to get there so you don't have to drive. It also goes to Fremont Street. We loved not having to smell smoke or walk through the crowded casinos. If you want a relaxing vacation, this is perfect. Everyone was very helpful and nice at the resort. They have barbeques, pool towels and covered parking. They were so helpful by putting all of us in rooms very close by each other. Check in was easy and only a $30 per week resort fee. There are lots of restaurants, shops and things to do close by. Several went hiking in Red Rock. We took in some shows. Getting to the strip was easy for us by taking the shuttle, Ubers or driving. Everything was clean and in great working order. We would stay there again.

reviews.title: Great property
reviews.text: Overall a great place to relax. Quiet location near not far from any Las Vegas destination. Shopping and resources nearby. Excellent maintenance. Excellent staff, very responsive and friendly.Lighting in the unit could be better designed, but the night light switch in the bathroom was very helpful to us.We would gladly return to this property.

reviews.title: Very nice resort
reviews.text: Resort is off the strip in a residential area.  It is quiet and serene.  Easy access to the strip, by street or freeway.  Ask for an upstairs unit if physically able to climb stairs; second floor occupants can be loud.

reviews.title: Older but worked for the purpose of our trip
reviews.text: Resort is older and a bit worn down but clean. Pool was nice and we enjoyed it while we were at the resort. It was a good resort for us as we were there for a week long dance convention. Only concern was we did not get the promised mid week cleaning and check out guy didn’t really give much thought or concern over it.

reviews.title: Clean and great experience once again
reviews.text: We are so grateful this is our home base with RCI.  The staff is always willing to do the best for anyone who stays.  The rooms are wonderful, spacious and clean.  CJ you are truly a great person.  Thank you for the help.  You went way beyond what we could have asked for.  We are grateful.  Manager Richard and Miss Candace a thank you as well.

reviews.title: Very nice property but unit was poorly maintained!
reviews.text: We stayed at this property from July 12th - 19th in unit #1002. We have been time share owners for almost 40 years and have exchanged for numerous properties all over. We previously stayed at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon around 2005 and decided to return because we liked the property and it's location in Vegas to the Red Rock area. The unit was very poorly maintained! The master baths faucet and toilet seat were very loose. The other bathrooms shower faucet dripped constantly. One of the kitchens GFI was dead and wouldn't reset thus effecting one whole kitchen counter or 3 daisy chained receptacles. A Cliffs representative called during the week to inquire if we enjoying our stay and we informed them of the issues, nobody ever showed up to address them. We informed them again during check out. Most of these issues should have been noticed by housekeeping during unit cleaning, you would think!We would never consider buying a time share in a property that wasn't well maintained or that we felt our maintenance fees we well spent!

reviews.title: No staff resort
reviews.text: The no staff at the clifffs at peace canyon.They charge $25.00 for amenities and won't tell you the amenities that they have.Internet slow but the resort was fast to charge 20 for it.My unit was falling apart.

reviews.title: Stay @ Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: The resort is very very nice clean & quite in a residential neighborhood. It was actually an apartment with all the inside amenities. Very close to stores, restaurants and eateries. For ONCE it was very nice to be 8 miles from the strip. Free shuttle was available daily to the strip, downtown and grocery stores. Very Very nice and relaxing.

reviews.title: July Vegas Trip to the Cliffs
reviews.text: Overall this is a nice spot located in a residential area, near shopping and some eating spots.  Depending on taste really not enough stand alone restaurants for choices, probably to drive you to the strip.  Cleanliness of the unit - looks okay at first look, but its dirty, carpet, floors, doors were hard to open, well insulated for the air conditioning, small pool and hot tub, patio area, BBQ and fire pit.

reviews.title: Nice, clean, quiet, and close to shopping.
reviews.text: It's away from the strip and was very quiet, very clean, and nice to have free parking which was close to the unit. The unit was big with plenty of amenities. 2 large rooms with bathrooms for each bedroom.

reviews.title: First time to Las Vegas didn't disappoint
reviews.text: We arrived at The Cliffs late in the evening.  I was happy to know that there was a 24/7 desk available for check in after our long flight.  I was not crazy about the fact that after our easy check-in we were pushed over to another desk offering "free brunch" at a local casino.  This of course turns out to be a time share push .  Aside from that, the 2 bedroom condo was very roomy for 2 families to share.  It came with everything you would need for a weeks stay.   A bit disappointed that the pool was smaller then expected but was still a nice area and option on the hot July days.

reviews.title: Convenient location for Vegas vacation
reviews.text: The Cliffs was a great location for our vacation.  Quiet residential setting away from the Strip, yet only a short shuttle ride (Free!) when we wanted to be in the midst of the excitement of the strip.  Easy access to main highways, restaurants, stores, other area sightseeing.  Close to Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire State Park, Lake Mead & Hoover Dam. Our fave restaurants - Juan's Flaming Fajitas, Aloha Kitchen, Rise & Shine for steak and eggs.  Resort was great!  Friendly, knowledgeable and responsive staff.  Our one-bedroom unit was quite spacious, very clean, well-equipped and nicely furnished.  Nice pool with shady areas as well, spa, several built-in BBQs.  Ample parking and also a covered parking spot for our car.  Free shuttle was so convenient for us to go from resort to the Strip and back "home" again---a reservation is required but not an issue while we were there.We would absolutely stay at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon again when we visit Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Excellent resort - located in a very quiet and peaceful part of Vegas, not too far from the strip, shuttles were offered throughout the day. It has a beautiful swimming pool and a Jacuzzi , bbq pits are impeccably clean and the staff was excellent at assisting to our every need.  I would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.title: Second stay
reviews.text: This was my second visit and everything was perfect. The units are nice, clean, and everything was in perfect working order. The staff was beyond friendly and always willing to help with anything. I look forward to returning in the future.

reviews.title: Grand Canyon/Vegas Trip
reviews.text: Check out u tube entries regarding what to see/do, places to spend/save money in Vegas. EBike tour in Red Rock Canyon just 15 minutes east of resort was a great morning activity. Grand Canyon was great, did bike tour there also, 95% downhill ride, 2-3 hour tour with stops. Hike down Bright Angel path. Use a water back pack! Antelope Canyon tour worth it. Buy 2-3 gals. water, leave in your car. U'll need it!

reviews.title: Great family vacation!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time staying at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon! The resort was perfect for our family. The pool was perfect and very relaxing.  We loved the area also. It's not as busy as the strip or the Grandview.

reviews.title: Very Accommodating & Pleasant
reviews.text: Nicely located away from Vegas Strip in more residential / homey type area.  Very close to shopping, restaurants while easy to get to highways and attractions.  Resort layout was simple w/comfortable units.

reviews.title: Hidden fees, indifferent staff, missing amenities
reviews.text: We booked this property due to being in Las Vegas late one night and very few available hotels at the time.  We booked through a third-party hotel website that advised us at checkout that we were paying the entire amount due including all taxes and resort fees.  Upon checking in we were told we had to pay an additional $30 resort fee.  When we questioned this the attendant became very defensive and barked at us that everyone complains about that and our issue is with the booking site.  We were told the additional $30 is for the parking, free shuttle service, etc.  The next night we tried to book a ride on the free shuttle, only to be told that it was full and we should have booked it days in advance.  Do not count on getting a ride on this free shuttle; it's a very small vehicle that is booked full in advance.  This would have been nice to know upon checkin.  The parking spot for the room was quite far from the room, and we had to drag our luggage up a few flights of stairs.  You are required to take out your own garbage and start the dishwasher before checking out; there is a $150 security deposit hold put on your card.  The beds and pillows were very cheap and uncomfortable and the door was difficult to lock.  The shower leaked down the wall and was stationary, with no mobile hand attachment.  The furniture was very basic and dated.  There was a strong odor of marijuana smoke on our shared balcony coming from one of the other rooms.  It costs about $20 for uber to the strip.  The property is in a business area with various restaurants and stores around, but nothing within walking distance.  Every interaction we had with the staff they all seemed defeated and irritated.  The difficulties we had could have been made much better by a properly trained professional staff, but it seems that they really skimp in this area, which is a shame.  For $300 a night, we surely expected more.  There are much better options in this price range in Las Vegas and I do not recommend staying here.

reviews.title: Convenient Location
reviews.text: Very convenient to all Las Vegas activities. If doing the Strip or downtown take the free shuttle. Friendly staff, very responsive and knowledgeable. Nicely equipped units with nice pool and spa including outdoor barbecues.

reviews.title: Relaxing family vacation
reviews.text: This was a great location to be away from the strip and easy access to sight seeing and activities. We visited the Grand Canyon, Red Rock Canyon and Seven Magic Mountains. It was in a quiet location and close to shopping and restaurants. I will definitely vacation here again.

reviews.title: Great time in Vegas
reviews.text: We spent a week in Vegas to see family.  Our condo was roomy.  The beds were very comfortable.  My dad was on a walker and we were never crowded.  Our condo turned out to be the central gathering point.  Three of us stayed there but 7 -10 would show up during the day.  We all used the pool and the bbqs.  Great time.  A guaranteed cover parking spot was nice and there was lots of visitor parking.  Be sure to hit Handels ice cream on Tuesdays for the special scoop night.  Juans Flaming Fajitas is a great Mexican place and be sure to hit Baby Stack for breakfast.

reviews.title: Relaxation in the Desert
reviews.text: This resort is wonderful.  The staff all very friendly and polite.  The pool and hot tub were relaxing and peaceful, with a beautiful view all around.  Very close to the strip, downtown and nightlife of Vegas, without being in the middle of the craziness of Vegas!  Thank you, we will return!!

reviews.title: Great place close to everything
reviews.text: This place was in a great location, close to the strip-they have a wonderful shuttle to many things.  We wanted to visit many parks and hiking places near Vegas, this resort was perfectly located.  We thought the room was well maintained and enjoyed having breakfast and dinner on the balcony every day.  We would stay again!!

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: My wife and I just spent a week at The Cliffs in a one bedroom unit. We really enjoyed our stay and the amenities the resort had to offer. The unit was well equipped with everything we needed or could want. The Wifi in the unit was excellent as it was throughout the entire resort. Other noteworthy positives include great working AC, ice maker worked fantastic, the bed was comfortable, large flat screen TV, nice room darkening drapery, plenty of handy outlets for charging electronics, abundance of closet space, couch was large enough that we could both take naps, good size bathroom vanity, and the table and 2 chairs on the balcony were just right. We did use the barbecue area, clean, high end gas grills with excellent illumination for night time grilling. We spent a fair amount of time relaxing and using the pool and pool/spa area. Good mix of tables with umbrellas and loungers, never had an issue finding a place to relax. From what I could tell the layout of the resort allowed for all units to be relatively close to the pool/office/fitness center. The palm trees in the pool area are beautiful and the other vegetation around the resort is thriving and well manicured. Also used the fitness center, nothing over the top but was adequate and all the equipment worked. While there was a dispenser for sanitary wipes it was never refilled in the time we were there and a scale would have been a nice addition. The shuttle bus was by far a great amenity, not having to deal with driving to the strip was a huge plus. Staff was very friendly and check-in was hassle free. The assigned,covered parking was nice and there were plenty of extra spaces. The standard chain stores and restaurants are close by including Starbucks. The neighborhood is mostly residential and appeared very safe, clean, no graffiti to speak of, good sidewalks and well landscaped and manicured parkways along the streets, we were never concerned. So there is always the one thing that is the spoiler, for us it was folks smoking pot on their balcony. While smoking is not allowed in the room and really no one smoked in the pool area that we are aware of, there were ash trays on every balcony table. Pot smoke smell was abundant on our balcony and often prevented us from sitting out there and enjoying ourselves. We don't come from a state were weed is legal so not sure what, if any, action could be taken, and since the ash trays were there for a reason we did not complain. I would suggest that the resort become completely smoke free. We enjoyed the free coffee offered in the reception room.

reviews.title: nice resort to stay away from strip and still have able to see vegas strip
reviews.text: nice resort and people working were very nice and friendly. About 8 miles from strip made stay quiet and safe. Shuttle to Mirage on the vegas strip and to fremont made seeing these areas easier to enjoy.

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a lovely little gem located right near Red Rock Canyon National Park. The Park is beautiful and offers many great hikes. There are lots of restaurants in the area and shopping nearby as well. The service at the Cliffs was great and they were quite accommodating to our requests. It is quiet, yet only 10 minutes from all the bling of Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent vacation spot.
reviews.text: I would book again. It’s close to down Las Vegas strip. Shopping is nearby. Excellent restaurant choices for both adults and children. The entertainment can’t be beat. I’m not that much of a gambler but great casinos are nearby.

reviews.title: A Relaxing Retreat Outside the Hubbub of the Vegas Strip
reviews.text: I not being one to enjoy the traffic and commotion of the city, I was reluctant to join my family's trip to Vegas.  Jim and I decided to seek a resort just outside the Vegas strip through RCI.  I had previously read a review of the resort in a travel magazine. We could not have made a better choice.  Our unit was super comfortable and conveniently located near major highways, to which we had easy access when visiting nearby canyons and parks.  When we wished to meet family and friends on the strip or see a show, we used the resorts shuttle.  Jim and I were delighted with our apartment which provided a wonderful retreat from the noise and bustle of the city.  We could eat breakfast in or have a late night supper if we were very tired.  We often chose to eat at nearby restaurants which gave us a more extensive choice for dining. outside of what was available on the strip.

reviews.title: Best timeshare resort in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: great resort for couples or families with children. Units are clean, staff are friendly and all units are easy to get to the pool office, exercise unit etc. Highly recommend this time share resort. Shuttle service available to certain casino's Shopping is close by as well.

reviews.title: Away from the Strip, peaceful and comfortable.
reviews.text: As a place to stay in the area, it's great - if you don't want to be swamped by the Vegas trappings. Good accessibility to anything, shuttles to the Strip, etc. The staff is the best, very helpful and friendly.

reviews.title: Only if you want no amenities
reviews.text: There is a $25 resort fee for a property which is is not a resort by any standards, but particularly not by LV standards. The pool area is small for the number of units and at least during our visit was taken over with children; there is only one pool so there was no where else to go.  Housekeeping is offered only one time per week without an additional charge, but management thoughtful provides a map of where to take trash to dumpster.  In the two-bedroom unit one of the beds is a queen-sized bed, but according to the desk they have no queen-sized fitted sheets so they made the bed with a double fitted sheet, when asked for a larger sheet we were offered a king-sized fitted sheet and asked if we wanted to make it ourselves and acted put out when we asked them to make the bed with a sheet that would stay tucked in for the entire night.

reviews.title: Our favorite place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: We don't go for the strip... we have family there.  The Cliffs is away from the strip, relatively quiet... has everything we would want: pool area, bbq area (which we used a few times) exercise room w/ equipment.

reviews.title: Family getaway with younger kids
reviews.text: Family vacation? Yes! Nice and quiet location with shuttle service to the Mirage every hour. Couples? Depends if you want quiet and low key. If you want closer to the strip, then the Cliffs is not it. Overall, we enjoyed our stay at the Cliffs and will again.

reviews.title: A quiet place to relax!!!
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay In the property because the location is about 15 minutes away from Las Vegas strip and it gave us time to relax in a quiet condominium. We do not even have to drive to the city because there is a free shuttle available during the day our stay.

reviews.title: Great hide-a-way with ALL AMENITES
reviews.text: Staff is very cordial and informative with a friendly smile at all times.  rooms are exceptional with comfortable beds with a great feel of home away from home.  I love their shuttle service and its location is awesome with shopping and restaurants near by

reviews.title: return again
reviews.text: Location, easy access from anywhere in Las Vegas and the cleanliness and upkeep of the resort keeps us coming back. Staff are helpful when needed. Quiet and peaceful. Will suggest this resort to anyone.

reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.text: Great aminities, I took my parents and granddaughter for a family vacation.the shuttle service to and from downtown Las Vegas, Walmart, and the grocery food store was priceless.There was a meeting concerning the shuttle on the evening we were scheduled for a show. The front desk called to inform me of the problem. We called an uber driver, the resort reimburse the cost of the uber driver and the tip I gave the driver.

reviews.title: Quiet but not updated
reviews.text: Room was nice but dirty. Found crumbs on counter, peanuts on the floor. Teapot and coffee maker had mold.  Furniture is outdated and old and cabinets look very old. Needs some upgrades and repairs. We did have the pool to ourselves a couple nights and it was heated so that was great!

reviews.title: Away but close
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is away from the strip but still so close to everything. The strip is about 15 min away, the airport is about 15-18 and Red Rock Casino and Sumerlin area with mall, eats and fun for kids is about 5-10 min away. Great breakfast at RIse and Shine just a skip down the street.This was our 2nd stay here and we love it. Parking is free and easy and the staff is friendly. Good wifi. Only con is the $25 resort fee but i guess that is becoming pretty common.

reviews.title: Lovely place to stay!
reviews.text: If you are needing a chill out place after being on the strip or just a chill out place to holiday then this is your place! Location is brilliant and is only a 20 minute car ride from either outlets, walmarts, ross or the Vegaa strip itself. The apartments are beautiful and such modern comfy places to stay. It has a lovely pool area and plenty of parking! Will 100% be staying here again!

reviews.title: Finding Peace by the Canyons
reviews.text: This place was quiet, clean, and located far from the madding crowds.  If you are looking for Las Vegas glitz and glam---this is not the place for you.  If you are looking for a quiet getaway with a clean room, clean pool, and efficient housekeeping then this is the right place. The pool seemed a bit  small for the number of units, but the hot tub was adequate. Because this place is far from the strip, it is perfect for families and honeymooners..  We used it as a base for  Red Rocks Canyon; close, convenient and quiet.

reviews.title: Excellent restbit
reviews.text: Overlooking pool is pretty and easy access to amenities. If you want more reclusive ask for outlying unit. Still just 2 minute walk to amenities. Make use of staff. Friendliest and most helpful I have ever experienced.

reviews.title: Excellent Vacation Spot
reviews.text: The Cliffs is an excellent timeshare near Vegas.  It is located in the suburbs which is close to Vegas but far enough to have peace and quiet.  The units are fully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay.  Customer service is excellent.  There is a shuttle that takes you to the strip, Walmart, the supermarket and Fremont Street.  This is a wonderful amenity.  We loved staying here and would definitely recommend it.

reviews.title: great place
reviews.text: we have stayed at the cliffs a number of times and it is always a great time, the shuttle is great and if you get Steve you will happy he is a great driver with a lot of info,the grilling area is awesome and wife loves the pool,be sure to take shuttle to Freemont street is something you will remember

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon is an Oasis from the bustle of the Strip
reviews.text: This was our second trip to Cliffs at Peace Canyon. We love that it is off the strip and away from all the hustle and bustle. We love that they offer guests a shuttle service to the strip, grocery or fremon street. The units are well maintained, and the grounds are gorgeous. Jose does and AMAZING job keeping the outside grills spotless and looking brand new. We love that we can swim or soak in the tub whenever we choose, no early shut down of the pool area. The gym is convenient and well maintained. Staff is friendly and helpful. The location for day trips to the mountains is perfect. We will come back again, in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Good Place
reviews.text: Gym is less than adequate.  The facility is nice, staff is great.  The shuttle is super...you could really get away with not renting a car.  If for some reason you want to take a day to go somewhere other than the strip, you can rent a car from enterprise for the day and they will bring the car to you and pick it up.

reviews.title: Not clean
reviews.text: The cleanliness of this resort was horrible. The staff was nice but the housekeeping was horrid. Definitely won’t be staying here again. For being a time share holder there are certain expectations but mine were not met.

reviews.title: Quiet stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Nice quiet location west of the Strip.  Shopping, casinos and restaurants nearby. Recommend a rental car to get around.  Nice outdoor pool and fitness equipment. Red Rock casino is right nearby. Can drive to the Strip in 25 minutes.  Nice place for a vacation

reviews.title: Too far away from strip
reviews.text: The shower water was not hot. Far away from strip but there were many stores near by. I wouldn’t stay again. We did not sleep well. We stayed 2 nights out of the week. We slept much better in a hotel.

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: Nice and quite resort. The gym need some updating on its equipment and their is no concierge at the front desk to help you book excursions. If you're looking for a quite and relaxing place this is it.

reviews.title: Very Quiet and clean
reviews.text: Quiet, clean, and private. Other than no food or drink, excellent! Covered parking available. Full kitchen and full sized washer and dryer. Nice grills on a patio close to the pool. Could use more that one ice machine. Only saw a pool table, so more activities would be good too.

reviews.title: Amazing off the strip place to stay!
reviews.text: We were treated like royalty from the first greeting!  The staff is very accommodating and the rooms were very nice and spacious.  We were on the ground floor with was great because we did not have to carry our luggage up the stairs, even though they asked if we needed help.  Love the location, off the strip and quiet!  The pool and hot tub are very nice.  4 grills for the guests to use and even an outdoor fireplace to gather around on the chilly nights.  Easy location to get to many local eateries and Red Rock Canyon.  Thanks again to everybody at Cliffs at Peace Canyon for making out stay memorable!

reviews.title: What  we needed at the time where we needed it!
reviews.text: Being on the West side gave direct access to (generally) Red Rock.  Direct access to Hwy I215 and many of the needed amenities, i.e., restaurants and stores. The wifi was fast enough; however, the $25.00 Resort Fee is excessive for wifi.

reviews.title: R Fulton
reviews.text: The two bedroom condo was excellent for our needs,it was clean & very quiet. The shuttle was was very convenient for getting to and from the strip and was easy to book. The staff were very friendly & accommodating.

reviews.title: Celebrating at the Cliffs
reviews.text: We spent a lovely week at the Cliffs for our 50th anniversary. Our unit was upgraded to a two bedroom and gave us a feel of a large apartment.  My only minor complaint would be it was in the back and the road behind us effected my sleeping.  The hot tub was wonderful after a day in Vegas.  Really appreciated the shuttle taking us to and from the strip.  It really helped as this was our first visit.  If ever we come back to Vegas, we would certainly want to stay here again.

reviews.title: 1st Visit
reviews.text: The resort was nice and the staff was always ready available to assist.  The location was not far from the strip or the stores.  It  was a pleasure.  There were 4 of us  and we all agreed to vacation at the Cliffs again.

reviews.title: GREAT PLACE TO STAY
reviews.text: Richard was friendly, courteous and fast with check-in/check-out!! Peaceful and pleasant place to stay away from the Strip. Only problem we had, bed was too hard. Overall, great place to stay!! Thanks!

reviews.title: What happens in Vegas...
reviews.text: The property was very well maintained, the amenities were well kept and easily accessible.  The suite was perfect.  Amazing space, accommodating, clean, efficient!!!!  Would definitely go again.   Just far away from the strip, close to Red Rock...beautiful!

reviews.title: Amazing Las Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: Wonderful time OFF THE STRIP. The Cliffs is a quiet resort with friendly staff. Excellent shuttle service to the strip is provided. Richard checked us in and was very helpful with details. We visited Hoover Dam, Grand Canyon (south rim), Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire, watched Mystere and spent a day on touring Las Vegas Blvd. A wonderful vacation!

reviews.title: Great Place for Families!
reviews.text: We stayed here for a family vacation. We had a two bedroom unit and have kids who are 8 and 12. My parents also travelled with us and had a 1 bedroom unit. Worth it-- space to spread out, full kitchen for breakfasts at home, and a pool!!The location is exactly as others have said- an easy 20 minute drive to the Strip, in a quiet area but PLENTY of restaurants, shopping within 5 minute drive. The location was perfect for us- with kids, we wanted a pool, plus access to both the Strip and other places- we visited Red Rock Canyon and Hoover Dam- both very easy day trips from here.  Otherwise, we'd hang out at the pool and then drive to the Strip (free parking at some of the casinos-- just google it) or vice versa.Richard (front desk) was very helpful and accommodating, as were the rest of the staff. The unit we stayed in was in a quad- 2 bedrooms on the ground floor (2 units across from each other) and two 1 bedroom units above. Stairs access only-- proved a bit challenging for my parents. Since the unit across from us on the ground floor was unoccupied, Richard was able to move them, which helped a great deal.We came via a timeshare, Sat-Sat. Our Sat flight home was at 11 pm-- again, Richard and the staff were so helpful-- for a small fee we were able to book another day instead of checking out Sat AM. This way, we could hang out on the Strip one more day, the kids could spend the afternoon at the pool, and we could all shower before heading to the airport for our red-eyes back to the East Coast.Definitely recommend staying here, especially for families with a week in Vegas!

reviews.title: Relaxing place after the hustle and bustle
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a great place to stay to be away from the strip but close enough to get there easily.  It's not far from the interstate, as well as Walmart and grocery stores.  You will need a car to be able to come and go as you please--while they have shuttle service to the strip, it only goes at certain times and to certain locations.  It will take you to the strip, but only to the Mirage--which is a long walk to the Luxor or Mandalay Bay or to the Stratosphere in the other direction, then back to the Mirage for pick-up.  The pool and hot tub are great for relaxing after a long day of walking the strip, though!  I would certainly stay here again.

reviews.title: Ideal place to be "away" from the Strip, but only a quick 15-20 minute ride away!
reviews.text: 15 minute walk to shopping, restaurants, etc.; 15-20 minute free round-trip  shuttle ride to the "Strip".  Small and somewhat quaint, American SouthWestern flair/ambience.  Rooms are a bit dark due to high windows and rather close-together spacing of the buildings.  15-20 delivery service for pizza/italian food.  Only two-story buildings made apartment access convenient.  Furniture (sofa) was very firm, not all that comfortable.  Beds/bedrooms were comfortable.  Full kitchen and laundry equipment made for much appreciated convenience.  Response time for service needs (replaced lamp; ran out of bathroom tissue) was merely a few minutes - even late at night.

reviews.title: The Cliffs
reviews.text: Excellent resort with a very nice atmosphere.Close to everything yet away from the Strip. The staff was very nice and accommodating.  The pool and hot tub are great.The apartment is large and has a lot of room to visit.

reviews.title: Las Vegas off the Strip
reviews.text: The cliffs resort it located in a very desirable are and everything you need is nearby. Variety of restaurants, grocery stores etc. The resort offers a Free Shuttle to the Strip and other places. The staff are extremely helpful and want to satisfy your needs.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This was a great location and best time of year to travel to Valley of Fire, Red Rock Conservation Area, Hoover Dam, Death Valley and of course the Strip! Temps were perfect! Lots of shopping and restaurants close by. If you like Chinese then try “Yummy” off Rainbow Blvd. The owners Terri  and Jim are welcoming and their food is great.  Over all our stay was the best one this time around.

reviews.title: Another Great Stay
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a great resort for a relaxing break in Las Vegas, resort staff are great and it's close enough to the Strip to not be an issue to get to, local shops and restaurants are also very goodThis was our 3rd time at this resort, love it

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: It is a very nice resort and good location. Clean and well equipped. Staffs are friendly. Unfortunately our room was at a noisy side of the street.Traffic noise woke us up and hard to have a relaxing sleep on vacation.

reviews.title: Nice resort and location, but...
reviews.text: The resort staff was super and the resort overall was fine.  The individual units need a serious upgrade including appliances, carpeting etc...  The location was excellent - out of the noise of the strip and close to some wonderful golf courses.

reviews.title: Vacation in Las Vegas that is quiet with also close proximity to the strip
reviews.text: We wanted to have some quiet time in our unit, swim in a pool and enjoy the beautiful surroundings.  we got all that and were still within 15 minutes of the strip.  They had a shuttle that would take you to the Casino's on a scheduled basis, so you didn't have to drive and park.  We did both.  There is close shopping and plenty of activities in the area to enjoy.  Would recommend this resort.

reviews.title: Loved this location.
reviews.text: There is so much to do in Las Vegas without having to gamble. This facility was centrally located which made "side trips" accessible. I had reserved two units to accommodate my family and we were conveniently housed a very short distance from each other. Loved, loved, loved it.

reviews.title: good serviers
reviews.text: location are good ,10 mins drive to eats chinese food, all ours member are like that , and we will come back here 100%, Thanks, the room is too close to the road, we can hear the noise a litte bit, that is all,

reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text: Beautiful  resort, great amenities, closed to the stip and also closed to Vegas Downtown. Away from the congested of the strip. Closed to the Rock Cayon,  if you want California  is 4 hour drive. Recommend  this resort.

reviews.title: Went for Hockey Game. Stayed for Vacation
reviews.text: The Cliffs is a nice, quiet resort with nice amenities. The suite was modern and furnished nicely. Beds and bedding I found very comfortable. Wife not as much. Weren’t a lot of people when we were there so pool and hot tub were always available. The shuttle to and from the strip was a very nice perk. Steve was very professional but also fun and informative as was Rocky and the fella from the Philippines.The Cliffs in general is a nice escape from the hustle and bustle of the strip. We enjoyed our stay

reviews.title: Quiet sanctuary in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This resort has excellent service.  While the resort is a bit older than others in Las Vegas, it has been kept up extremely well and the rooms are nicely appointed and very roomy.  My wife and I very much enjoyed going both to the desert and to the strip.  You will need a car to get around, but lots of restaurants, costco and stores in the area.  We had a very pleasant stay at this resort!

reviews.title: a "peaceful" stay at the Cliffs
reviews.text: This is our second stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon.  We chose this resort again because it was away from the Strip, but we could easily access it with the provided shuttle.  The staff are cordial and very helpful with our needs.  They have a heated pool, hottub, gym facilities, outside bbq's and even an outdoor fireplace.  I think the best part is the relative quiet of the resort and the ability to use the shuttle to get to places like the Strip, Fremont Street, the Outlet Mall, and even grocery shopping.  The three drivers that we used are very good and got us to our destinations with a minimum of fuss.  Overall, this is a resort I'd recommend to anyone or a family that wanted to go to Las Vegas but didn't want to be too near the Strip.

reviews.title: Nice quiet resort
reviews.text: Nice to be away from the madness of the strip. It was good to dip in and out as we wanted. The shuttle bus was a great additional service - saved us hiring a car on that week. There are a few restaurants within walking distance. Units nice and clean with plenty of amenities.

reviews.title: Horrible Visit
reviews.text: We arrived at the unit at 8:35 pm, 19 minutes later we’re getting a visit from security staing that we’re being reported for a noise complaint. The three of us were in one room simply watching tv.Later that week, we were forced to move from one unit to another between midnight and 1:00 am in the morning due to a broken water heater/leak outside of the unit. No apologies or follow up from management for the inconvenience.  Cleanliness was horrible, hair was everywhere; in the tub, the bed, the soap dish, the sofa sleeper, blankets, shower leaked, tub stopper didn’t work, housekeeping didn’t deliver when items were requested. Just horrible customer service

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Staff members were friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive. The room was spacious, clean, and had everything that we needed. The shuttle was convenient for getting around. Not too far or too close to the strip, great location!

reviews.title: A great resort with excellent staff.
reviews.text: Besides our dishwasher failing, we couldn't have been happier with the resort and staff. We regularly used the shuttle to and from the strip, plus enjoyed downtime by the pool. I am certain that we will be back.

reviews.title: perfect place
reviews.text: Just 20 minutes of the downtown and peaceful place- everything clean and order... nice place to be with the family and feel comfortable like home.the spaces are beauty and quite... the  people in the reception is very kind

reviews.title: A pleasant and peaceful stay in the Las Vegas area
reviews.text: This resort provides easy access to spectacular  hiking in the Red Rock Canyon Park and state parks.  In addition, the resort is near a variety of good restaurants, provides a shuttle to the strip and is a very comfortable place to stay. The staff is friendly and accommodating. This is my third time staying here and I hope to return. I would recomment taking a second floor unit as we were on the first floor this time and the noise of movement above was distracting.

reviews.title: Birthday in Las vegas
reviews.text: Strip about 25 min. Easy drive down Tropicana.  Close by are restaurants, target, and food shops.  The spa was great and very clean.  Did not use the free shuttle, times are limited.  Rooms are spacious and have everything you need

reviews.title: 40th BIRTHDAY
reviews.text: This place was a great location with shuttle access to and from the stripe. The only issue was the resort not having phone service. The fact that it was to cold to go back and forth from office to room made it uncomfortable.

reviews.title: February is not the time to stay
reviews.text: Extremely cold with snow.  Shows were good.  Having visited Las Vegas many times, I found the area a very expensive rip off and will not return.  Food and show prices are triple what one could find at other locations, with far more to do during the day.  After three days in the jungle of humanity, I wanted to come home.

reviews.title: Off the Strip Stay
reviews.text: We've stayed here a couple times and will be staying again later this year.  My wife is fairly particular when it comes to hotel/resort rooms.  So, just the fact that we will be staying here again, is a kind of a big deal.  Units are pretty clean, however they could be cleaner.  Found a few miscellaneous items under the bed & dresser.  Not a deal breaker, by any means.  The unit is appointed well enough.  It's a smaller complex, so the noise isn't bad.  Check-in only takes a few minutes.  Most parking is covered, which is nice. Pool is large enough as is the hot tub.TIP:  Write down your car model & license plate #, before you go in & save yourself a trip back out to the parking lot, to get it.

reviews.title: A Great Stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent condo stay. We were given an immaculate two bedroom condo.  We loved the quiet location on the west side of LasVegas.  The shuttle service and staff were helpful and friendly.  We could not ask for more as a vacation stay.

reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: We had gotten two rooms because we had a family vacation. When we arrived, they had given one of our rooms to someone else, and we ended up being very far apart. Eventually, we got rooms side by side after being lied to continuously by the staff and management. Other than that, the resort is a great place, and would recommend it.
