We just don't appreciate being lied to.

reviews.title: Cousin's Annual Gathering
reviews.text: The Cliffs in Las Vegas was the best.  This might be considered small, as it relates to importance on reviews but any request for additional coffee packets or tea bags was no problem  Typically any additional extras, beyond the complimentary packages, are stated to be an extra charge.  We had no problem in getting all that we asked for at the front desk.We especially enjoyed the lay-out of the unit.  This being a two bedroom unit, the bedrooms were at opposite ends of the unit, allowing both couples to complete privacy.  Both bathrooms were adjacent to the bedrooms.  Again, providing complete privacy.One additional item that made this resort pleasing to us was the location.  The intent of our family trip was to be able to spend time within Las Vegas.  The Cliffs is located in Las Vegas area but far enough from the madness surrounding the bright lights and traffic.  Plus, we were close enough to the other attractions of Las Vegas (Red Rock, etc).

reviews.title: Happy visitor
reviews.text: This was a very clean and quiet resort. The staff were very friendly. The pool looked lovely but the weather temperature was too cool for us to try the pool.  The only wish would be for the shuttle to go to different locations than just the mirage for drop off.

reviews.title: wonderful vacation
reviews.text: Great resort.  Staff was courteous and helpful. Room was clean and comfortable. The kitchen was stocked with everything we needed to have meals in the room. Grocery shopping was close by and fast food was nearby for times when we didn't want to cook. Easy location to get around Vegas.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: We decided to try this resort this year instead of our unit at the Grandview.  We were accompanied by another couple, liked the unit layout with the bedrooms and bathrooms on opposite ends of the living room.  Heated pool and hot tub were good size, and there were gas griils to use if wanted.  Very clean, though a few things like the kitchen cabinets could be updated.  Peaceful location away from the strip, and a grocery store and other conveniences were just a few minutes away.  Shuttles to the strip and Fremont Street were handy and the drivers friendly.  Would stay here again!

reviews.title: Above and beyond.
reviews.text: Let's just say that the General Manager at this property went above and beyond any kind of customer service I've experienced at any resort to accomodate me and my 8 months pregnant wife.  Everything was excellent top to bottom.

reviews.title: Peaceful and beautiful!
reviews.text: Best decision ever.  The staff are incredibly helpful and friendly.  I'd give them all a 6 if I could.  The hot tub is HOT, the pool is warm, and the gym is perfectly adequate.  Rooms were very clean and while not brand new, they were extremely well cared for.  We asked for a room with a gas fireplace and got a pool view which was really nice.  The layout of the complex is a little confusing at first.  Be patient and read your map correctly.  Some of the rooms require that you carry your stuff from your car a little way, and the steps are outside, so if that's a problem for you let them know so you can be accommodated.  We came to site-see and hike so none of it was a problem for us at all.  Added to the privacy in fact.  Lots of easy shopping right around here.  Took about 20 minutes to get into Vegas and there is tons of parking downtown so it was perfect.  The hiking out here is absolutely beautiful on so many levels.  So, if you want peace away from the strip yet close enough to enjoy it this is perfect for you.

reviews.title: Loved our stay here!
reviews.text: The room was bigger than we thought.  This timeshare has a larger kitchen & full sized laundry is is great. You get your numbered parking so you always know you have a spot close to your room. The pool/hot tub area is beautiful.  Even in January it was warm enough to get a sun tan & swim.

reviews.title: Peaceful vacation delivered at the Cliffs
reviews.text: Wonderful resort - quiet and excellent location to visit Red Rock Canyon, Death Valley, Valley of the Fire, and Hoover Dam. Shuttle bus to Fremont, Smiths, Casinos is helpful.  Staff (especially Richard at the Front Desk) , all helpful. Pool attractive, but not designed for lap swimming.  Health club machines perfect for light workout.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Resort was great! Just of the Strip. We used the resort shuttle (always on time). We went there to visit family and was also our first time in Vegas. Staff was helpful, checking in and out was a breeze. Our room felt like home. Overhaul great trip and would definitely recommend this resort. Thank You

reviews.title: Don't miss this gem
reviews.text: We simply had a fabulous week, the check in was clean & fast, Check out too.  Tons of smiles from the help desk and booked us into the "talk\" which looks like an amazing deal.  Pools are great, clean, lit, quiet.  The neighborhood is quiet and just a short drive to the strip.. Stay off the interstates and just use Tropicana or Flamingo to strip-it,

reviews.title: Great Las Vegas Resort
reviews.text: Stayed here several times and love this resort. I don't like high rise resorts (like on the strip). This is about 5 miles west of the strip. It is a 2 story resort, close to grocery and Walmart. Beautiful pool area, exercise room and a shuttle to the strip and other places. Set in a residential area, it is quieter than downtown and not so crowded. Very relaxing  resort.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: Check in a breeze and as described. Unit was clean and pleasantly furnished. Obvious upgrades so old kitchen cabinet doors didn’t bother me. I thought fireplace in LR was advertised yet there appeared to be a space for it yet none. Pool and spa were beautifully maintained.

reviews.title: units poorly maintained.
reviews.text: Units are not cleaned or maintained very well.  Lot of noise from road as units face roadway.  Bed was hard and noisy so made for a very disturbed sleep if anyone moved in the night.  Cupboard drawers falling apart.

reviews.title: Very nice location and unit
reviews.text: This is a nicely kept condo in an easy to access just outside of busy downtown area. Staff were exceptional and not only allowed us to check in early but also choose an upper or lower unit.  Unit was spacious, updated, and comfortable.

reviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: My sister and I took a week-long vacation together to Las Vegas, we stayed at the cliffs at Peace Canyon and had a wonderful time. There is a shuttle that will take you to the grocery store, the shopping center and to the strip. All of the staff took the time to get to know us and to ensure we were safe. Steve the shuttle driver made us laugh every day. The resort was clean and tidy with all the amenities you would need to make it to your home for a week.

reviews.title: Needs updating and rug removal
reviews.text: This resort would be a nice place if the unit did not smell so bad.  After reporting the smell, was told they could not change our unit.  Not sure I would go here again, not worth the points.  Even opened the windows and could not get rid of the smell

reviews.title: Excelent Resort
reviews.text: The room nery clean, Location central and close to storage. Very good experience, facilities and comfort. The impotent thing about a trip to the US is to be able to have access to the mall, parks, event zones, and this hotel fulfilled my expectations.

reviews.title: Peaceful vacation
reviews.text: We visited for the second time in 10 years ..very nice property and units away from busy Strip. We used resort shuttle and uber to go to Strip and avoided traffic. Enjoyed it very much .Beds comfortable.

reviews.title: Functional and Convenient
reviews.text: We stayed for a week and booked thinking that 6 people could stay comfortably in a 2 bedroom Unit.Well they can but in our case we enquired about  adding a 1 bed Unit so everybody was afforded the same level of privacy. The manager, Daniel, understood our situation and immediately with no fuss and absolute priority arranged additional accommodation.  Can't ask for anything better than that.The location is convenient if you have a car or avail yourself of the complimentary shuttle service to the Strip. It's quiet and being located close to Sumerlin  you have easy access to good shopping etc.

reviews.title: Enjoyable resort
reviews.text: Overall a pleasant experience.  I do not want to purchase a time share in Las Vegas.  It would have been helpful to know if the resort van did not transport to the airport only to Downtown locations and the strip.

reviews.title: NYE with the family
reviews.text: Great place! Spacious and quiet, full kitchens and baths. Staff is friendly, I would definitely stay here again. Not too far from the strip and away from the TRAFFIC!Several shopping centers nearby and restaurants. DVDs and board games available at the lobby. Great for the kids.

reviews.title: Find another place to stay.
reviews.text: Overrated... not worth of exchange. Staff was not helpful af check in when we had concerns about our stay! They said call RCI and see if they could help.... so we did and had no luck. The extra resort fee was a joke and would not refund it to us.

reviews.title: A getaway resort, far enough away from downtown Vegas to call it peaceful and close enough to visit the lights of VEGAS!
reviews.text: A getaway resort, far enough away from downtown Vegas to call it peaceful and close enough to visit the lights of VEGAS!

reviews.title: Nice place close to Red Rock Canyon and Las Vegas
reviews.text: The resort was nice.  The area has lots of restaurants and is close to Red Rock Canyon.  It's an easy drive to the strip as well.  The staff was helpful.  We were hoodwinked into listening to a timeshare presentation so beware when they offer you a free buffet.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: The hotel has seen better days. Many cracked tiles, faucet that leaked, refrigerator that leaked, no heat with the hair dryer. We used this as home base so did not spend hours there. Tile makes any movement but someone upstairs very loud for those downstairs. At one point we realized we could here the neighbors through the bedroom wall. Thank goodness they were not loud in the bedroom!

reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text: Not too many amenities but a nice resort with friendly staff and very convenient to the Las Vegas valley if you’re not “stripping” it every day. Though there is a shuttle that runs consistently every day all day.

reviews.title: Las Vegas at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Over all the place is nice. They do need to update some of the units with new appliances and pay more attention to cleaning the units and maintain the Jacuzzi better. the place gets pretty cold at night especially in fall or winter. its about 20 minutes from the strip so it is fairly quiet.

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: This location was great great rooms good facilities, staff helpful, shuttle to the strip drivers polite and helpful we had a good time with no real problems. The location was central although not on strip the shuttle to 15 minutes to get there and dropped of on good location and collect same spot and was regular.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: We liked everything about the resort. Front desk at 2 in the morning was very polite and cheery while we were checking in. Our Suite was perfect. Very, very clean. Huge walk in closet. Like really big. With plenty of hangers too. Big bathroom, full, nicely done kitchen, Big screen TV in living room. Large Table to eat at. Nice deck to watch the sunrise over Las Vegas before going to bed ;). I had only a couple complaints about the place. One was in the bathroom. The mirror was not placed well. The left side of the mirror frame was directly in front of the sink. So for me, while shaving, I had to lean to the right to see myself in the mirror. As you can see in the picture the light over the mirror is in the correct place, but the mirror is not centered under it if you catch my drift. I tried to slide it but it wouldn't budge. The only other complaint was the pillows. Not really comfortable. Not flat by any means but the fill in the pillows were all messed up inside. Needs better pillows, I think at least. Fix that and the place was great. We did not use the pool as it was pretty cold out. But it looked nice and the grounds were kept up really nicely. When you check in ask where the dumpster closest to your room is located. I had to walk around at 4 in the morning to find it while we were leaving for the airport.

reviews.title: So nice to escape from The Strip
reviews.text: We bought a unit at this timeshare years ago.  Although we had seen it, we never stayed there -- this was our first time.  We found it well maintained, spacious, comfortable, and quiet.  It was so nice to escape the noise and hustle & bustle of Fremont Street and The Strip.  We did not use any of the resort amenities or services -- we were too busy.  We did the usual Vegas stuff but did other activities, as well.We enjoyed being close to Red Rock Canyon.  We visited one day as a family and a couple of days later, our son went climbing there.  Another day, we visited Valley of Fire State Park.Although we had a full kitchen, we did little cooking.  We had good Mexican food at Juan's Flaming Fajitas very close by.  Claim Jumper at the Golden Nugget in the Fremont St neighborhood had good food -- we ate there twice.  I liked the Tri-Tip and had it both times.

reviews.title: Good Getaway
reviews.text: This was my second stay at the Cliffs of Peace Canyon and our experience was as pleasant as the first time.  The staff is friendly and helpful, the facility is clean and comfortable and the location is quiet, well maintained and convenient to all the sites of Las Vegas.

reviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: We have stayed here before and it was awesome again. The staff was friendly and accommodating and the few minor needs we had, the staff responded to our needs immediately. Plenty of shopping and things to do nearby and quick access to the strip if needed. Plan on visiting again.

reviews.title: Totally awesome resort and facility. Great amenities. Super customer service from all the staff. Our stay was wonderful.
reviews.text: Totally awesome resort and facility. Great amenities. Super customer service from all the staff. Our stay was wonderful.

reviews.title: Not a good place to stay.
reviews.text: Carpets were filthy and in need of shampoo.  Kitchen knives are all dull.  Room phone could not call the front desk or housekeeping.  Gas weed blower started every day at 9:00 AM outside our room.  Not good after a night out on the town.  Bed sheets were very old and worn out.  The place is just very old and in need of updating.  Bleach that was used in the bathroom was so strong that it took 3 days to air out the condo.

reviews.title: AMAZING property with a great location
reviews.text: This property was in  a great location, not too far from the strip and also within walking distance of restaurants and stores.  The unit themselves were very updated clean with all the amenities. They even had a free shuttle that will take you to this trip as well as to some of the major stores in the area. The staff was friendly and extremely helpful I’d like to point out Amber and the manager Daniel Edwards who are both amazing!

reviews.title: Will stay here every time in Vegas!
reviews.text: Amazing trip. If you need a relaxing and convenient place to stay off the strip this is the place for you! Quiet, beautiful and relaxing resort with absolutely everything you need! We enjoyed our vacation so much that I will only stay here next time in Vegas.

reviews.title: Peace and quiet at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Beautiful accommodations, large pool and hottub (but I didn't use it).  I chose it because it is close to the mountains for hiking and to get away from the crowds in the strip.  Plenty of restaurants around.  But the kitchen was large so I felt comfortable making something quick to eat inside.

reviews.title: Sister's week
reviews.text: The grounds were really nice.  Grills were super clean.  Condo had been partially updated.  Loved having a full kitchen and washer and dryer.  Loved the location, easy to get to the strip and the airport.

reviews.title: Very quiet and relaxing
reviews.text: This resort was great for my family because it was away from the strip and all the crazy things they have there but it was close enough that you could go there easily.  The pool area was awesome and the pool was heated.  the area was quiet and relaxing and our kids had a great time swimming.  If you want a Vegas vacation with the family I would highly recommend staying here.

reviews.title: golf trip
reviews.text: This is a nice place, great location - but needs some TLC....Very old.  Desk people were very helpful and friendly.  Coffeemaker is OLD - wouldn't work until we figured out that the plugs in the wall weren't working.  That needs to be taken care of.

reviews.title: Not your typical time share
reviews.text: I have been to a number of resorts and this one would be one of the better resorts. It is off the strip but a shuttle will take you to the strip and downtown. Access was easy and to get to anywhere in the city a freeway was close. The unit was very clean and had all of the amenities.

reviews.title: Peace away from The Strip
reviews.text: You can be in Vegas and experience the natural side and the showgirl side of the city at this resort. Easy access to the strip and downtown, quiet pool time and hiking opportunities nearby make this an ideal location. Our 2 bedroom unit was spacious and even had a washer/dryer in the unit.

reviews.title: Vegas Trip
reviews.text: Excellent Resort. It is not a very large place but it is clean, quiet and tastefully decorated. I recommend it for anyone who would like a nice clean quiet vacation away from the Strip. If you want to travel to other locations for side trips, I recommend renting a car.

reviews.title: Great location and value
reviews.text: The resort is located within 20 minutes of both the hotel and strip and it is also easy to get on the major freeways if you want to travel outside Vegas. We had a single bedroom unit with a great kitchen that had  all amenities including dishwasher.   Lots of closet space which was great.  Only complaint is that the shower head should be descaled or replaced.

reviews.title: Very Nice. Needs Some Updating.
reviews.text: Location for families is great...away from the strip and near shopping and restaurants. In N Out just around the corner along with Flaming Fajitas and many others. All shopping needs are within walking distance. This is a great resort if you are interested in hiking or climbing in Red Rock Canyon. Morning skies include hot air balloons. Resort staff extremely helpful in accommodating special needs. Kimrose was the best. Maintenance also helped my son pump up a flat tire so he could drive to a nearby tire repair facility. Can't say enough good things about the staff.

reviews.title: No Cliffs, No Peace, No Canyon
reviews.text: The resort is not located in a nice area, nor are there any views to speak of. A resort called "The Cliffs at Peace Canyon" implies that there are "cliffs" and/or a "canyon." There are neither. It's located in a residential neighborhood, surrounded by strip malls. It does not feel like a vacation. Also, there is no restaurant at the resort and the amenities are minimal.The unit smelled badly of smoke and we had to request a new unit. All units are supposed to be non-smoking. The next unit was okay, but not cleaned well, and the carpet was severely worn. There were sticky areas all over the kitchen countertops and shoe prints on the bathtub. We had to request that the cleaning staff re-clean the unit.The bathtub is extremely shallow and isn't a soaking tub or jacuzzi tub. The beds are extremely uncomfortable and cause pain and discomfort. There weren't enough blankets for the cold weather. There wasn't a single frying pan - just sauce pans - and only a metal spatula.If you hate the "hard sell," be prepared: Guests are forced to go to the "concierge" to get a "parking pass." The "concierge" is actually in sales (timeshare sales) and they'll give you a long spiel about how you have to pay $20 to attend a breakfast, and then you'll receive a gift card. They'll insist it's not related to timeshare sales and tell you it's an "owner perk" and "very informative." Then, they'll take your money and hand you a form that says (in capital letters, at the bottom) that it's for timeshare sales! This is not how we want to spend our vacation. Needless to say, we didn't go to the timeshare sales breakfast, but they refused to refund our $20.

reviews.title: A nice relaxed "at home" feel in Vegas
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our first ever trip to Vegas, and enjoyed having the comforts of home with a kitchen and two bedroom condo at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon.  We invited another couple to join us and had a great time doing outings (with our car) to Fremont St., the strip, Red Rocks Canyon.  We found it very comfortable, but would recommend having a rental car.

reviews.title: Excellent Vacation Location and venue
reviews.text: Wonderful peaceful, residential location; Great staff, service amenities. The heated pool was wonderful; the hot tub was wonderful. the accommodation were great. We had a unit by the pool. Fireplace and BBQ units were terrific.

reviews.title: Quiet and clean
reviews.text: Excellent place for a family. It is away from the bustle of the strip and quiet. Good internet reception. Comfortable bed. Well equipped kitchen. Laundry facilities are a plus. Everything you need for a get-a-way.

reviews.title: Vegas has casinos too?
reviews.text: Just spent a wonderful week at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon in Las Vegas. We took our 15 year old granddaughter and stayed on the go all week long. We visited Zion Nat. Park in Utah, Grand Canyon West Rim and the Skywalk (yikes!) in AZ, stayed overnight at Grand Canyon West Ranch, took a drive on historic Rte. 66, and toured Valley of Fire State Park just outside Vegas. Highly recommend all these places when vacationing in Vegas. Trust me, you won't have time to miss  the casinos!

reviews.title: Nice but old
reviews.text: Nice place but in need of updates. Also it seems like the resort is close to the Vegas Strip. But you almost always have to get on the interstate highway and that is nerve racking. In addition the shuttle has specified times and locations throughout the week and that should be noted. Again an ok place. Quite and everything worked. But it is outdated and for our unit the flooring was coming loose. Oh and no fans or ceiling fans so unless you open a window or turn off the heat it’s hot and stifling inside. View we had wasn’t as good as I’m sure other units enjoyed.

reviews.title: Don't jump (off the Cliffs) LOL
reviews.text: A quiet, restful place. Kept clean and customer friendly. The "documents Dirk's review mentioned are mostly involving a "time-share" tour that is optional. The bed (reviewed in Discover's review) was just fine. Mattress good, pillows satisfactory. The kitchen is well stocked and there is ample parking. We have been to numerous 'time share' resorts and this one is just fine. Special mention is deserved by the manager Daniel Edwards. He is efficient, professional and extremely helpful with any and all aspects of a vacation.

reviews.title: Rehab
reviews.text: I liked the place other than the dated furniture and how hard the bed was . I was there to Rehab from a surgery found it hard to get comfortable. I would have given this place a five if not for dated furniture.

reviews.title: Good resort but way too much documents at check in
reviews.text: Good and nice resort in a quite area of Las Vegas but way too much documents and a very long procedure ( 30+ minutes) just to check in. The units themselves are good and clean. We didn't use any of the resorts activities.

reviews.title: Off the strip
reviews.text: We like the quiet neighborhood location.  It is less hectic and more relaxed. You have access to all that Las Vegas has to offer, but you are away from the hectic passe of the strip. The pool is excellent and the work-out area is first rate.

reviews.title: Nice time
reviews.text: Great location,easy access to everything,car rental is best to get around. the shuttle was very helpful to get to strip and fremont.had a unit next to road which was a bit noisy of traffic. We thought widow was open. Everything else was great.

reviews.title: Short Sheeting allowed
reviews.text: need to upgrade sheets for Queen Beds. should keep check on heat maintainence front desk staff need to be aware of what the management has offered to guest for repairs to units and extra nights stay.thanks

reviews.title: Awesome Vacation!
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is so beautiful and comfortable!  The layout of the suite and the colors are very contemporary. The kitchen was much bigger than we thought it would be.  Very spacious living and bedrooms.

reviews.title: Not worth the exchange fee.
reviews.text: Check-in was nice.  Rooms not very clean.  Walls paper thin, could hear neighbors conversations quite easily.  Basically, just an apartment complex.  Pool was dirty and hot tub was out of order.  I left after 2 of my seven days.  Staff called me no less than 3 times in that 2 days to get me to listen to a timeshare sales pitch.  Save your exchange fee and find something different .

reviews.title: Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: Nice, clean, outside hussle bussle of downtown. Only 20 minutes from downtown. Only 20 minutes from Red Rock. Easy access to Highway. Made it easy to get around. Went to Hoover Dam and Valley of Fire also.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay!
reviews.text: We stayed a full week here and really enjoyed our time here.  But, do rent a car - Uber can get expensive.  The units are spacious and comfortable. Covered parking for your vehicle.  We enjoyed hanging out at the pool and the hot tub in October, something we are not used to being able to do!  There were also nice grills and eating area.  We tried to enjoy the outdoor fireplace, but it was a little chilly even with the fire going.  It's an easy drive to almost anywhere you want to go, the strip, Sam Boyd Stadium, Red Rock Canyon, etc.  They have a gym, but we did not use it.  We are members of Snap and there is one just a couple miles down the road that we enjoyed.

reviews.title: Nice off the strip resort
reviews.text: Enjoyed staying off the strip at this property.  Although the name, The Cliffs at Peace Canyon, would lead you to believe the resort is located in a canyon in the dessert, this is not the case.  The resort is in a populated residential area.  This being said, the resort atmosphere is calming and the staff responded to our needs promptly.  The pool we felt was a little small for the number of units, but the resort was not that busy while we were there so we had plenty of room.  The unit was comfortable and well furnished.  We will return to this resort again.  If you want a little distance between you and the strip, this is a good place to stay.

reviews.title: Excellent resort!!
reviews.text: The facilities are wonderful with everything you need to stay for a week or more..  The pool, hot tub and BBQ area was set up well and convenient to all rooms. Shuttle services to the strip, Walmart for groceries, etc were great.  Only recommendation would be for one more later return shuttle.  11:30 is early to come back from the strip or downtown.  Driver's were courteous and informative.  We will definitely return to this resort.

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a Fine Place to Stay
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a very nice place to stay. Large units with a full kitchen and washer and drier. Very clean and comfortable, with a pool, jacuzzi, and gas grills. About 7 miles west of the “Strip”, it is very quiet.  This was our second time staying there. We would definitely go back again.

reviews.title: Another Great Week at the Cliffs at Peace Canyion
reviews.text: The service was excellent as usual, The room was clean and roomy. Great access to golf courses, restaurants, strip, downtown and red rock casino. Red Rock canyon, Valley of Fire and Mt Charleston are close also. We love the location, very peaceful yet close to all the action.

reviews.title: Meeting friends in Vegas
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful and very comfortable.  Our friends were very impressed with the resort.  The swimming pool area was very clean and pristine.  The BBQ area was clean and ready for use.  The resort was within 15 min from the strip.

reviews.title: Vegas Wedding Stay
reviews.text: We stayed at the Cliff’s for a week while attending a wedding in Las Vegas.  The Resort is very clean, the pool area was very well maintained.  The unit we stayed in was very clean and well equipped.  The staff was very helpful and friendly.  It is a little far from the Las Vegas strip – but nice to come after a long day and relax in the hot tub. Walking distance to a Mall and restaurants.

reviews.title: casual comment
reviews.text: overall very satisfied with everything except a minor complaint of the housekeeping but even that is not a significant problem. Excellent location. convenient  for shopping but far enough from the strip which is provide a very quiet environment. The place is easy to fine and easy access to freeways.Even thou  our unit was on the street side, there was no significant noise that would bother us. Only regret was that we didn't get to use the pool because of cool weather but did used the gym.

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: It is a very pleasant place between Tropicana and Flamingo, that you can easily drive down to the strip. The rooms have been remodeled with nice décor. There is a washer/dryer that I didn't know that they had. The pool/spa had great hours and was a great place to relax. The gym looked very nice. All the local shops that you need for food and otherwise are very close. They have a shuttle service to the strip and Fremont Street. Wish I could have stayed longer and will definitely return.

reviews.title: 2nd time there
reviews.text: For me, being away(20 minutes) from the strip, and in a low rise, low key facility with parking literally steps from your unit and amenities is a big plus.We also felt very safein the upscale Sumerline area. Red Rock Canyon and Red Rock casino 3 exits up the freeway.

reviews.title: The Cliffs is really Peaceful
reviews.text: We wanted a place off the strip area since we wanted to see the real beauty that Las Vegas had to offer beyond the Strip experience.  It was a great base for many wonderful sights in the area.  Red Rock Canyon and the Valley of Fire National parks.  The resort offers the shuttle to the strip for the moments you would like some nightlife and take in a show or two.   The units were very comfortable and family friendly.  I would love to stay here again when we return next time to Vegas.  Staff was great and very helpful.   Just ask and they are more than willing to help.  They offer outstanding customer service with a smile.

reviews.title: perfect...for us!
reviews.text: Wanted a quiet week in Vegas, but still be able to enjoy the Strip.  This is the perfect place for it - only 10 -15 min. from the Strip (by car; free shuttle available from this resort, which we did not use).  Resort is quiet, pool small but hot tub available too.  Staff courteous and helpful; no hard-sell for timeshares!  Unit was available earlier than expected; clean, spacious, well-stocked.  No complaints with TVs (three in our 2br unit).  Only issue: custodian's noisy trolley early morning (we did have our windows open, since the weather was not too hot nor cold...).  Neighbourhood a lot more developed since our last visit over five years ago - more stores and restaurants - which is not a bad thing.  Close to Red Rock canyon, highway #215, golf courses.  Hoover Dam less than an hour.

reviews.title: Great resort. Beware $70 week fee...for nothing.
reviews.text: This is a real nice resort in a great area. Close to Sedona, Jerome and Cottonwood is a nice town. The units are exceptionally nice. The resort pool area is great.Staff was very nice and helpful. Only drawback that I saw was no in unit laundry facilities and a $70 week fee that gets you nothing.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: We had a nice time. Likely to plan another trip to this great location.Nice amenities as well.   Ummmmmmmmmmm hmmmmmm. Yep thats about all I have to say about the cliffs at peace caynon located in the city of Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Underwhelmed
reviews.text: We traded some top drawer RCI points for a week at this resort. Don’t be fooled by the name. They are not anywhere in a canyon, or anywhere with a view. It is a bunch of converted condos in a shabby residential area. The unit was seriously in need of updating and maintenance....peeling paint, worn furniture with unrecognizable stains, mold in the bathrooms. To their credit, the beds were comfortable and linen clean and sweet-smelling and the staff were very friendly and helpful. We did enjoy the whirlpool at the end of days of golf and hiking.This could be a nice alternative to The Strip if they would invest some money and manpower, but it is by no means a Gold Crown resort.

reviews.title: RCI resort comes through
reviews.text: This is a little out of the way from the strip, but they have good shuttle service if you don't have a vehicle. It off of a main strip that includes box stores, super markets, restaurants, massage places, hair salons, etc. The resort has a nice pool and the condo we had for a week was clean and spacious. Some of it was a bit worn, but we have had plenty of experience with RCI resorts and so know that these condos get a lot of use. We appreciated the full sized washer and dryer and used them. Our coffee machine wasn't working and housekeeping brought us a new one within the hour. We arrived earlier than check-in time and the front desk worked diligently to get us into our condo as soon as possible. All in all a great experience.

reviews.title: Family get-a-way destination
reviews.text: The cliffs is a great location to visit! It makes for a great hub to travel day trips to the coast, Death Valley, Grand Canyon, others... getting downtown is an easy commute. Having the home accommodations makes it cost effective to be able to cook while traveling!

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Pleasantly surprised with location and availability of anything needed nearby. Resort was well taken care of and all needs were met. Courtesy van was a life saver to the strip and Freemont due to traffic, parking and knowledge

reviews.title: Nice area of Vegas away from the strip
reviews.text: Second time staying at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon. We love the area out in the west of Vegas.The resort provides service to the Strip and Freemont street as well as for some grocery shopping if you require. We had our own vehicle so we also did some touring around Red Rock Canyon and some near-by golfing, all was great!  The room is well equipped for cooking up some of your own meals. The Barbeque area is located out near  the pool and hot tub area, so bring all your supplies down with you and eat outside if you like, or you will have to run it back up to your room and eat there. Each room had a small balcony as well which was nice.There is nearby shopping and restaurants in the area, some which we walked to - about 10mins. We will likely return for a third visit.

reviews.title: Wonderful resort Off the strip
reviews.text: It was very nice to have a quiet, relaxing place 8 miles off the strip to stay with our 2 preteens.  Shuttle service was super helpful and allowed us to not have to rent a car.  Pool was warm and hot tub is huge!

reviews.title: More than The Strip
reviews.text: If you come to Vegas primarily for the glitz and hype of The Strip this is probably not where you want to be. But if you want to take day trips to Hoover Dam, Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire etc. And have a car, then it is ideal.The units are spacious and well equipped. We had a 2 bedroom; bedrooms at opposite ends of the unit.Noise from the upstairs unit was our only complaint, but it can be really annoying.We had 1 small maintenance issue and it was attended to immediately.The shuttle downtown is useful but you must book ahead and be flexible on timing.We had a rental car and found free parking available at some casinos (Treasure Island.)The “gift” options for enduring the timeshare sales pitch were well worth the pain.Very attractive pool and spa area.  Excellent gas bbqs but a long way from our unit.

reviews.title: Wonderful, quiet resort in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed at the Cliffs so that we could enjoy what Las Vegas offers without being in the middle of all of the craziness on the strip.  The resort is located about 20 minutes from the strip and provides a quiet escape from the hustle and bustle of Vegas.  A shuttle is provided by the resort that will take you to the strip every hour from 10 AM until 1130 PM.  This is a big plus so that you don't have to drive in the crazy traffic and try to find parking.  The resort is located near shopping, restaurants, etc.   The resort staff are very friendly and helpful and responsive to our needs.

reviews.title: Quiet resort
reviews.text: This resort had fresh paint nice furniture well stocked kitchen. Location about 15/20 minutes from the strip. Uber home from strip was $17. Resort provides a shuttle that we used twice. Nice outdoor patio. We stayed on second floor and never were bothered with noise from street or neighbors. Red Rock Canyon only twenty minute and it’s a beautiful park. I would recommend this location to others wanting to visit the area without noise and crowds on the strip.

reviews.title: Quiet and laid-back accomodations
reviews.text: This was our first time at The Cliffs, but we will definitely put it at the top of our list for future visits. It is an easy drive to the Strip, but far enough away to feel relaxed. It doesn't have a lot of extras, like activities for kids, but the pool and hot tub are nice. Our 2-bedroom unit is spacious and well laid out for the two of us. I would recommend it if you are mainly looking for a jumping-off place for your explorations of Las Vegas and the surrounding areas, and a place to rest and recover for your next outing.

reviews.title: Our trip  and stay at Peace Canyon in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Although the resort was older it was kept up very well.  We requested a handicap suite because our daughter-in-law had broken her ankle and could not walk.  That was cheerfully provided.  We also had an issure with the clothes dryer and it was fixed within 30 minutes of our reporting it. Great staff!

reviews.title: Relaxing vacation
reviews.text: The Cliffs has always provided a home like atmosphere for the years we have been there. The nice abour rhis place you are not subjected to the pace of Vegas  and they provide a shuttle to the strip and old town. Very comfortable units  Do wish they would use Teflon cooking pots and Pans

reviews.title: Peace and Relaxation
reviews.text: As an older couple, we still love the Vegas strip and shows, but not 24/7. This resort's location is great for quiet time and relaxing while still being close to easy routes anywhere by car, or take their convenient shuttle to shopping and the Strip. We had a wonderful experience.

reviews.title: Convenient location
reviews.text: Booked a 2 bedroom unit through an RCI exchange. Check-in was very quick although they do send you to the concierge who offers the sale presentation. Although we said no, someone will put a flyer in your door the next day that states that you get a gift when presenting the flyer to the concierge. It is just an opportunity to offer the sales presentation again, although they will give you some discount coupons for shows in Vegas. The staff was friendly and helpful.The rooms don't have much of a view although some have a pool view. They do have covered parking. The grounds are kept clean.The living space consisted of a living room and dining room. The living room had a corner sleeper sofa, chair, table, and large screen tv. The dining area had a large table with 6 chairs. The kitchen is well stocked and has plenty of space. There is also a washer/dryer just off the kitchen. The master bedroom has a kingsize bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, and tv. There is a large bathroom with a shower/tub and a very large walk-in closet with a safe. The 2nd bedroom had a queen bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, and tv. The 2nd bathroom, with a walk-in shower is accessible form the living room but just outside the 2nd bedroom. There were plenty of towels/pool towels in the bathrooms as well as some toiletries. The unit also had a small patio with a table and 2 chairs. A maid does come in for a midweek towel exchange.There is a pool and a hot tub.  The pool is a saltwater pool (tasted like it anyway) and 4 ft in depth. It was kept clean. There is plenty of seating, with both lounge chairs and tables and chairs. Some shade can be found via umbrellas and palm trees. There is also a small gym with some basic equipment. Although there aren't activities that take place at the resort, there is a schedule for a shuttle that takes guests to the Vegas strip (the Mirage), Fremont St. and Red Rock Casino throughout the day. They keep to the schedule that they put out. There's not much in the way for kids to do,The Cliffs are in a convenient location to much that Vegas has to offer. Located between Tropicana and Flamingo Avenues, both take you east to the strip, about  20-25 minutes by the resort shuttle. Going west, you are about 15 minutes from Red Rock Canyon which has a neat 13 mile scenic drive. The National Park Pass is accepted here. All around the resort are shops and restaurants. Interstate 215 is a couple of minutes away which makes for a convenient trip to the airport or if heading to Hoover Dam.Nice place to stay if your looking to stay out of the hustle and bustle (traffic) of the strip, but close enough to enjoy the entertainment that the strip has to offer.

reviews.title: plenty of space!!!
reviews.text: The 2 bedroom unit ALSO HAS A MURPHY BED IN THE LIVINGROOM!  The kitchen was nicely stocked with adequate pans. The pools were very nice.  the resort is accessible to 3-4 major Canyons: Zion, Cedar Breaks, Snow and Bryce Canyons.

reviews.title: Week away from the Mayhem.
reviews.text: The week at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon went very well. It is far enough away from the strip that it is very relaxing. The rooms are very nice. The pool is well kept and the BBQ grills were in great shape. We visited Red Rock Canyon which is only about 15 minutes away. If you are inter3ested in gambling the Red Rock Casino is only about 10 minutes away. Did have one small issue and Daniel the manager could not have been more accommodating. He really does care about his guest.

reviews.title: Sales presentation was handled wrong
reviews.text: resort is quiet and relaxing. But after check in you are referred to another desk that pushes the sales breakfast on you and want your money up front,then informs you to drive 40 min in rush hour traffic to be told that breakfast is over  and they do not want to give you your money back.. This is wrongI have 3 time shares, and know how it works. This was the worst...

reviews.title: Parking
reviews.text: The only problem I find is that some of the spots around the property should have more handicap spots so we don't continually have to look for a vacant spot near where the rooms are. Out by the pool maybe you could put 2 more tables with umbrellas as there is not enough shaded places to hide from the sun.

reviews.title: Away from the strip
reviews.text: quiet resort away from the strip. You will need a car........................................................................Not a large resort like your Marriots or Hiltons but quaint and quiet (If your on the 2nd floor ). It's located about 25 minutes from the strip, and there is a shuttle, ( very friendly drivers )

reviews.title: Trip to Las Vegas
reviews.text: We enjoyed being off the strip but close enough to drive (easy drive).  The resort also had a shuttle bus that offer trips to the strip and to another casino.  The pool and hot tub were great and people were very friendly.  There were many restaurants and shopping in the area.

reviews.title: A relaxing vacation with all the excitement you want.
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our time at The Cliffs.  Our 2 bedroom condo was comfortable and quiet.  The layout of the grounds is smart and the pool area is awesome.  We used the pool and spa more here than we ever have on any other vacation. The free shuttle to the Vegas Strip is great and the drivers are all personable and knowledgeable.

reviews.title: Great to be off of the Strip
reviews.text: The Cliffs is a resort  that is 8 miles from the Strip therefore it is much quieter and more homey'. My wife and I enjoyed the quiet and proximity of the front desk, pool etc. There were plenty of stores and restaurants near-by, very close to Red Rock Canyon (tell Uber and others that the resort id on S. Grand Canyon (entrance) as google puts them on Peace Way. We would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: At Peace by the Strip
reviews.text: The 1 bedroom was great and near th pool. Although about 20min from the strip - the free shuttle service helped avoid finding parking and avoiding traffic. It would have been nice to get shuttle service from the airport. Amenities like pool and fitness center was great especially they has long operations of operation - a dip in hot tub at midnite was relaxing.

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: This is a nice condo style place to stay if you want to be away from the Strip. It us quiet and fully stocked in the kitchen with cooking/eating utensils. The rooms are clean and the workers friendly. They do gave a shuttle but a car is a must if you want to look around.

reviews.title: It is not quite as we remembered on previous visit
reviews.text: If staying more than 1 week the second weeks clean is left till late in the day even though they were cleaning units in the same block as ours they took priority as they were for new check-ins. And if like us are wanting to go out for the evening you would not be able to start getting ready until after  4 :00pm. We also had a call from reception regarding our second weeks resort fee which had been forgotten to be charged to our credit card at 7:50am which when on holiday who wants to be disturbed at that time in the morning.We did mention these problems and this was resolved by the resort manager and we had our fee for the second week refunded (THANK YOU)

reviews.title: Best of both worlds: close to action or great to relax
reviews.text: An easy drive to Red Rock Casino or use their free shuttle to Strip/grocers (if driving, staff provides a list of free vs paid Strip parking sites).  When ready to relax, resort is peaceful (no pun intended) with lots of trees/shrubs to give homey feeling.  Noted many guests  used their balconies for morning coffee, complimentary in the lobby.  Staff all so friendly & smiling, whether working inside or outdoors.  Noticed our 1 bdrm had been nicely refurbished since our last stay (our 3rd time here).  Comfy bed & LOTS of towels (kudos) so declined the midweek complimentary restock & cleaning.  Great TV reception (a vast improvement) & covered parking.  Large pool with plenty of shaded seating available.  Resort fee only $25 for entire week, so much less than Vegas norm.  We'll come back again!

reviews.title: Great Quiet Place for a Vacation
reviews.text: The Cliffs provides a great atmosphere for relaxing. The room was very clean and well equipped. The amenities were very nice (pool,hot tub,workout room,grills) The staff was very friendly and helpful. Had a problem with washer and dryer when we checked in and the maintenance crew got right on it and fixed the problem in a very timely manner.  WELL DONE.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: Loved  the the location off the Strip just a short drive  to the strip. Will stay again Close to everything. Red Rock , The Strip, Good Food, Shopping, quiet Neighborhood, Well Maintained, Nice POOL. Awsome pool Hours. Very well kept

reviews.title: A nice facility
reviews.text: Located away from the strip, but with regular shuttle service and easy to get Ubers.  Room was clean and comfortable, staff was helpful.  It was nice being in a residential area, away from the noise of the Strip.

reviews.title: Very nice and pretty resort. Very clean!!
reviews.text: The workers are very nice. They always have a smile on their faces. They are ready to help you in any way they can. The rooms are very clean and nice makes you feel like home.  Easy to get in and out. close to the shopping mall.

reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: We spent a week here with friends. We each had a 1 bedroom.  The resort was quiet and clean!  Nice pool area with bbqs if you wanted to stay and cook.  The 1 bedroom had a king bed and plenty of room in the living area.  The kitchen is well stocked with what is needed for cooking etc.  A shuttle runs to the strip, Fremont St, outlet mall, groceries.  There is no shuttle to the airport.  You do have to plan and book the shuttle in advance though.  They charge a resort fee of $25 for this service and use of the small fitness area.  Each unit has a covered parking stall if you have a car.  We stayed here to explore around the Vegas area.  Red Rock Canyon is about a half hour away.  We all loved the place and would definitely book again.  Friendly staff too.

reviews.title: Awesome timeshare
reviews.text: As owners of the Cliffs since 2002 we have never been disappointed. It is away from the strip hotelsToward the mountains in a beautiful area- chock full of stores & restaurants. Free shuttle to the strip & Fremont street. It is only about 15 minutes to  Las Vegas Blvd- so it’s a piece of cake to see a show or visit the many hotel/casinos. We usually rent a car & visit the local casinos  (Red Rock , Suncoast  & Rampart ) right nearby which are great!

reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: We bought at Peace Canyon before it was built. It is perfect for being close to the strip but not being too close. The facility the condo was like being at home. The cleanliness was wonderful.  The pool  area  was great for 100* weather

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Just god awful.  I highly advise you don't choose this place. The service was horrible from the moment we arrived.  There isn't much amenities on-site.  The room was ok but have seen better.  The shuttle is a joke...just trust me.  Don't go

reviews.title: Very nice place to stay!
reviews.text: The staff was wonderful - especially the check-in and out clerks. The availability of a shuttle to and from the strip was awesome and very much appreciated. The apartment was great. Beds were really comfortable. Sound proofing adjoining bedroom walls would have been ideal, but otherwise we had a terrific experience.

reviews.title: Clean comfort and relaxation
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed for a week at the Cliffs.  We chose after Labor Day to (hopefully) limit the number of small children and families.  We had a nice, relaxing time -  pool time during the day, casinos and shows at night.  I liked that it wasn't real close to the strip or downtown, as I enjoy a more "local" experience.  Plenty of shopping for anything you need nearby, as well as other off-strip casinos where I think the odds are better.  Next time, we hope to stay two weeks!

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: We decided to stay here instead of our normal resort with no regrets. Glad we had a rental. Great staff room and grounds!check in was a breeze and rooms were super homey and clean.would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.title: Wonderful Resort!
reviews.text: Would definitely go back! Friendly, helpful staff provided prompt, excellent service round the clock. Our two-bedroom, two-bathroom suite with kitchen, living room, dining area and washer/dryer room greatly accommodated my wife, daughter, two grandchildren and I. The pool, landscape, jacuzzi, bbq area, fitness center, recreation room and lounge were clean and welcoming!

reviews.title: Excellent Resort!
reviews.text: My husband and I had a great time at The Cliffs. We appreciate the high maintenance of our room, pool and the Resort! The staff made us feel like home.  We will definitely return soon. Thank you!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text: My family and I enjoyed our week stay (2bdrm & 1bdrm) at this beautiful property.  Both Condos were clean & spacious with walk in closets & fully stocked kitchens. The resort grounds are beautifully manicured. Staff was EXCEPTIONAL!! Shot out to Jasmine at the Reservation Desk, Both Steve and the AA Shuttle Driver (forgot his name) for taking great care of us all week back & forth to Smith's & The Mirage & JP at the Concierge Desk. Free Shuttle to & from the Las Vegas Blvd,  Fremont Street, Grocery Store & Walmart. Plenty of parking for private vehicle. Patio with multiple grills near the pool. Perfect location away from the Strip & Airport but close enough to get there without hassle.  Very peaceful & pleasant. We highly Recommend this beautiful place!!!!**Management should Consider Daily Activities such as Karaoke Night, Poolside Paint Night, etc to encourage customers to choose this beautiful property **

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: The resort was based about 4 miles from the strip but offers a free courtesy bus up to midnight making this an ideal location for a Vegas trip. Would thoroughly recommend this resort to anybody thing of visiting Vegas.

reviews.title: Nice quiet resrort
reviews.text: I would recommend this resort for anyone wanting to stay in the Vegas area without the strip feel to it. It was clean, nice and quiet. It was conveniently located to the Red Rock Canyon park where we went hiking.

reviews.title: peace and comfort
reviews.text: this place is comfortable clean well maintained. being far from the Strip means it is restful and quiet. I have stayed here several times and intend to return again as my go to get away. the pool hot tub and exercise equipment are family friendly.

reviews.title: Quiet & Comfortable place!
reviews.text: Very pleasant stay, the facilities and Room were clean. Staff was nice 👍 would stay here again. Close to shopping and restaurants. We enjoyed the pool and Jacuzzi, met a lot of nice people. Quiet and comfortable a hop skip and a jump from the strip.

reviews.title: great time
reviews.text: resort was clean and peaceful very quiet at night, 1 bedroom was very large and clean with washer and dryer in room (made life easier),provided shuttle service to downtown Las Vegas, pool was very nice and refreshing for temps greater than 100 degrees. staff very helpful and friendly. provided covered parking for cars to keep from getting hot.resort close drive to downtown las vegas.has everything needed close by resort,plenty of food places to eat, even found fillipino food close by. over all great place to stay in las vegas will definitely return

reviews.title: A true vacation
reviews.text: The location and the condition of grounds and unit are wonderful ..accessible to almost anything one might want to do and yet away from the "hurly=burly" of too much noise, cars etc. Units well equipped, nicely decorated and contain everything you need.

reviews.title: We had a great time at the cliffs
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at the cliffs. Just the right distance from the strip. Close enough to get there in 15 minutes or less and far enough away to not be caught up in. Any traffic   The grounds are very nice.  Grills are awesome as is the pool and hot tub the 2 bedroom suite was spacious clean and quiet.

reviews.title: Great for those not wanting to be too close to the strip
reviews.text: Very clean pool, awesome BBQs, spacious units.  These were all we needed for a very relaxing stay in the sun.   We had a rental car, if you want to be back and forth from the strip a lot, consider getting a car.  The shuttle was frequent to the strip and grocery store so you could easily get by without one. Close to red rocks casino and area.

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: The condo was great.  Staff was amazing.  They made sure that we were well taken care of  Shuttle bus to Vegas was a plus.  The drivers were very nice.  Very close to Red Rock Canyon and Hoover Dam.  We drove to Sedona (5 hours) and Utah (Zion National Park (2 1/2 hours).  Rollin Smoke bbq, Juan's flaming fajitas, and Rise and Shine were great restaurants close by.

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: We attended the location for a five day trip.  We were immediately impressed by the professional and courteous staff which greeted us.  The resort and room was very clean and well organized in every aspects.  The room was more a spacious apartment/condo where one could cook on a daily basis with even an outside bbq area.  The only negative aspect found was the 20 minutes distance from the strip which cranked up an unpleasant taxi bill.  The shuttle service was from 10am to 11pm which to most people should have sufficed but due to shows and events we had to take expensive taxis instead of the shuttle as we had planned to do.  In conclusion, this is a great and peaceful resort away from the strip.

reviews.title: Nice place away from the crowds.
reviews.text: We enjoyed the quiet area with little traffic.  Free shuttle is great, although it is 20-25 minutes to the strip.  Only issue here is that the floors are frame construction and if you are on a 1st floor unit you will hear folks clomping on your ceiling.  Our first night, they were doing so at 2am and again at 4am and we got very little sleep.  Next day we asked for a 2nd floor unit and were accommodated without argument.  After that we enjoyed our stay.

reviews.title: Relaxing and peaceful
reviews.text: We own a week here and have come most years over the last 17 or so. Love the fact that it is about 9 miles off the Strip. There is a free shuttle for Smiths, Mirage, Fremont Street and Walmart but times vary and must be booked in advance on the day. This is a great service and we take full advantage of the convenience and reliability now that the hotels charge for Strip parking.The staff here are truly lovely and go out of their way to make us feel special. Nothing is too much trouble and we cannot thank them all enough for their superb service and thoughtfulness each trip. The condos are spacious and well equipped. The beds are very comfortable and any maintenance issues are dealt with promptly. We love to chill and relax around the pool but weekends can be busy and noisy from children jumping and splashing as they have fun. I choose to avoid these days and venture out instead. Altogether a great resort and we are looking forward to next time. A big thank you to everyone for looking after us so well - Daniel (manager), Jasmine, D and Amber on the front desk, Steve and Rocky the drivers and Jose for keeping the pool area immaculate and Vincent for all his help with our luggage!

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: As first timers to Vegas, we wasn't sure what to expect upon arriving. Given this was a family vacation, we were looking for something away from the hustle and bustle of the strip and a little more kid friendly and quiet. Although this complex is just about 20 minutes from the strip it gives a secluded feeling with easy access to any major shopping you might need. We opted for a vehicle since we were not sure what adventures we might get into but it certainly was not needed. We do however feel like the money spent was well worth the cost as the shuttle to and from the resort is limited. Within a 3 minute drive from the resort were a number of restaurants, a grocery store, & a shopping center. A short 20 minute drive in any direction could get to you all the attractions both on and off the strip. Rooms were quiet and spacious. We were provided all the necessities to make our stay comfortable with little more needed. The pool was quiet and easily accessible from any room in the complex. This was the first time I booked a trip using my RCI timeshare and was very pleasantly surprised at how easy it was. We would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: A week's vacation at Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Located west of Las Vegas Blvd, it is a compact and well maintained facility.   Easy to get to as it's just west of the 215 freeway and Tropicana Blvd. intersection.  The buidings are solidly built; we did not hear anything from the adjacent units.  The only down side was the Wi-Fi service, which the excellent manager struggled to get functioning, but it never quite got there, at least during the time we were there.

reviews.title: Love this property --The Cliffs at  Peace Canyon is a peaceful and beautiful  property.
reviews.text: Have stayed here more than 10 years now every August.   Great property for couples  - the 2 bedrooms offer privacy (one room at each end of units with bathrooms for each bedroom).   Very very clean units and property !   Can't rate it high enough !

reviews.title: One of the best places I have ever stayed! If you are entitled to military benefits this is an amazing value.
reviews.text: One of the best places I have ever stayed! If you are entitled to military benefits this is an amazing value.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Trip
reviews.text: Very nice resort. Friendly staff, clean units, nice pool.  Very convenient to shops, restaurants, and activities.  Nice covered on-site parking available and daily free shuttle bus to the strip.  Staff did not try to pressure us into listening to a time share pitch which was very nice.  We have stayed here before and would stay again.

reviews.title: Off the strip, friendly staff, clean
reviews.text: The Cliffs were very open to any of our needs. The staff, the shuttle driver were just excellent. The pool was open till midnight, but they allowed our kids to keep playing sometimes until 1:30 AM!!! They loved that., Check in was a bit of a pain and this is why I am rating it a 4. After check in you have to go over to RCI guy/girl to get your parking pass. There is no mention of why he is asking you questions but in the end you are signed up for a 4 hour Time-share sales pitch. I hate when they do this. The time share  was for south point, and they made us drive there ourselves. 10 miles or so. Truth be told we would probably buy another time-share but I did not like being tricked into it

reviews.title: Beautiful and Quiet
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort, in the middle of a residential area close to the mountains. Unlike the bright lights, crowds and noise of the Las Vegas Strip this is a very comfortable, family friendly, relaxing place. There is free shuttle service to/from the "Strip" when you want to join the party. It is also very easy to get to the areas natural attractions by car from this location. Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Great place for family stay
reviews.text: Friendly and helpful staff.. shout out to Tim the pool boy for answering all my son's questions about what he was doing and why why why 👍 The staff were responsive and got us a pack and play in less than 10 min.  The unit was clean, pull out couch mattress still had the plastic on the mattress, washer, dryer, dishwasher, all worked.  Easy parking, nice facility, perfect separation from the craziness of the strip.

reviews.title: Second visit to this resort.
reviews.text: The rooms are clean and well maintained. The staff was very helpful. My family really enjoyed the pool. I would definitely recommend this resort to friends and family. The location is convenient to the strip but just far enough away to avoid the craziness. Our unit had 2 bedrooms and 2 baths which was perfect for our family.

reviews.title: nice Vacation
reviews.text: Overall the resort was very nice. A great vacation. Will come again. Enjoyed the quiet, and relaxing space. shopping in the area was nice. close to Freeways, And away from all the hustle and bustle of the Strip.

reviews.title: West side - far from the crowds.
reviews.text: We stayed here for a few days.   The place is really nice, we had a two bedroom unit just for the two of us, so comfort-wise, was much more than we needed.  Our suite was well-appointed, with the exception of having virtually no view other than the parking lot.  That was fine anyway, we usually got rolling early every day.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
reviews.text: Cliffs is a calm and tranquil location that provides rest and relaxation, not frackers from the strip. Amenities and facility are in prestine condition.  Pool and common areas provide great family fun.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: The resort was nice and the staff was very friendly.   The unit could of been cleaned better.   The unit had a full size washer and dryer but, the dryer stained my clothes.  The pull out sofa still had dirty sheets on it.

reviews.title: Roomy comfort with easy access to Strip
reviews.text: We have stayed at several other hotels and time shares in Las Vegas, but this was our first time at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon. It is in a residential area away from the hustle and bustle, but The Cliffs provides hourly free shuttle transportation to and from several casinos and the local grocery store. We enjoyed our spacious one bedroom apartment unit.

reviews.title: Vegas vacation
reviews.text: The facility was great. We have now stayed at resort two years in a row.  When we plan our next vacation to Las Vegas we will make it a point to stay at this facility. Check in was easy and staff was very helpful.

reviews.title: Nice quiet location
reviews.text: The resort facility was very nice and in a quiet location. The rooms were clean. Nice appliances. Nice pool, but small. We cooked most of our meals there so we appreciate the clean grills. We enjoyed our stay, but wasn't able to access Wi-Fi  majority of the time at resort.

reviews.title: Great property away from strip
reviews.text: This property was outstanding, clean, well equipped, spacious, with nice grounds and pool area. Located away from the strip so nicely accessible to Las Vegas as well as Red Rock Canyon state park. 2 couples went there and enjoyed the stay.

reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: The entire facility was clean and nice. The staff was friendly. We took the shuttle to the Strip, but we found that we enjoyed the other things to do in the area more. Red Rocks National Conservation Area is close by, and we loved hiking in the area. My only complaint is the resort fee charged for WiFi.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Came to a seminar in Vegas and wanted to stay off the Strip.  This location is close to the beautiful national park that next time we will go and hike.  Easy to get to the strip - 20 minute drive, but worth not being in the downtown crush and no big fees!  Very enjoyable stay.

reviews.title: Excellent - Wonderful
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful 2 bedbroom/2 bath condo.  Everything was clean and very spacious.   The pool and gym were nice and in quite environment but not far the strip.  Did not need a vehicle provided transportation to local casinos and stores to but groceries.  Would return without hesitation.

reviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: GREAT Resort, not far from the strip, staff was great, got to check in early, nice pool, felt safe, security on site, resort not crowded, would like to have seen a place to get drinks/food on the property and would stay again...Unit was clean, kitchen cabinets a little outdated, but other than the outdated cabinets, great place to stay and especially to bring the family...

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: The Cliffs At Peace Canyon was a great family friendly spot.  Our unit was very clean, spacious and inviting.  The pool was crystal clean and stayed open late offering a nice swim after your day of adventures.  We loved the location for its proximity to Red Rock Canyon, Hoover Dam and Death Valley National Park.  You can easily, take a full day and hit many of the prime locations in Death Valley including Badwater Basin (282 feet below sea level).  On the way back,  we stopped in Rhyolite, a historic true ghost townsite, complete with a home made out of glass bottles (very unique)!    Of course, being only a short drive to The Vegas Strip is nice, too.  The resort offers multiple pick ups/drop offs if you do not wish to drive.  We caught a couple shows and  the obligatory buffet (highly recommend The Wicked Spoon in The Cosmopolitan).  As well seasoned RCI travelers,  we enjoyed and recommend The Cliffs at Peace Canyon for those who wish to enjoy not only The Vegas Strip but other locations in this beautiful part of our country.

reviews.title: Stewart family
reviews.text: My family and I really enjoyed this resort.    Very clean and the staff was attentive to our needs.   The shuttle bus takes you to and from the strip, Fremont Street, Walmart.   Steve, one of the drivers, is very knowledgeable about Las Vegas and soooo friendly.

reviews.title: Too much driving
reviews.text: The locations is 20 to 30 min from the strip or downtown and not okay when you are tired. The service not so good. I did not like cleaning service noving personal belogings to others places as stated in their documents.

reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: We had a great time.  The one drawback would have been if we were assigned a second floor condo (we had a first floor one) as it would have been hard ro carry everything to second floor with no elevator.

reviews.title: An enjoyable experience in spite of some minor details.
reviews.text: Update accessories such as DVD Players and Movies, and provide accurate information about cleaning services and times for events and services. We are overall pleased with our ownership and plan to return with the intent of recruiting the candidates for membership.

reviews.title: Skip the strip
reviews.text: Want to get away from terrible Vegas traffic? The western edge of the city (cities) has everything nearby and the drive to the strip is down one or two main roads (Flamingo or Tropicana). Also, the best Indian buffet is only blocks away (by McDonald's on Flamingo (lunch 7 days a week with no weekend price increase).

reviews.title: Quiet Timeshare nestled in Residential Area
reviews.text: If you love Las Vegas but do not want to stay on the strip, this is a great alternative.  This property is clean and very quiet at night.  Assigned parking spaces guarantee you will have a place to park 1 vehicle.  It is very close to a nice grocery store, gasoline, and other shopping.  It's not far from Red Rock Casino and Resort.  It is about 6 miles west of the strip - so - not that far from the

reviews.title: Off the Strip Gold Nugget
reviews.text: This Resort is wonderful. The rooms are clean, the pool is wonderful and the shuttle bus makes going to the strip or downtown easy. It was very relaxing and will be there again. The Freemont excursion is well worth the time. People watching is unreal.

reviews.title: Friendly staffs, very clean & peaceful place
reviews.text: The place is very secluded and clean.  Although it was scourging hot, the kids enjoyed their time in the pool.  It's very close to everything you want to do (trips to the Strip, Canyons or grocery stores - even Walmart is closeby) and yet very peaceful, just what we needed on this mini trip.Unit is well stuff with basics that we can even cook and do laundry - best thing too is that we go home with our clothes all clean and dry and eveyone's well rested and happy :)

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: The size of the unit was great!  The location was about 20 minutes from Las. Vegas Blvd.  The shuttle was easily available to drop off and pickup downtown.  The only downside was that the bed linen had not been changed in the master bedroom.  All things considered, it was a good place to stay.

reviews.title: Vacation at Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: The best Resort for the last 16 years. Best quality appliances, cook ware and TV. Great location of the resort, very quiet and clean. Excellent Shuttle transportation to the Strip. Friendly staff. My highest recommendations about this resort. It is close to the Red Rock Park.

reviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: The place is very nice. Wr had a 2 BR unit on  the 2nd floor, but the air conditioning was not cooling down the bedrooms. The Cliffs is about 10 to 15 minutes away from the strip. but they had a shuttle that took you there and back at no additional charge included in the $25 resort fee.

reviews.title: Great Resort AWAY From The Strip
reviews.text: My wife's whole family lives in Vegas, so when we go to visit, we don't go for the gambling. The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a great resort outside the hustle and bustle of the Strip but still close to a resort like Red Rock Resort Casino (which has a GREAT buffet). We got two 2-bedroom units right next to each other for our group of twelve family members and we were able to just

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Rooms were clean and the bed slept well.   The staff was very helpful.   The location was excellent for shopping and eating.   We would definitely stay there again.   Only draw back was the room didn't have a long mirror for seeing yourself fully dressed.

reviews.title: Nice Place in a Good Location
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a very nice place to stay off the Strip.  The rooms are very nice overall.  Our only complaint would be the air conditioning did not flow well into the master bedroom unless door was open - had to forgo privacy for cool air. .  Also would prefer twin beds in the second bedroom - all 2 bedroom suites only have queens.  The location is great as there are many stores and restaurants within walking distance or a very quick drive. They also provide a shuttle to the Strip daily, if you do not want to rent a car.  We did rent a vehicle and drive to the Strip is quick   It was nice to be in quiet area but able to travel to the action very easily. We would definitely stay here again if visiting Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Beautiful peaceful place to stay.
reviews.text: The bathrooms and kitchen could have been a little cleaner but that would be my only complaint and it didn’t distract from our overall experience.  The staff was helpful and friendly!  It was nice to be in such peaceful surroundings yet only 20 minutes from the strip.  Highly recommend!!

reviews.title: las vegas
reviews.text: nice place, clean and close to shopping center, easy to get to the strip,had a shuddle to the strip but we did not use it because we had a car. pool area was very nice and inviting with plenty of chairs..very nice bar-b -que area that you could use with lighting.

reviews.title: Great location and facility.
reviews.text: This is the second time we have stayed at the Cliffs.  We like the smaller property away from the crowds.  Each unit is specious with newer appliances and a small patio or balcony.  The pool, hot tub, exercise equipment and grills are centrally located and convenient.  Each unit has covered parking.  Helpful but not pushy staff.

reviews.title: Quiet resort in a mad town
reviews.text: It was about 8 miles away from the strip, don't  travel between 4 and 7 in the evenings. Complex manager helpful. Staff helpful if asked. I had 6 notification of a gift at reception during a 7 day stay.

reviews.title: Looking for Peace look no further
reviews.text: Cliffs at Peace Canyon is the place nestled in a clean and quiet neighborhood just off the interstate highway. Nice accomodations , nice pool, and nice surrounding. Close by shopping and a shuttle service is offer.

reviews.title: Good 3 Star
reviews.text: The property was in a nice secure part of Vegas. It is about 20 - 30 minutes from the Strip. Near lots of shopping and restaurants. While we were there the pool was broken and it was super hot. But the staff is very accommodating.

reviews.title: Awesome resort
reviews.text: We loved our stay here. The location was perfect for staying out of the busiest spots, but still only a few minutes from everything. The shuttle provided was excellent! It was easy to schedule and was prompt in pick up and drop off. The driver was funny and knowledgeable. The resort was clean and inviting. Our condo was true to the pictures on line, and we loved it!

reviews.title: Great location.
reviews.text: New area with lots available. Away from frantic strip activity but shuttle if you want to experience the strip. Red Rock Casino is close if you want to go to movie, bowl or enjoy great food plus gamble. Only issues we had with unit was maintenance and poor quality paper products. Everything thing else was great.

reviews.title: Vacation at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We were extremely happy with our resort and all the amenities it offered! The staff was very helpful and friendly! We loved the shuttle to and from the strip. It had a great fitness center. The pool and hot tub was great! We especially loved the 4 grills outside that were available and cleaned every night. Our place had a washer and dryer, dishwasher, blender, and a porch outside the unit which were all nice! They provided the soap for both!

reviews.title: Great Location Off of the Strip
reviews.text: A great location for those visiting Vegas for a beautiful, restful stay where The Strip is not your main attraction.  This would be great for families with children.  Shuttle service to and from the Strip is excellent, but ridesharing will get you there to without a huge bill.  Everything is close; great restaurants nearby.  We explored the beauty of nature in Vegas--Red Rock Canyon was gorgeous and just a short drive away.  Costco and the beautiful Summerlin community with its resort, casino and upscale shopping district is a 10-15 minute drive.  I'm not the easiest person to please, but I was well pleased with my stay at Cliffs at Peace Canyon.  Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Not Disappointed!
reviews.text: We have been RCI members for 15+ years. When booking I always pay attention to the rating (gold crown,  silver crown, etc.). We most always stay at a gold crown resort for obvious reasons.  The Cliffs did not disappoint. The 2 bedroom unit was very clean, spacious and felt like home. Staff during checkin was very efficient, courteous , and knowledgeable. On-site swimming pool was very clean and a good size. My husband used the fitness room which was equipped with 2 treadmills and weightlifting machines with multiple stations .  Outdoor gas grills were located near the pool area. I was impressed how clean they were.  The resort is located approximately 20-25 minutes from the las vegas strip so it was close enough to get to the strip but far enough away from all the hussle and bustle of the strip.
