Exactly what we were looking for.  A free shuttle service is available to the strip for those who do not want to attempt driving on their own.  The shuttle also provided service to Fremont and the grocery store.  The resort was very peace after a full day of seeing the nearby sites. Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire, Hoover Dam and the Mob Museum are within a  reasonable driving distance away.  All in all,  were very satisfied with The Cliffs at Peace Canyon.

reviews.title: Peaceful retreat in west Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is the second year we have stayed at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon. The staff is friendly and helpful. The resort is well cared for with beautiful grounds and pool area. The resort is located on the west side of the Las Vegas metro area, away from the hustle and bustle of The Strip. You can still get anywhere in town quickly because of the resort's proximity to Hwy. 215 and to W. Tropicana Ave.and W. Flamingo Rd. There are Smith's and Albertson's grocery stores nearby, along with good restaurants such as Ohjah Japanese Steakhouse and Lindo Michoacán Mexican restaurant. We would stay here again in the future.

reviews.title: NCguy
reviews.text: The unit was updated and comfortable.  Convenient to the pool, workout, and grill area. Resort is a nice size, walkable to pool area.  Conveniently located to shopping, golf, and groceries.  Staff is very helpful.

reviews.title: Loved This Place!!!
reviews.text: Where do I begin? Let’s start with Steven, the Manager. From my phone calls prior to arriving to checking in, he was very helpful and accommodating.  The condo was perfect. I had requested the back of property, 2nd floor and that’s what they had for us. The unit was clean and had everything we needed. Great pool and bbq area too.  The shuttle drivers, Steve and Rockie were the best!!! We used the shuttle everyday and they both were informative and funny! The evening driver (can’t remember his name) was hilarious! What a pleasure just to take a shuttle! Can’t say enough about the entire staff. We will definitely be back!  I’d like to take the time to mention about the timeshare breakfast that you will be offered when you check-in. If you have no intention of purchasing a timeshare, please do not waste the time of these hard-working people just to take the free gift that they offer you. It’s not fair to them. My husband and I went to the breakfast with June and so glad that we did. We ended up purchasing a timeshare. June was absolutely amazing!  So needless to say, we will make it a point to go back to the Cliffs. Thank you to all of you. Gail and Ed (or Julie and Geronimo according to Steve the shuttle driver).

reviews.title: Nice place to stay off the strip
reviews.text: Be early for the shuttle they will leave you if you are 1 minute late.Resort and rooms very clean. The shuttle driver Steve is the best, funny and familiar with the area. We enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere of being away from the strip.

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: We were wonderfully surprised by this resort.  It is in a great location.....away from the strip but there is a free shuttle to take you there.  The staff was very helpful and friendly.  The pool area was wonderful but it could use some more umbrellas for shade.

reviews.title: Great stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Awesome check-in experience with me arriving after midnight. Kind enough to put us in a ground floor unit. Unit was comfortable, clean and had everything we needed including washer/dryer. 2 bedroom/2 bath. Was able to get clean clothes and a mid week cleaning. Further from Strip than I thought but had free Shuttle service to the Strip, Fremont St, Wal-Mart and grocery store. Used the pool and hot tub which were both clean and accommodating.

reviews.title: Peace at the cliff
reviews.text: If you are looking for a place that is quiet, no water park because you are an adult and you want relaxation, The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is definitely the place to go to be away from the strip of Vegas but close to everything

reviews.title: Nice Resort off the Strip
reviews.text: I found the resort to be clean, quiet and comfortable.The kitchens are well appointed and the grounds are well kept.There is a shuttle, but since the resort does not have a resturant, I would recommend a car to get to nearby shopping and resturants.

reviews.title: wonderful place to relax
reviews.text: This resort has easy access to the action of the strip and the surrounding area activities, but allows for a peaceful restful vacation.  Most places to visit are within a half an hour drive.  There are places to buy groceries and other items.  The grills at this resort are a plus as it allows for another meal type option.

reviews.title: Cliffs of Peace Canyon is the BEST kept secret in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: I love this time share.  the rooms are well kept and the resort staff is extremely helpful.  The rooms are all closely surrounding the pool which is small and intimate.  People are always happy and willing to get to know you.  My two favorite people at the resort are Steve, the shuttle bus driver, and Danny at the welcome desk.  (Danny has recently moved to the Grandview.  He will be missed.)   This resort is the BEST kept secret in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Outside Vegas, but they have a shuttle!
reviews.text: We stayed a  the Cliffs for a week. The check in was quick and you immediately were sent to the time share people to get your parking pass. It was OK, no pressure. THe activity fee was $25 which includes the shuttle and Wi-Fi. It was worth it the wi-fi is strong and the shuttle is great. The grounds were perfect and the pool was a great relief the hot days spent in Vegas. The hot tub was very nice and it was hot. They have a shuttle and they give you a schedule of times that they will drop you off either at Fremont Street or at the Mirage Hotel. It also has the pick up times. You must sign up to go or come on the shuttle. The resort is located in a nice residential neighborhood. There are gas stations and food store very near and the shuttle also go to Walmart on certain days. We stayed in a two bedroom. It had a very large living, dining and kitchen space as well as a patio. They have a very large flat screen TV and the bedrooms have TV as well. The ups: The unit was very nice and the mattresses offered good sleeping. The furniture in the unit was in excellent shape and the L shaped couch was nice to spread out on. The dining table was big with six chairs. The appliances were good and they were clean. There was also a nice selection of utensils. The downs: The countertop in the kitchen was dated and was separating in the corner joint. This no big deal. The cabinets could use a replacement in the near future. The only thing that was not acceptable was the carpet in the Master Bedroom. The carpet was gold and the path between the bedroom door and the bathroom were black with dirt. It was so bad you could not see the gold color. Also around the baseboard in the room was a dust line which means the carpet had not been cleaned in a very long time. I think tile would be a better choice when the carpet is replaced. The pillows need to be replaced. All in all it was a great stay. The staff were very pleasant and nice to interact with. If we return to Vegas we will stay again! Thank you for the great time.

reviews.title: Bed Bugs !!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Checked in and that night was bitten by a bed bug on my face . Reported it to management who called bug specialist who confirmed they had bugs. Some staff said it wasn't the first time. We were not satisfied with how we were treated. The place  had dirty floors and our room number had a sticker that said BUG OFF #211 which kind of says they knew and rented to us anyway.

reviews.title: Beautiful peaceful resort
reviews.text: Mountains all around   7 miles to Vegas strip   Peaceful sleep   Bennie was awesome who drives the shuttle   Very clean resort   Nice pool and spa   Rooms great   Roomy   Accomodates handicap   Pleasant friendly employees

reviews.title: Relaxing resort
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. The resort is centered away from the strip, but shuttle service available.We were  close enough to go to Red Rock Canyon, shop, restaurants, Hover Damn, and Lake Meade.Everyone very friendly.

reviews.title: Nice Quiet Place
reviews.text: We were in Vegas to see a friend's musical show.  I ride road bike and got in three great rides directly from the resort.  I went out to Red Rock Park and along the 215 bike trail.  Nice good restaurants and lots of shopping nearby.  We will probably stay again on our next trip to Vegas.  They also have a shuttle to the strip and Fremont St which we took advantage of.

reviews.title: Las Vegas off the Strip
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon was a wonderful way to have access to the strip via car or their shuttle with just a 20 minute drive away.  We preferred staying in a more peaceful resort, with easy access to Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire and other outdoor recreational attractions.  The resort was beautifully maintained, on the smaller side.  Only downside for some may be the lack of any type of restaurant on the premises.  It's very close to grocery stores and numerous restaurants within a 10 minute walk for 5 minute drive.

reviews.title: Annual Vegas vacation
reviews.text: Enjoyed the week sitting by the pool relaxing and reading.  The surroundings are usually peaceful except when they need to use the blowers to clean the sidewalks of leaves daily.  There could be more tables with umbrellas but the pool area is the main reason I visit.

reviews.title: mr kermit hansen
reviews.text: everyone was very helpful.  The shuttle were very helpful in so many ways.. I can not say enough about the resort GREAT GREAT GREAT///////// o k I just coouldn't  think of more good things to say. If I go back to Vegas I will stay at the same Place.

reviews.title: The Best of Vegas and It's Not The Strip
reviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a wonderful, quiet resort in an excellent location away from the Strip.  The staff, with the exception of one person (there's always one) were friendly, polite, and responsive.  The shuttle to the Strip was excellent.  We couldn't have been more pleased with out stay.

reviews.title: Pleasant stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed being off the strip, unit had everything we required, although a little outdated.  Kitchen cabinets could definitely be replaced as well as the mattress.  Pool and surrounding area was nicely maintained and staff was fantastic . Shuttle service is a plus although we also rented a car to see some other sights and do some shopping.

reviews.title: Great Location on Westside
reviews.text: Easy access from both directions of the 215.  All kinds of shopping within a couple of miles.  15 minutes from Red Rocks Conservation area.  Convenient shuttle service.   The pool area is great for relaxation and socializing.  Our one bedroom unit was clean, comfortable, and quite.

reviews.title: Nice resort, but location of our unit had issues.
reviews.text: The resort was very nice, but 0ur unit was right on Peace Canyon Way and was very noisy from the street traffic.  There were some loud cars that seem to race down the street.  It was nice weather, and we could not keep the windows open for the breeze.  We put up with the noise for about 3 days and then asked to be moved to another unit.  The resort said that it was too late, that they would have to charge us.

reviews.title: Quite nice
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon.  The photos were representative of the property.   We had a 2 bedroom unit because there were 4 of us.  Our unit was nice but happened to face the street so not real conducive to using the patio.  It wasn't enough to make us move, but next time, I'd request one with more privacy.  This was a perfect place to stay since we did not want the hustle/bustle of the Vegas Strip.  We did use the free shuttle to go to the Strip one night.  That was nice.  This was a hiking trip for us and it was a great location--so close to Red Rock Canyon.  The pool is small but not crowded when we were there.  Although I wouldn't classify this property as

reviews.title: A great place to stay
reviews.text: Quiet, clean and great pool!  Best value RCI has in Vegas compared to other properties.  We've been coming here for over 10 years and I appreciate the maintenance on the rooms and grounds. First timne we've had a too worn mattress but we lived and it will probably be replaced soon.

reviews.title: Base Point
reviews.text: We used this resort as a base point to see sites in the area.  We don't gamble.  The rooms were nice but the housekeeping needs a refresher course.  The refrigerator was not emptied from previous guests, the counter tops seemed gritty.  I know this seems picky but they really need to wipe down the base boards and vacuum the carpet next to the base boards.  Had dust growing.  I call on the refrigerator and counter tops and they were very prompt in cleaning them.  The staff were very pleasant and even though we did not use the pool, workout room etc.... they seemed very nice.  I would recommend going back to this place.

reviews.title: Vegas and Golf Trip
reviews.text: Stayed at resort for a week of gambling and golf. Resort is a comfortable 15-20 minutes west of strip near Red Rock. Traffic was never a problem and you are situated near the freeway entrance and two main roads leading to the strip or Red Rock Casino.  Very easy check in even when early.  Had four guys in 2 - 2 bedroom units that were plenty big and very comfy beds.  Between the four of us we tried the complementary coffee in the clubhouse, pool and hot tub during the stay.  Also used the shuttle service which was always on time and delivered guest to grocery area or the center strip at the Mirage.  Situated near shopping center with numerous options for dining if you want something good away from the strip.Recommend highly.

reviews.title: Near Red Rock Canyon
reviews.text: This resort was located close to the Red Rock Canyon where we went hiking. We also love to go to the Red Rock Casino to gamble, bowl, go to the movies & eat, so the location was perfect for visiting that casino. The resort staff was super friendly & accommodating, even if it was 2:30 in the morning. The 2 bedroom was huge & gave us plenty of space.

reviews.title: Property off the strip
reviews.text: the resort was not too busy. Plenty chairs at the pool. The resort was also very quiet, easy to relax. The shuttle was a great advantage, since the casino are charging now for parking, it was east to get to the strip. The shuttle drivers were very polite and personal. All over it was a great place to stay, I would stay there again anytime.

reviews.title: The cliffs
reviews.text: Really beautiful units, nice quiet pool, about 20 min from the strip but lots of restaurants around, great staff.  JP at the front counter was amazing, always smiling and willing to give tips on places to go..  they also have a $500 draw every Saturday for one lucky guest to win

reviews.title: Liked this resort, the area, would definitely recommend!
reviews.text: Beds were comfortable, shower heads are great!  Pool towels are provided.  No frying pan or spatula.  If you plan to eat around the pool buy some paper plates.  Our family stayed in a 2 bedroom, there was plenty of room for all six of us, everyone liked the set up, enjoyed the little patio outside the room.  Grounds were clean and well groomed, pool and surrounding area was clean, very well maintained.  The online pictures represent the area very well.

reviews.title: Cliffs At Peace Canyon
reviews.text: Approx. 20 Minutes from a the Vegas Strip. Quiet location with plenty of shopping and dining nearby. Nice pool area with a large hot tub. Outdoor grilling area available. We had a one bedroom unit which was large and comfortable, small deck with table and chairs off the dining area.The kitchen was not as well stocked with extra utensils etc.. as other places we have stayed but it was sufficient. This was our first trip to Vegas and this was a good choice. They do provide a shuttle service to the strip but you have to plan ahead and reserve a spot.

reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: This is not a gold crown resort. Proceed at your own disappointment. Unit was very dated. Matress and pillows worn, no whirlpool ion master, a/c fan noisy, unable to read cup level on coffee pot, smoke detector yellow.

reviews.title: Resort Disappointment
reviews.text: If you are looking for a quiet & relaxing resort away from the crowds and secluded.....this may look the place on paper....but it is NOT that.  It is on a Main Street right in the heart of Las Vegas subdivision.  The best part of the stay was the staff who were very helpful and try hard to make our stay a good experience....Thanks so much Jasmine!!!They say they are away from the Strip but with traffic it really is about 30 mins away, which if it was, as advertised by RCI....that would have been okay but in reality the location didn't come close to what they promised sadly!!The unit itself is soooo far from a GOLD STAR unit!!  The kitchen cupboards were loose and uneven, the floor was in terrible shape.  It is all stone tiles but all the ground was broken and crumbling between the stones so they banged when you walked on them and the floor had a constant dust on it.  The AC unit was soooooo loud you have a hard time sleeping with it on.  The balcony is small and looks out at the building next door.  The bed was really hard too.  It did have ensuite laundry which was a bonus and a full kitchen....but didn't have some of the basic things you need.  We arrived Mon and left Sun and never had housekeeping....which was okay but surprising.It is in need of a MAJOR upgrade to the units.

reviews.title: The Cliffs
reviews.text: The property was just as described.  Very clean, well kept, Pool, jacuzzi and exercise  room wer all fantastik.  We checked in at 1:30am Saturday night and the night staff was very helpful and accomodating.  The information they gave us was very informative.  As we walked the ground the next day, their staff was genuinely interested in our experience there. Kitchen was well equipped  and the outdoor grilles were very inviting.  Next time we will have more time to use them.

reviews.title: Good to be off the strip
reviews.text: I arrived at the Cliffs 4/9 and will leave 4/23.  It is in a residential area, and there are stores and restaurants you can walk to, or a short drive.  I basically wanted to get out of the cold and be somewhere warm.  There are two story buildings around the property.  There are no elevators.  I asked for a room on the first floor close to the pool.  It is close, but I cannot see the pool from my unit.  My room is very depressing.  I love the sun and the light, and at home I let all the light I can in.  When I walked in, it was like coming into a cave.  They have wooden blinds on the windows.  I went around opening all of them.  Unfortunately, I don’t know if the windows have ever been washed, but I at least got some light, but not what I wanted.  There are simply not enough windows.  They are not very soundproof.  The people upstairs are constantly dragging chairs, which is quite noisy.  The pool is small, but fine.  There are an adequate amount of chairs, but not a lot of people out there, but that could be because I am from Ohio, so I am happy to be out when it is 63.  The shuttle goes to the Mirage every hour, and will drop off at the grocery store on each trip if desired.  It also goes to Freemont Street a couple of nights and leaves you there about three hours.  It also has trips to Walmart and Red Rock Casino a couple times a week.  You do need to make reservations.  There are not many scheduled activities.  One thing that would be nice if they had a small store for essentials.  There are some vending machines in the work out room for some snacks though.  Overall, it is very basic ... not a great room, not great landscaping, could use some updating, but the people are nice.

reviews.title: Almost 2 weeks at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
reviews.text: The location was ideal for the type of trip we had planned to Vegas.  Very little time on the Strip but good access to Hwy 215 allowed us to get everywhere quickly.  The resort itself was very relaxing with just a short walk to the pool, hot tub, exercise room and Bar BQ's.

reviews.title: great uuits,location, and extras at the Cliffs
reviews.text: was a  great place to stay and convieniet to las vagas.  units were well maintained and staff was very helpful.,grounds were well done.also handicap parking was appreciared.was also convient to eating and business places.

reviews.title: Excellent resort!
reviews.text: The entire resort is clean, spacious and the staff is friendly and courteous.  The bed was comfortable an resort was very quiet!  We were very happy with our condo!  Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a wonderful resort and we will be visiting again!

reviews.title: Relaxing and Peaceful.
reviews.text: I was a little concerned initially about the distance from Strip but the Resort is an excellent location with lots of restaurants.  We had a rental car but utilized the shuttle to go to the strip and downtown.  If you want to do Vegas and relax w/o the crowds this an excellent location.  We had the 2 bedroom so we could spread out and have family over to visit. The bedroom were comfortable enough ...pillows kinda soft though. We were on the go a lot so the bed wasn't a major concern.

reviews.title: Spring Break
reviews.text: This was our first trip to the Cliffs and we will return. While this is an older property our unit looked completely updated with very nice new furniture. The rooms were clean and quite large with plenty of space to spread out and store your gear. We really liked the sectional sofa in the living room. The pool, hot tub , BBQ and outdoor fireplace provided great outdoor living. We took advantage of the free shuttle to the strip- the drivers were very nice and accomodating. What a great vacation!

reviews.title: Needs updating
reviews.text: The grounds are very nice as is the pool area. Check in went smoothly without the typical time share pitch.It is away from the strip which means it is quiet and there’s a shuttle ( which we did not use) .The unit itself was another story. Everything appears old and worn.There was an odor in the room ( not sure why) . It dissipated after a while with Open windows and febreze.  The air conditioner did not work though once reported was fixed. The dish washer did not work properly. Was given “ new dish detergent “ to try.  That did not work either. It probably needs to be replaced.  I would not recommend this property. We will not come back.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: We loved this resort- 2 bedroom lower unit- plenty of space for a family of 4. Full sized washer/dryer in a lundery room off of the kitchen. Big walk in master closet- with plenty of space for luggage and clothes. Good living room set up- great pool and grill/ fireplace area in the center of the resort. Assigned covered parking right next to the unit... it was great for us- we wanted to be off strip this time- went to the grand canyon, Away from the congestion- but close enough to get their quickly.  This was a perfect resort for a family that wants to relax, but is able to get to the fun and thirlls that Vegas offers in a hurry. Staff was great... resort was full, but it did not feel crowded. They appologized for not having a

reviews.title: Wonderful Las Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at the Cliff's at Peace Canyon resort using our RCI membership for the first time.  We could not have been more happy with the entire experience.  The staff was great, the unit was clean and well stocked with everything you would need for your time, and the shuttle capped off a really wonderful stay.  This was the first time in our many years of travel that we could actually use the knives provided in the unit, they were sharp!!  The kitchen was well stocked as was the bathroom with plenty of towels and other necessary items.  We used the shuttle to travel from the resort to the strip every day which worked out great.  No need to drive our car and try to find parking on the strip.  Can't say enough about how much fun we had and the resort was the main reason, wonderful place to stay and see the sights.
